              {data.tingkatFaskes || 'FKTP'}
            </span>
            {data.isTerintegrasiSikda ? (
              <span className="text-[9px] font-black px-2 py-0.5 bg-emerald-500 text-white uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-1 shadow-xs border border-emerald-400">
                <CheckCircle2 size={11} className="text-white" />
                SIKDA AKTIF
              </span>
            ) : (
              <span className="text-[9px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 bg-amber-500/90 text-white uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-1 shadow-xs border border-amber-400">
                <AlertCircle size={11} className="text-white" />
                NON-SIKDA
              </span>
            )}
          </div>
          {data.akreditasi && (
            <span className="text-[9px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 bg-emerald-600 text-white uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-1 shadow-xs">
              <ShieldCheck size={11} />
              Akreditasi {data.akreditasi}
            </span>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Title on Bottom Photo */}
        <div className="absolute bottom-3 left-4 right-4">
          <span className="text-[9px] font-mono font-bold text-emerald-400 uppercase tracking-widest">
            {data.kode || 'KODE FASKES'} • {data.jenis}
          </span>
          <h2 className="text-sm font-bold text-white tracking-tight leading-snug drop-shadow-sm mt-0.5 truncate">
            {data.nama}
          </h2>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* SIKDA INTEGRATION STATUS CARD BANNER */}
      {data.isTerintegrasiSikda ? (
        <div className="p-3 bg-emerald-50 border-b border-emerald-200 shrink-0">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <span className="relative flex h-2.5 w-2.5">
                <span className="animate-ping absolute inline-flex h-full w-full rounded-full bg-emerald-400 opacity-75"></span>
                <span className="relative inline-flex rounded-full h-2.5 w-2.5 bg-emerald-600"></span>
              </span>
              <span className="text-[11px] font-black text-emerald-950 uppercase tracking-wide flex items-center gap-1">
                <CheckCircle2 size={13} className="text-emerald-700" />
                Terintegrasi Sistem SIKDA
              </span>
            </div>
            <span className="text-[10px] font-mono font-bold bg-emerald-200/90 text-emerald-900 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-sm">
              {data.totalUsers || 0} Akun Staf &amp; Nakes
            </span>
          </div>
          <p className="text-[10px] text-emerald-800 mt-1 leading-relaxed">
            Faskes ini aktif terhubung ke ekosistem SIKDA Kab. Bogor dengan {data.totalUsers || 0} akun staf operasional (Dokter, Perawat, Loket Pendaftaran, Farmasi, Kasir &amp; Lab).
          </p>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="p-3 bg-amber-50/90 border-b border-amber-200 shrink-0">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <AlertCircle size={13} className="text-amber-600 shrink-0" />
              <span className="text-[11px] font-black text-amber-950 uppercase tracking-wide">
                Belum Terintegrasi SIKDA
              </span>
            </div>
            <span className="text-[10px] font-mono font-semibold bg-amber-200/80 text-amber-900 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-sm">
              0 Akun Terdaftar
            </span>
          </div>
          <p className="text-[10px] text-amber-800 mt-1 leading-relaxed">
            Fasilitas ini terdaftar dalam basis data pemetaan wilayah Dinas Kesehatan, namun belum mengaktifkan akun operasional atau melakukan bridging ke aplikasi SIKDA.
          </p>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* TABS NAVIGATION (STICKY GOOGLE MAPS STYLE) */}
      <div className="sticky top-0 z-20 flex border-y border-slate-200 bg-white/95 backdrop-blur-md shadow-xs shrink-0">
        <button
          onClick={() => setActiveTab('profil')}
          className={`flex-1 py-3 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider border-b-2 transition-all cursor-pointer text-center ${
            activeTab === 'profil'
              ? 'border-emerald-700 text-emerald-800 bg-white shadow-2xs'
              : 'border-transparent text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-50'
          }`}
        >
          Profil &amp; Izin
        </button>
        <button
          onClick={() => setActiveTab('layanan')}
          className={`flex-1 py-3 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider border-b-2 transition-all cursor-pointer text-center ${
            activeTab === 'layanan'
              ? 'border-emerald-700 text-emerald-800 bg-white shadow-2xs'
              : 'border-transparent text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-50'
          }`}
        >
          Layanan &amp; Bed
        </button>
        <button
          onClick={() => setActiveTab('armada')}
          className={`flex-1 py-3 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider border-b-2 transition-all cursor-pointer text-center ${
            activeTab === 'armada'
              ? 'border-emerald-700 text-emerald-800 bg-white shadow-2xs'
              : 'border-transparent text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-50'
          }`}
        >
          Armada &amp; Darurat
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* TAB CONTENT 1: PROFIL & IZIN OPERASIONAL */}
      {activeTab === 'profil' && (
        <div className="divide-y divide-slate-100 flex-1">
          <DetailRow
            icon={Network}
            label="Status Integrasi SIKDA"
            value={data.isTerintegrasiSikda ? 'Terintegrasi Penuh (Online SIKDA)' : 'Belum Terkoneksi ke SIKDA'}
            subvalue={
              data.isTerintegrasiSikda
                ? `Terdaftar ${data.totalUsers || 0} akun staf operasional faskes (Dokter, Perawat/Bidan, Loket Pendaftaran, Farmasi, Kasir, dan Laboratorium).`
                : 'Fasilitas belum memiliki akun operasional aktif di platform SIKDA. Menunggu aktivasi oleh Dinas Kesehatan.'
            }
            highlight={Boolean(data.isTerintegrasiSikda)}
            badge={data.isTerintegrasiSikda ? 'AKTIF ONLINE' : 'BELUM TERDAFTAR'}
          />

          <DetailRow
            icon={UserCheck}
            label="Penanggung Jawab Medis / Kepala"
            value={data.penanggungJawab || '-'}
            subvalue={data.sipPenanggungJawab ? `SIP/STR: ${data.sipPenanggungJawab}` : undefined}
          />

          <DetailRow
            icon={FileText}
            label="Surat Izin Operasional"
            value={data.nomorIzinOperasional || 'Izin Resmi Dinas Kesehatan'}
            subvalue={
              data.tanggalIzinOperasional
                ? `Berlaku sejak: ${new Date(data.tanggalIzinOperasional).toLocaleDateString('id-ID')}`
                : undefined
            }
          />

          <DetailRow
            icon={Clock}
            label="Jam Operasional Layanan"
            value={data.jamOperasional || '24 Jam Non-Stop'}
            highlight={Boolean(data.jamOperasional?.toLowerCase().includes('24 jam'))}
          />

          <DetailRow
            icon={MapPin}
            label="Alamat Lengkap"
            value={data.alamat || '-'}
            subvalue={`Kec. ${kec}, Kel./Desa: ${desa}`}
          />

          <DetailRow
            icon={Phone}
            label="Kontak Kantor / Telepon"
            value={data.telepon || '-'}
            link={data.telepon ? `tel:${data.telepon}` : undefined}
          />

          {data.kontakDarurat && (
            <DetailRow
              icon={Siren}
              label="Hotline Gawat Darurat 24 Jam"
              value={data.kontakDarurat}
              link={`tel:${data.kontakDarurat}`}
              badge="SIAGA 24 JAM"
              highlight
            />
          )}

          {data.email && (
            <DetailRow
              icon={Mail}
              label="Email Resmi"
              value={data.email}
              link={`mailto:${data.email}`}
            />
          )}

          <DetailRow
            icon={MapPin}
            label="Titik Koordinat GPS"
            value={!isNaN(lat) && !isNaN(lng) ? `${lat.toFixed(5)}, ${lng.toFixed(5)}` : '-'}
          />

          {/* RADIUS TOGGLE BUTTON */}
          <div className="p-4 bg-slate-50/70 flex items-center justify-between">
            <div className="flex flex-col">
              <span className="text-xs font-medium text-slate-700">Radius Jangkauan Pelayanan (3 KM)</span>
              <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400">
                Visualisasikan zona layanan utama di sekeliling fasilitas
              </span>
            </div>
            <button
              onClick={() => setShowImpactRadius(!showImpactRadius)}
              className={`px-3 py-1.5 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider rounded-none transition-colors cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1 ${
                showImpactRadius
                  ? 'bg-rose-600 text-white'
                  : 'bg-white border border-slate-300 text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-100'
              }`}
            >
              <Radio size={12} />
              {showImpactRadius ? 'Aktif' : 'Tampilkan'}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* TAB CONTENT 2: LAYANAN & FASILITAS */}
      {activeTab === 'layanan' && (
        <div className="p-4 space-y-4 flex-1">
          {/* Layanan Unggulan */}
          <div className="flex flex-col">
            <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-1 mb-2">
              <Sparkles size={12} className="text-emerald-700" />
              Layanan Unggulan & Poli Spesialis
            </span>
            <div className="p-3 bg-emerald-50/50 border border-emerald-200 text-xs text-slate-800 leading-relaxed font-medium">
              {data.layananUnggulan ||
                'UGD 24 Jam, Poli Umum, Poli Gigi, Poli KIA/KB, Laboratorium Klinis, Farmasi'}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Kapasitas Tempat Tidur (Bed) */}
          <div className="flex flex-col">
            <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-1 mb-2">
              <Bed size={12} className="text-emerald-700" />
              Kapasitas Rawat Inap & Tempat Tidur
            </span>
            <div className="p-3.5 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 flex items-center justify-between">

                <Bed size={16} />
              </div>

          <div className="flex flex-col">

              Status Akreditasi Kemenkes RI
            </span>
            <div className="p-3 bg-blue-50/50 border border-blue-200 flex items-center justify-between">
              <div className="flex flex-col">
                <span className="text-xs font-bold text-blue-900">
                  Akreditasi {data.akreditasi || 'Paripurna'}
                </span>
                <span className="text-[10px] text-blue-600">
                  Standar mutu pelayanan dan keselamatan pasien
                </span>
              </div>
              <ShieldCheck size={20} className="text-blue-600" />
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* TAB CONTENT 3: ARMADA AMBULANS & DARURAT */}
      {activeTab === 'armada' && (

          <div className="p-3 bg-rose-50/60 border border-rose-200 flex items-start gap-3">
            <Siren size={20} className="text-rose-600 mt-0.5 shrink-0" />
            <div className="flex flex-col">
              <span className="text-xs font-bold text-rose-900">
                {data.ketersediaanAmbulance ? 'Armada Ambulans Siaga' : 'Tidak Ada Armada Ambulans Mandiri'}
              </span>
              <span className="text-[10px] text-rose-700 mt-0.5 leading-snug">
                {data.jenisAmbulance || 'Pelayanan evakuasi terhubung dengan Unit Siaga AGD 119 Dinas Kesehatan Kab. Bogor.'}
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>

          {data.kontakDarurat && (
            <div className="p-4 bg-slate-900 text-white flex items-center justify-between">
              <div className="flex flex-col">
                <span className="text-[9px] font-bold text-rose-400 uppercase tracking-widest">
                  Hotline Panggilan Cepat 24 Jam
                </span>
                <span className="text-sm font-bold font-mono mt-0.5 tracking-wider">
                  {data.kontakDarurat}
                </span>
              </div>
              <a
                href={`tel:${data.kontakDarurat}`}
                className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-700 text-white text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider transition-colors"
              >
                Hubungi
              </a>
            </div>
          )}

          <div className="p-3 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 text-xs text-slate-600 leading-relaxed">
            <span className="font-semibold text-slate-800 block mb-1">Protokol Evakuasi Medis:</span>
            Armada siap diterjunkan untuk penanganan henti jantung, trauma kecelakaan lalu lintas, rujukan PONED maternal-neonatal, serta pemindahan pasien kritis ke RS rujukan tingkat 2 dan 3.
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* BOTTOM ACTION BUTTONS (STICKY AT BOTTOM) */}
      <div className="sticky bottom-0 z-20 mt-auto p-3.5 border-t border-slate-200 bg-white/95 backdrop-blur-md shadow-md space-y-2 shrink-0">
        {!isNaN(lat) && !isNaN(lng) && (
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
            <button
              onClick={() => openSmartStreetView(lat, lng)}
              className="w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 py-2 bg-sky-600 hover:bg-sky-700 text-white text-xs font-semibold transition-colors cursor-pointer"
              title="Buka Google Street View 360 derajat di lokasi ini"
            >
              <Eye size={13} />
              <span>Street View</span>
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => openGoogleMapsPin(lat, lng)}
              className="w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 py-2 bg-white hover:bg-slate-50 border border-slate-300 text-slate-700 text-xs font-semibold transition-colors cursor-pointer"
              title="Buka Google Maps dengan pin lokasi asli"
            >
              <MapPin size={13} className="text-rose-600" />
              <span>Peta Google</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        )}

        <button
          onClick={() => {
            if (data.telepon) {
              window.location.href = `tel:${data.telepon}`;
            }
          }}
          className="w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-2 py-2.5 bg-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-800 text-white text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider transition-colors cursor-pointer rounded-none"
        >
          <Phone size={13} />
          <span>Hubungi Fasilitas ({data.telepon || 'Call Center'})</span>
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function DetailRow({
  icon: Icon,
  label,
  value,
  subvalue,
  highlight = false,
  badge,
  link,
}: {
  icon: any;
  label: string;
  value: string;
  subvalue?: string;
  highlight?: boolean;
  badge?: string;
  link?: string;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col px-5 py-2.5 hover:bg-slate-50/50 transition-colors">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-medium flex items-center gap-1.5">
          <Icon size={12} className="text-emerald-700" />
          {label}
        </span>
        {badge && (
          <span className="text-[8px] font-bold px-1.5 py-0.2 bg-rose-100 text-rose-800 uppercase tracking-wider">
            {badge}
          </span>
        )}
      </div>

      {link ? (
        <a
          href={link}
          className={`text-xs mt-0.5 leading-snug break-words hover:underline ${
            highlight ? 'font-bold text-rose-700' : 'text-emerald-700 font-medium'
          }`}
        >
          {value}
        </a>
      ) : (
        <span
          className={`text-xs mt-0.5 leading-snug break-words ${
            highlight ? 'font-bold text-slate-900 font-mono' : 'text-slate-800 font-normal'
          }`}
        >
          {value}
        </span>
      )}

      {subvalue && (
        <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 mt-0.5 leading-tight">{subvalue}</span>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';

import React, { useMemo } from 'react';
import {
  Search,
  Building2,
  HeartPulse,
  Cross,
  FlaskConical,
  Pill,
  Users,
  Siren,
  MapPin,
  ChevronRight,
  ShieldCheck,
  Bed,
  CheckCircle2,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { useGisUIStore } from '../../store/useGisUIStore';
import { FaskesItem } from '@/services/dinkes.service';

interface FaskesPanelProps {
  faskesList: FaskesItem[];
}

export default function FaskesPanel({ faskesList = [] }: FaskesPanelProps) {
  const {
    searchQuery,
    setSearchQuery,
    selectedCategory,
    setSelectedCategory,
    selectedSubdistrict,
    setSelectedSubdistrict,
    selectedFaskesId,
    setSelectedFaskes,
    openPanel,
    closePanelsToTheRight,
    setMapCenter,
    setMapZoom,
  } = useGisUIStore();

  // Ekstraksi daftar kecamatan unik
  const subdistricts = useMemo(() => {
    const setKec = new Set<string>();
    faskesList.forEach((f) => {
      const kec = f.wilayahKecamatan || f.kecamatan;
      if (kec) setKec.add(kec.trim());
    });
    return Array.from(setKec).sort();
  }, [faskesList]);

  // Filtering fasilitas
  const filteredList = useMemo(() => {
    return faskesList.filter((f) => {
      const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase().trim();
      const matchQuery =
        !q ||
        f.nama?.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        f.kode?.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        f.alamat?.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        f.penanggungJawab?.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        f.wilayahKecamatan?.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        f.kecamatan?.toLowerCase().includes(q);

      // Kategori filter
      let matchCat = true;
      if (selectedCategory !== 'ALL') {
        const jenis = f.jenis?.toLowerCase() || '';
        const tingkat = f.tingkatFaskes?.toLowerCase() || '';

        if (selectedCategory === 'RS') {
          matchCat = jenis.includes('rumah sakit') || tingkat.includes('tingkat 2') || tingkat.includes('tingkat 3');
        } else if (selectedCategory === 'PUSKESMAS') {
          matchCat = jenis === 'puskesmas' || jenis.includes('puskesmas');
        } else if (selectedCategory === 'PUSTU') {
          matchCat = jenis.includes('pembantu') || jenis.includes('pustu');
        } else if (selectedCategory === 'LAB') {
          matchCat = jenis.includes('laboratorium') || jenis.includes('lab');
        } else if (selectedCategory === 'APOTEK') {
          matchCat = jenis.includes('apotek') || jenis.includes('farmasi');
        } else if (selectedCategory === 'UKBM') {
          matchCat = jenis.includes('posyandu') || jenis.includes('pos lansia');
        } else if (selectedCategory === 'AMBULANCE') {
          matchCat = f.ketersediaanAmbulance === true || Boolean(f.jenisAmbulance);
        }
      }

      // Kecamatan filter
      let matchKec = true;
      if (selectedSubdistrict !== 'ALL') {
        const kec = (f.wilayahKecamatan || f.kecamatan || '').toLowerCase();
        matchKec = kec.includes(selectedSubdistrict.toLowerCase());
      }

      return matchQuery && matchCat && matchKec;
    });
  }, [faskesList, searchQuery, selectedCategory, selectedSubdistrict]);

  const handleItemClick = (f: FaskesItem) => {
    setSelectedFaskes(f);

    const lat = f.latitude ?? (f.titikGps ? parseFloat(f.titikGps.split(',')[0]) : NaN);
    const lng = f.longitude ?? (f.titikGps ? parseFloat(f.titikGps.split(',')[1]) : NaN);

    if (!isNaN(lat) && !isNaN(lng)) {
      setMapCenter([lat, lng]);
      setMapZoom(16);
    }

    closePanelsToTheRight(-1);
    openPanel('detil-faskes', f.nama || f.namaFaskes || 'Faskes', f);
  };

  const getFacilityIcon = (jenis: string) => {
    const j = (jenis || '').toLowerCase();
    if (j.includes('rumah sakit')) return <Building2 size={14} className="text-rose-600" />;
    if (j.includes('laboratorium') || j.includes('lab')) return <FlaskConical size={14} className="text-purple-600" />;
    if (j.includes('apotek') || j.includes('farmasi')) return <Pill size={14} className="text-blue-600" />;
    if (j.includes('pembantu') || j.includes('pustu')) return <Cross size={14} className="text-teal-600" />;
    if (j.includes('posyandu') || j.includes('pos lansia')) return <Users size={14} className="text-amber-600" />;
    if (j.includes('ambulance') || j.includes('jenazah')) return <Siren size={14} className="text-rose-600" />;
    return <HeartPulse size={14} className="text-emerald-600" />;
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col h-full bg-white font-sans text-left pb-10 select-none">
      {/* SEARCH & DUAL FILTER TOOLBAR */}
      <div className="px-5 py-3.5 border-b border-slate-100 bg-white sticky top-0 z-10 space-y-2.5">
        {/* Search Input */}
        <div className="relative group">
          <Search
            className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400 group-focus-within:text-emerald-700 transition-colors"
            size={14}
          />
          <input
            type="text"
            placeholder="Cari faskes, kode, PJ, kecamatan..."
            value={searchQuery}
            onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
            className="w-full bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 py-2 pl-9 pr-3 text-xs font-normal text-slate-800 placeholder:text-slate-400 focus:outline-none focus:border-emerald-600 focus:bg-white transition-all rounded-none"
          />
        </div>

        {/* Category & Subdistrict Filters */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
          <select
            value={selectedCategory}
            onChange={(e) => setSelectedCategory(e.target.value)}
            className="w-full bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 py-1.5 px-2.5 text-[11px] font-medium text-slate-700 focus:outline-none focus:border-emerald-600 rounded-none cursor-pointer"
          >
            <option value="ALL">Semua Jenis Faskes</option>
            <option value="RS">Rumah Sakit</option>
            <option value="PUSKESMAS">Puskesmas</option>
            <option value="PUSTU">Pustu (Pustu Desa)</option>
            <option value="LAB">Laboratorium</option>
            <option value="APOTEK">Apotek</option>
            <option value="UKBM">Posyandu & Pos Lansia</option>
            <option value="AMBULANCE">Layanan Ambulans</option>
          </select>

          <select
            value={selectedSubdistrict}
            onChange={(e) => setSelectedSubdistrict(e.target.value)}
            className="w-full bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 py-1.5 px-2.5 text-[11px] font-medium text-slate-700 focus:outline-none focus:border-emerald-600 rounded-none cursor-pointer"
          >
            <option value="ALL">Semua Kecamatan ({subdistricts.length})</option>
            {subdistricts.map((kec) => (
              <option key={kec} value={kec}>
                Kec. {kec}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* RESULT METRICS */}
      <div className="px-5 py-2.5 bg-slate-50/80 border-b border-slate-100 flex items-center justify-between text-[11px]">
        <span className="text-slate-500 font-medium">
          Ditemukan <strong className="text-slate-800">{filteredList.length}</strong> Faskes
        </span>
        {filteredList.length !== faskesList.length && (
          <button
            onClick={() => {
              setSearchQuery('');
              setSelectedCategory('ALL');
              setSelectedSubdistrict('ALL');
            }}
            className="text-emerald-700 hover:text-emerald-800 font-bold uppercase text-[9px] tracking-wider cursor-pointer"
          >
            Reset Filter
          </button>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* FACILITY LIST */}
      <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto divide-y divide-slate-100">
        {filteredList.length > 0 ? (
          filteredList.map((f) => {
            const isSelected = selectedFaskesId === f.id;
            const icon = getFacilityIcon(f.jenis || f.jenisFaskes || '');
            const kec = f.wilayahKecamatan || f.kecamatan || 'Kabupaten Bogor';

            return (
              <div
                key={f.id}
                onClick={() => handleItemClick(f)}
                className={`p-4 transition-colors cursor-pointer group relative ${
                  isSelected
                    ? 'bg-emerald-50/70 border-l-[3px] border-emerald-700'
                    : 'bg-white hover:bg-slate-50 border-l-[3px] border-transparent'
                }`}
              >
                <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
                  <div className="flex items-start gap-2.5 min-w-0">
                    <div className="mt-0.5 p-1.5 bg-slate-100 border border-slate-200 shrink-0">
                      {icon}
                    </div>

                    <div className="flex flex-col min-w-0">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
                        <span className="text-[10px] font-mono font-bold text-slate-500 uppercase">
                          {f.kode || 'FASKES'}
                        </span>
                        {f.tingkatFaskes && (
                          <span className="text-[8px] font-bold px-1.5 py-0.2 bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 uppercase tracking-wider">
                            {f.tingkatFaskes}
                          </span>
                        )}
                        {f.akreditasi && (
                          <span className="text-[8px] font-bold px-1.5 py-0.2 bg-blue-100 text-blue-800 uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-0.5">
                            <ShieldCheck size={9} />
                            {f.akreditasi}
                          </span>
                        )}
                        {f.isTerintegrasiSikda ? (
                          <span className="text-[8px] font-black px-1.5 py-0.2 bg-emerald-600 text-white uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-0.5 shadow-xs">
                            <CheckCircle2 size={8} /> SIKDA
                          </span>

                        {f.nama}
                      </h4>

                        <MapPin size={11} className="text-slate-400 shrink-0" />
                        <span className="truncate">Kec. {kec}</span>
                      </div>

                      {/* Info badge row */}
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-2 flex-wrap text-[9px] text-slate-500">

                            {f.kapasitasBed}
                          </span>

                            <Siren size={10} />
                            Siaga Ambulans
                          </span>
                        )}
                        {f.penanggungJawab && (
                          <span className="truncate max-w-[140px] text-slate-400">
                            PJ: {f.penanggungJawab}
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <ChevronRight
                    size={16}
                    className="text-slate-300 group-hover:text-emerald-700 transition-colors shrink-0 mt-2"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })
        ) : (
          <div className="py-16 px-4 text-center">
            <Building2 size={36} className="mx-auto text-slate-300 mb-2" />
            <p className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-700">Tidak ada faskes ditemukan</p>
            <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 mt-1">
              Coba sesuaikan kata kunci pencarian atau reset filter kategori.
            </p>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';

import React, { useMemo } from 'react';
import {
  BarChart3,
  Building2,
  HeartPulse,
  Cross,
  FlaskConical,
  Pill,
  Users,
  Siren,
  Bed,
  MapPin,
  CheckCircle2,
  Network,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { FaskesItem } from '@/services/dinkes.service';
import { useGisUIStore } from '../../store/useGisUIStore';

interface StatistikPanelProps {
  faskesList: FaskesItem[];
}

export default function StatistikPanel({ faskesList = [] }: StatistikPanelProps) {
  const { setMapCenter, setMapZoom } = useGisUIStore();

  const stats = useMemo(() => {
    let rsCount = 0;
    let puskesmasCount = 0;
    let pustuCount = 0;
    let labCount = 0;
    let apotekCount = 0;
    let ukbmCount = 0;
    let ambulanceCount = 0;
    let totalBedEstimated = 0;

    const kecMap: Record<string, { total: number; rs: number; pkm: number; amb: number; lat: number; lng: number }> = {};

    faskesList.forEach((f) => {
      const jenis = (f.jenis || '').toLowerCase();
      const tingkat = (f.tingkatFaskes || '').toLowerCase();
      const kec = f.wilayahKecamatan || f.kecamatan || 'Kabupaten Bogor';

      const lat = f.latitude ?? (f.titikGps ? parseFloat(f.titikGps.split(',')[0]) : NaN);
      const lng = f.longitude ?? (f.titikGps ? parseFloat(f.titikGps.split(',')[1]) : NaN);

      if (!kecMap[kec]) {
        kecMap[kec] = { total: 0, rs: 0, pkm: 0, amb: 0, lat, lng };
      }
      kecMap[kec].total += 1;
      if (!isNaN(lat) && !isNaN(lng)) {
        kecMap[kec].lat = lat;
        kecMap[kec].lng = lng;
      }

      if (jenis.includes('rumah sakit') || tingkat.includes('tingkat 2') || tingkat.includes('tingkat 3')) {
        rsCount++;
        kecMap[kec].rs += 1;
      } else if (jenis.includes('pembantu') || jenis.includes('pustu')) {
        pustuCount++;
      } else if (jenis.includes('puskesmas')) {
        puskesmasCount++;
        kecMap[kec].pkm += 1;
      } else if (jenis.includes('laboratorium') || jenis.includes('lab')) {
        labCount++;
      } else if (jenis.includes('apotek') || jenis.includes('farmasi')) {
        apotekCount++;
      } else if (jenis.includes('posyandu') || jenis.includes('pos lansia')) {
        ukbmCount++;
      }

      if (f.ketersediaanAmbulance === true || Number(f.ketersediaanAmbulance) > 0) {
        ambulanceCount++;
        kecMap[kec].amb += 1;
      }

      if (f.kapasitasBed != null) {
        if (typeof f.kapasitasBed === 'number') {
          totalBedEstimated += f.kapasitasBed;
        } else {
          const num = parseInt(String(f.kapasitasBed).replace(/\D/g, ''));
          if (!isNaN(num)) totalBedEstimated += num;
        }
      }
    });

    const sortedKec = Object.entries(kecMap).sort((a, b) => b[1].total - a[1].total);
    const terintegrasiCount = faskesList.filter((f) => f.isTerintegrasiSikda).length;
    const nonSikdaCount = faskesList.length - terintegrasiCount;

    return {
      total: faskesList.length,
      rsCount,
      puskesmasCount,
      pustuCount,
      labCount,
      apotekCount,
      ukbmCount,
      ambulanceCount,
      totalBedEstimated,
      kecamatanList: sortedKec,
      terintegrasiCount,
      nonSikdaCount,
    };
  }, [faskesList]);

  const handleKecClick = (lat: number, lng: number) => {
    if (!isNaN(lat) && !isNaN(lng)) {
      setMapCenter([lat, lng]);
      setMapZoom(14);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col h-full bg-white font-sans text-left pb-10 select-none">
      {/* Top Banner */}
      <div className="px-5 py-3.5 bg-emerald-50/40 border-b border-slate-100 flex items-center justify-between">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <BarChart3 size={14} className="text-emerald-700" />
          <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-800">Ringkasan Kapasitas Faskes</span>
        </div>
        <span className="text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800">
          Kab. Bogor
        </span>
      </div>

      <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-4 space-y-4">
        {/* KPI Cards Grid */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2.5">
          <div className="p-3 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 flex flex-col">
            <span className="text-[9px] font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider">
              Total Faskes Terdata
            </span>
            <span className="text-2xl font-bold font-mono text-slate-900 mt-1">
              {stats.total}
            </span>
            <span className="text-[9px] text-emerald-700 font-semibold mt-0.5">
              Fasilitas Aktif
            </span>
          </div>

          <div className="p-3 bg-emerald-50/60 border border-emerald-200 flex flex-col">
            <span className="text-[9px] font-bold text-emerald-800 uppercase tracking-wider">
              Kapasitas Tempat Tidur
            </span>
            <span className="text-2xl font-bold font-mono text-emerald-900 mt-1 flex items-baseline gap-1">
              {stats.totalBedEstimated} <span className="text-xs font-normal">TT</span>
            </span>
            <span className="text-[9px] text-emerald-700 font-semibold mt-0.5 flex items-center gap-1">
              <Bed size={10} /> Ruang Perawatan
            </span>
          </div>

          <div className="p-3 bg-rose-50/60 border border-rose-200 flex flex-col">

/**
 * Spatial Analytics & Helper for SIKDA GIS Dinkes
 */

// Simple & robust Ray-Casting Point-in-Polygon (PIP) implementation
export function isPointInPolygonRing(pt: [number, number], ring: number[][]): boolean {
  const [lng, lat] = pt;
  let inside = false;

  for (let i = 0, j = ring.length - 1; i < ring.length; j = i++) {
    const xi = ring[i][0];
    const yi = ring[i][1];
    const xj = ring[j][0];
    const yj = ring[j][1];

    const intersect = yi > lat !== yj > lat && lng < ((xj - xi) * (lat - yi)) / (yj - yi) + xi;
    if (intersect) inside = !inside;
  }

  return inside;
}

export function isPointInFeature(pt: [number, number], feature: any): boolean {
  if (!feature?.geometry?.coordinates) return false;
  const geomType = feature.geometry.type;
  const coords = feature.geometry.coordinates;

  if (geomType === 'Polygon') {
    return isPointInPolygonRing(pt, coords[0]);
  } else if (geomType === 'MultiPolygon') {
    return coords.some((polyCoords: number[][][]) => isPointInPolygonRing(pt, polyCoords[0]));
  }
  return false;
}

/**
 * Agregasi Jumlah Faskes per Kecamatan (Choropleth Analytics)
 */
export function calculateFaskesPerKecamatan(
  faskesList: any[],
  geojsonKecamatan: any
): Record<string, number> {
  const counts: Record<string, number> = {};
  if (!geojsonKecamatan?.features) return counts;

  geojsonKecamatan.features.forEach((feature: any) => {
    const kecName = feature.properties?.WADMKC;
    if (!kecName) return;
    counts[kecName] = 0;

    faskesList.forEach((f) => {
      // First check kecamatan string match
      if (
        f.wilayahKecamatan?.toLowerCase().includes(kecName.toLowerCase()) ||
        f.kecamatan?.toLowerCase().includes(kecName.toLowerCase())
      ) {
        counts[kecName] += 1;
        return;
      }

      // Or spatial PIP check
      const lat = f.latitude ?? (f.titikGps ? parseFloat(f.titikGps.split(',')[0]) : NaN);
      const lng = f.longitude ?? (f.titikGps ? parseFloat(f.titikGps.split(',')[1]) : NaN);

      if (!isNaN(lat) && !isNaN(lng)) {
        if (isPointInFeature([lng, lat], feature)) {
          counts[kecName] += 1;
        }
      }
    });
  });

  return counts;
}

/**
 * Inverted Boundary Masking (Area Luar Wilayah Kabupaten Bogor)
 * Creates a world-bounding polygon with the county boundaries cut out as holes.
 */
export function createInvertedMask(geojson: any): [number, number][][] | null {
  if (!geojson?.features) return null;

  // World outer boundary ring in [lat, lng] format
  const worldOuterRing: [number, number][] = [
    [-85, -180],
    [-85, 180],
    [85, 180],
    [85, -180],
    [-85, -180],
  ];

  const holes: [number, number][][] = [];

  geojson.features.forEach((feature: any) => {
    const geom = feature.geometry;
    if (!geom) return;

    if (geom.type === 'Polygon') {
      const ring = geom.coordinates[0].map(([lng, lat]: [number, number]) => [lat, lng] as [number, number]);
      holes.push(ring);
    } else if (geom.type === 'MultiPolygon') {
      geom.coordinates.forEach((poly: any) => {
        const ring = poly[0].map(([lng, lat]: [number, number]) => [lat, lng] as [number, number]);
        holes.push(ring);
      });
    }
  });

  // Returns array where first is outer boundary, followed by holes
  return [worldOuterRing, ...holes];
}

import { create } from 'zustand';
import { FaskesItem } from '@/services/dinkes.service';

export interface PanelItem {
  id: string;
  type: 'layers' | 'katalog-faskes' | 'detil-faskes' | 'basemap-gallery' | 'statistik' | 'tentang';
  title: string;
  isVisible: boolean;
  data?: any;
}

interface GisUIState {
  // Panel management
  activePanels: PanelItem[];
  openPanel: (type: PanelItem['type'], title: string, data?: any) => void;
  closePanel: (id: string) => void;
  closePanelsToTheRight: (index: number) => void;
  clearPanels: () => void;

  // Spatial layers and map state
  activeLayers: string[];
  toggleLayer: (layerId: string) => void;
  setAllLayers: (layers: string[]) => void;

  mapOpacity: number;
  setMapOpacity: (opacity: number) => void;
  maskOpacity: number;
  setMaskOpacity: (opacity: number) => void;

  activeBaseMap: 'dark' | 'esri' | 'osm' | 'satellite' | 'street';
  setActiveBaseMap: (basemap: 'dark' | 'esri' | 'osm' | 'satellite' | 'street') => void;

  selectedFaskesId: string | null;
  selectedFaskes: FaskesItem | null;
  setSelectedFaskes: (faskes: FaskesItem | null) => void;

  mapCenter: [number, number];
  setMapCenter: (center: [number, number]) => void;
  mapZoom: number;
  setMapZoom: (zoom: number) => void;

  activeAdminBoundary: 'none' | 'kecamatan';
  setActiveAdminBoundary: (boundary: 'none' | 'kecamatan') => void;
  showImpactRadius: boolean;
  setShowImpactRadius: (show: boolean) => void;

  // Filters & Search
  searchQuery: string;
  setSearchQuery: (q: string) => void;
  selectedCategory: string;
  setSelectedCategory: (cat: string) => void;
  selectedSubdistrict: string;
  setSelectedSubdistrict: (kec: string) => void;
  selectedAmbulanceType: string;
  setSelectedAmbulanceType: (amb: string) => void;

  resetMapContext: () => void;
}

export const useGisUIStore = create<GisUIState>((set) => ({
  // Panels
  activePanels: [],

  openPanel: (type, title, data = null) =>
    set((state) => {
      const isFloating = type === 'detil-faskes';
      let nextPanels = [...state.activePanels];

      const isLeftMenu =
        type === 'layers' ||
        type === 'katalog-faskes' ||
        type === 'basemap-gallery' ||
        type === 'statistik' ||
        type === 'tentang';

      if (isLeftMenu) {
        nextPanels = nextPanels.filter((p) => p.type !== 'detil-faskes');
        nextPanels = nextPanels.filter((p) => p.type !== type);
      } else if (isFloating) {
        nextPanels = nextPanels.filter((p) => p.type !== 'detil-faskes');
      }

      const newPanel: PanelItem = {
        id: `${type}-${Date.now()}`,
        type,
        title,
        isVisible: true,
        data,
      };

      nextPanels.push(newPanel);
      return { activePanels: nextPanels };
    }),

  closePanel: (id) =>
    set((state) => {
      const closedPanel = state.activePanels.find((p) => p.id === id);
      if (!closedPanel) return {};

      const filtered = state.activePanels.filter((p) => p.id !== id);
      const isDetail = closedPanel.type === 'detil-faskes';

      return {
        activePanels: filtered,
        ...(isDetail && {
          selectedFaskesId: null,
          selectedFaskes: null,
          showImpactRadius: false,
        }),
      };
    }),

  closePanelsToTheRight: (index) =>
    set((state) => {
      const sliced = state.activePanels.slice(0, index + 1);
      const isDetailStillOpen = sliced.some((p) => p.type === 'detil-faskes');

      return {
        activePanels: sliced,
        ...(!isDetailStillOpen && {
          selectedFaskesId: null,
          selectedFaskes: null,
          showImpactRadius: false,
        }),
      };
    }),

  clearPanels: () =>
    set({
      activePanels: [],
      selectedFaskesId: null,
      selectedFaskes: null,
      showImpactRadius: false,
    }),

  // Layers & Map Settings
  activeLayers: [
    'layer-rs',
    'layer-puskesmas',
    'layer-pustu',
    'layer-posyandu',
    'layer-poslansia',
    'layer-lab',
    'layer-apotek',
    'layer-amb-pasien',
    'layer-amb-jenazah',
  ],

  toggleLayer: (layerId) =>
    set((state) => {
      const exists = state.activeLayers.includes(layerId);
      const next = exists
        ? state.activeLayers.filter((id) => id !== layerId)
        : [...state.activeLayers, layerId];
      return { activeLayers: next };
    }),

  setSelectedSubdistrict: (kec) => set({ selectedSubdistrict: kec }),
  selectedAmbulanceType: 'ALL',
  setSelectedAmbulanceType: (amb) => set({ selectedAmbulanceType: amb }),

  Pill,

  ShieldCheck
} from 'lucide-react';
import { 
  dinkesService,

  VaccineStockItem 
} from '../../../../services/dinkes.service';
import { masterService } from '../../../../services/master.service';

export default function DinkesMedicinesPage() {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'alert' | 'vaksin' | 'katalog'>('alert');
  const [kategoriFilterAlert, setKategoriFilterAlert] = useState<'semua' | 'obat' | 'bmhp'>('semua');
  const [kategoriFilterKatalog, setKategoriFilterKatalog] = useState<'semua' | 'obat' | 'bmhp'>('semua');
  
  const [alerts, setAlerts] = useState<MedicineStockAlert[]>([]);
  const [vaccineData, setVaccineData] = useState<VaccineMonitoringResponse | null>(null);
  const [masterObat, setMasterObat] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [searchKatalog, setSearchKatalog] = useState('');
  const [searchVaksin, setSearchVaksin] = useState('');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  const fetchData = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const [alertData, masterData, vacData] = await Promise.all([
        dinkesService.getMedicineAlerts(),
        masterService.getObat(),
        dinkesService.getVaccineMonitoring().catch(() => null)
      ]);
      setAlerts(Array.isArray(alertData) ? alertData : []);
      setMasterObat(Array.isArray(masterData?.data) ? masterData.data : []);
      setVaccineData(vacData);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Gagal memuat data logistik farmasi, BMHP, & vaksin:", err);
      setAlerts([]);
      setMasterObat([]);
      setVaccineData(null);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchData();
  }, []);

  const alertList = Array.isArray(alerts) ? alerts : [];
  const masterList = Array.isArray(masterObat) ? masterObat : [];

  // Filter Alert Kritis (Obat vs BMHP)
  const filteredAlerts = alertList.filter(item => {
    const isBmhp = item.kategori === 'BMHP';
    if (kategoriFilterAlert === 'obat') return !isBmhp;
    if (kategoriFilterAlert === 'bmhp') return isBmhp;
    return true;
  });

  const obatAlertCount = alertList.filter(a => a.kategori !== 'BMHP').length;
  const bmhpAlertCount = alertList.filter(a => a.kategori === 'BMHP').length;

  // Filter Master Data (Obat vs BMHP)
  const filteredMaster = masterList.filter(o => {
    const matchSearch = 
      (o.namaObat || '').toLowerCase().includes(searchKatalog.toLowerCase()) ||
      (o.kodeObat || '').toLowerCase().includes(searchKatalog.toLowerCase()) ||
      (o.kategori || '').toLowerCase().includes(searchKatalog.toLowerCase());
    
    if (!matchSearch) return false;
    const isBmhp = o.kategori === 'BMHP';
    if (kategoriFilterKatalog === 'obat') return !isBmhp;
    if (kategoriFilterKatalog === 'bmhp') return isBmhp;
    return true;
  });

  // Filter Vaksin Se-Kabupaten
  const faskesVaksinList = vaccineData?.data || [];
  const filteredFaskesVaksin = faskesVaksinList.filter(f => 
    f.namaFaskes.toLowerCase().includes(searchVaksin.toLowerCase()) ||
    f.kecamatan.toLowerCase().includes(searchVaksin.toLowerCase()) ||
    f.vaksinList.some(v => v.namaVaksin.toLowerCase().includes(searchVaksin.toLowerCase()))

    <div className="p-6 lg:p-8 space-y-8 bg-slate-50 min-h-screen">
      {/* Header */}

        <div>
          <Link
            href="/dinkes"
            className="inline-flex items-center text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 hover:text-emerald-700 uppercase tracking-widest mb-2 transition-colors"
          >
            <ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4 mr-1" /> Kembali ke Dashboard Dinkes
          </Link>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-black text-slate-900 tracking-tight flex items-center gap-2">
            <Pill className="w-7 h-7 text-emerald-600" />

          </p>
        </div>

                      <thead>
                        <tr className="bg-slate-50 border-b border-slate-200 text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider">
                          <th className="py-3 px-6">Nama Vaksin &amp; Target Imunisasi</th>
                          <th className="py-3 px-4 font-mono">No. Lot / Batch Pabrik</th>
                          <th className="py-3 px-4 text-center">Suhu Cold-Chain</th>
                          <th className="py-3 px-4 text-center">Stok Dosis</th>
                          <th className="py-3 px-4 text-center">Buffer Min</th>
                          <th className="py-3 px-4 text-center">Tanggal Expired</th>
                          <th className="py-3 px-6 text-center">Status Pasokan</th>
                        </tr>
                      </thead>
                      <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100">
                        {faskes.vaksinList.map((v) => (
                          <tr key={v.id} className="hover:bg-slate-50/70 transition-colors">
                            <td className="py-4 px-6">
                              <span className="font-semibold text-slate-900 block">{v.namaVaksin}</span>
                              <span className="text-xs text-cyan-700 font-medium block">
                                Target: {v.targetPenyakit || 'Imunisasi Rutin'}
                              </span>
                            </td>
                            <td className="py-4 px-4 font-mono font-bold text-slate-700 text-xs">
                              {v.noBatch}
                            </td>
                            <td className="py-4 px-4 text-center">
                              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-bold rounded-full bg-cyan-100 text-cyan-800 border border-cyan-200">
                                <Snowflake className="w-3 h-3 text-cyan-600" />
                                {v.suhuPenyimpanan}
                              </span>
                            </td>
                            <td className="py-4 px-4 text-center font-bold text-slate-900 font-mono">
                              {v.stok} Dosis
                            </td>
                            <td className="py-4 px-4 text-center text-slate-500 font-mono text-xs">
                              {v.stokMinimum} Dosis
                            </td>
                            <td className="py-4 px-4 text-center">
                              <div className="text-xs font-medium text-slate-700">
                                {v.tanggalExpired ? new Date(v.tanggalExpired).toLocaleDateString('id-ID', { day: '2-digit', month: 'short', year: 'numeric' }) : '-'}
                              </div>
                              {v.sisaHari !== null && (
                                <span
                                  className={`inline-block mt-0.5 px-2 py-0.2 text-[10px] font-bold rounded-full ${
                                    v.statusExpired === 'KADALUWARSA'
                                      ? 'bg-rose-100 text-rose-800'
                                      : v.statusExpired === 'SEGERA_KADALUWARSA'
                                      ? 'bg-orange-100 text-orange-800'
                                      : v.statusExpired === 'WASPADA'
                                      ? 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-800'
                                      : 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800'
                                  }`}
                                >
                                  {v.sisaHari < 0 ? 'KADALUWARSA' : `${v.sisaHari} Hari (FEFO)`}
                                </span>
                              )}
                            </td>
                            <td className="py-4 px-6 text-center">
                              <span
                                className={`inline-block px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-bold rounded-full ${
                                  v.statusStok === 'HABIS_TERGANTIKAN'
                                    ? 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 border border-slate-300'
                                    : v.statusStok === 'HABIS'
                                    ? 'bg-rose-100 text-rose-800 border border-rose-200'
                                    : v.statusStok === 'KRITIS'
                                    ? 'bg-orange-100 text-orange-800 border border-orange-200'
                                    : 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 border border-emerald-200'
                                }`}
                              >
                                {v.statusStok === 'HABIS_TERGANTIKAN' ? 'HABIS (Ada Batch Baru)' : v.statusStok}
                              </span>
                            </td>
                          </tr>
                        ))}
                      </tbody>
                    </table>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* TAB 3: KATALOG FORMULARIUM & BMHP DAERAH */}
      {activeTab === 'katalog' && (
        <div className="space-y-4">
          {/* Search & Filter Kategori */}
          <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-3 bg-white p-4 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-xs">
            <div className="w-full sm:w-1/2 flex items-center gap-3">
              <Search className="w-5 h-5 text-slate-400" />
              <input
                type="text"
                value={searchKatalog}
                onChange={(e) => setSearchKatalog(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Cari nama barang, kode, atau sediaan..."
                className="w-full text-sm text-slate-800 outline-none bg-transparent"
              />
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 self-start sm:self-auto">
              <button
                onClick={() => setKategoriFilterKatalog('semua')}
                className={`px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold rounded-lg transition-all ${
                  kategoriFilterKatalog === 'semua'
                    ? 'bg-slate-900 text-white shadow-xs'
                    : 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-200'
                }`}
              >
                Semua ({masterList.length})
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={() => setKategoriFilterKatalog('obat')}
                className={`px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold rounded-lg transition-all flex items-center gap-1.5 ${
                  kategoriFilterKatalog === 'obat'
                    ? 'bg-blue-700 text-white shadow-xs'
                    : 'bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 hover:bg-blue-100'
                }`}
              >
                <Pill className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                Obat ({masterList.filter(m => m.kategori !== 'BMHP').length})
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={() => setKategoriFilterKatalog('bmhp')}
                className={`px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold rounded-lg transition-all flex items-center gap-1.5 ${
                  kategoriFilterKatalog === 'bmhp'
                    ? 'bg-purple-700 text-white shadow-xs'
                    : 'bg-purple-50 text-purple-700 hover:bg-purple-100'
                }`}
              >
                <Syringe className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                BMHP ({masterList.filter(m => m.kategori === 'BMHP').length})
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-xs overflow-hidden">
            <div className="p-5 border-b border-slate-200 flex items-center justify-between">
              <div>
                <h3 className="font-bold text-slate-900 text-base">
                  Seluruh Formularium Master Obat &amp; BMHP Daerah ({filteredMaster.length})
                </h3>
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">
                  Data master obat dan bahan medis habis pakai yang disinkronisasi ke seluruh Puskesmas se-Kabupaten.
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="overflow-x-auto">
              <table className="w-full text-left text-sm border-collapse">
                <thead>
                  <tr className="bg-slate-50 border-b border-slate-200 text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider">
                    <th className="py-3 px-6">Tipe Barang</th>
                    <th className="py-3 px-4">Kode Barang</th>
                    <th className="py-3 px-4">Nama Item &amp; Spesifikasi</th>
                    <th className="py-3 px-4">Kategori Sistem</th>
                    <th className="py-3 px-4">Bentuk Kemasan</th>
                    <th className="py-3 px-4 text-right">Harga Standar (Rp)</th>
                    <th className="py-3 px-6 text-center">Status Katalog</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100">
                  {loading ? (
                    <tr>
                      <td colSpan={7} className="py-12 text-center text-slate-400">
                        <RefreshCw className="w-6 h-6 animate-spin mx-auto mb-2 text-emerald-600" />
                        Memuat master data...
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ) : filteredMaster.length === 0 ? (
                    <tr>
                      <td colSpan={7} className="py-12 text-center text-slate-400">
                        Tidak ada data yang sesuai dengan kata kunci pencarian.
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ) : (
                    filteredMaster.map((item) => {
                      const isBmhp = item.kategori === 'BMHP';
                      return (
                        <tr key={item.id} className="hover:bg-slate-50/80 transition-colors">
                          <td className="py-4 px-6">
                            <span
                              className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-bold rounded-full ${
                                isBmhp
                                  ? 'bg-purple-100 text-purple-800 border border-purple-200'
                                  : 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-800 border border-blue-200'
                              }`}
                            >
                              {isBmhp ? <Syringe className="w-3 h-3" /> : <Pill className="w-3 h-3" />}
                              {isBmhp ? 'BMHP' : 'OBAT'}
                            </span>
                          </td>
                          <td className="py-4 px-4 font-mono font-bold text-slate-900">
                            {item.kodeObat}
                          </td>
                          <td className="py-4 px-4 font-semibold text-slate-800">
                            {item.namaObat}
                          </td>
                          <td className="py-4 px-4 text-slate-600 text-xs">
                            {item.kategori || 'Obat Bebas'}
                          </td>
                          <td className="py-4 px-4 text-slate-600">
                            {item.sediaan || 'Pcs'}
                          </td>
                          <td className="py-4 px-4 text-right font-mono font-semibold text-slate-800">
                            {item.harga ? Number(item.harga).toLocaleString('id-ID') : '-'}
                          </td>
                          <td className="py-4 px-6 text-center">
                            <span className="inline-block px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-bold rounded-full bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 border border-emerald-200">
                              Aktif Terdaftar
                            </span>
                          </td>
                        </tr>
                      );
                    })
                  )}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { 
  Building2, 
  Users, 
  Activity, 
  BedDouble, 
  AlertTriangle, 
  Pill,

  Sparkles
} from 'lucide-react';
import { dinkesService, DinkesSummary, FaskesWorkload } from '../../../services/dinkes.service';

export default function DinkesDashboardPage() {
  const [summary, setSummary] = useState<DinkesSummary | null>(null);
  const [workloads, setWorkloads] = useState<FaskesWorkload[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const fetchData = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const [sumData, workloadData] = await Promise.all([
        dinkesService.getExecutiveSummary(),
        dinkesService.getWorkloadAnalytics()
      ]);
      setSummary(sumData);
      setWorkloads(workloadData?.list || []);
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error("Gagal memuat analitik Dinkes:", err);
      setError(err?.response?.data?.message || err?.message || "Gagal menghubungi server analitik");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchData();
  }, []);

  return (
    <div className="p-6 lg:p-8 space-y-8 bg-slate-50 min-h-screen">
      {/* Header Section */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between gap-4 bg-white p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-xs">

            <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-bold bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 rounded-full uppercase tracking-wider">
              Pusat Komando Wilayah
            </span>
            <span className="text-xs text-slate-400">• Realtime Sync</span>
          </div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl lg:text-3xl font-black text-slate-900 tracking-tight">
            Dashboard Eksekutif Dinas Kesehatan
          </h1>
          <p className="text-slate-500 text-sm mt-1">
            Monitoring lalu lintas pasien, rasio beban tenaga medis, ketersediaan tempat tidur, dan logistik se-Kabupaten.
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <button
            onClick={fetchData}
            disabled={loading}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2.5 bg-white border border-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-50 text-slate-700 text-sm font-semibold rounded-lg shadow-xs transition-colors disabled:opacity-60"
          >
            <RefreshCw className={`w-4 h-4 ${loading ? 'animate-spin text-emerald-600' : ''}`} />
            Perbarui Data
          </button>
          <Link
            href="/dinkes/ai-briefing"
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2.5 bg-gradient-to-r from-amber-500 to-amber-600 hover:from-amber-400 hover:to-amber-500 text-white text-sm font-bold rounded-lg shadow-sm transition-all"
            title="Laporan Situasi Eksekutif & Briefing Cerdas AI"
          >
            <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4 text-white" />
            AI Executive Briefing
          </Link>
          <Link
            href="/dinkes/workload"
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2.5 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white text-sm font-semibold rounded-lg shadow-xs transition-colors"
          >
            Analisis Mutasi Nakes
            <ArrowRight className="w-4 h-4" />
          </Link>
        </div>
      </div>

      {error && (
        <div className="p-4 bg-red-50 border-l-4 border-red-500 rounded-r-xl flex items-center justify-between">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <AlertTriangle className="w-5 h-5 text-red-600" />
            <p className="text-sm font-medium text-red-800">{error}</p>
          </div>
          <button onClick={fetchData} className="text-xs font-bold text-red-700 underline hover:text-red-900">
            Coba Lagi
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-slate-400 mb-3">
            <span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500">Total Faskes</span>
            <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-lg bg-blue-50 text-blue-600 flex items-center justify-center">
              <Building2 className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="text-2xl font-black text-slate-900">
            {loading ? '...' : (summary?.totalFaskes ?? 0)}
          </div>

        </div>

      {/* Main Analysis Section: Traffic Pasien & Beban Nakes per Faskes */}
      <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-xs overflow-hidden">

                  </td>
                </tr>
              ) : (

                  const isKritis = item.bebanKerjaStatus === 'KRITIS_TINGGI' || item.bebanKerjaStatus === 'TINGGI';
                  return (
                    <tr key={item.faskesId} className="hover:bg-slate-50/80 transition-colors">

                          <Building2 className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400" />
                          <span>{item.namaFaskes}</span>
                        </div>
                        <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 uppercase font-mono block pl-6">
                          {item.tipeFaskes}
                        </span>
                      </td>

                      </td>

                          <Stethoscope className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-blue-500" />
                          <span>{item.totalDokter}</span>

                      </td>
                      <td className="py-4 px-4 text-center font-mono font-bold text-slate-900">
                        {item.rasioPasienPerDokter} : 1
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-4 px-4 text-center">
                        <span
                          className={`inline-block px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-bold rounded-full ${
                            item.bebanKerjaStatus === 'KRITIS_TINGGI'
                              ? 'bg-rose-100 text-rose-800 border border-rose-200'
                              : item.bebanKerjaStatus === 'TINGGI'
                              ? 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 border border-amber-200'
                              : item.bebanKerjaStatus === 'NORMAL'
                              ? 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 border border-emerald-200'
                              : 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-800 border border-blue-200'

} from 'lucide-react';
import { dinkesService, FaskesWorkload, FaskesItem } from '../../../../services/dinkes.service';

export default function DinkesWorkloadPage() {
  const [workloads, setWorkloads] = useState<FaskesWorkload[]>([]);
  const [faskesList, setFaskesList] = useState<FaskesItem[]>([]);
  const [mutasiHistory, setMutasiHistory] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'analisis' | 'riwayat'>('analisis');

  // Modal State
  const [showMutasiModal, setShowMutasiModal] = useState(false);
  const [submittingMutasi, setSubmittingMutasi] = useState(false);
  const [mutasiForm, setMutasiForm] = useState({
    tenagaMedisId: '',
    faskesAsalId: '',
    faskesTujuanId: '',
    alasanMutasi: '',
    nomorSkDinkes: ''
  });

  const fetchData = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const [wlData, fData, mHistory] = await Promise.all([
        dinkesService.getWorkloadAnalytics(),
        dinkesService.getFaskesList(),
        dinkesService.getMutasiHistory()
      ]);
      setWorkloads(Array.isArray(wlData?.list) ? wlData.list : []);
      setFaskesList(Array.isArray(fData) ? fData : []);
      setMutasiHistory(Array.isArray(mHistory) ? mHistory : []);
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error("Gagal memuat analitik beban kerja:", err);
      setWorkloads([]);
      setFaskesList([]);
      setMutasiHistory([]);
      Swal.fire({
        icon: 'error',
        title: 'Gagal Memuat Data',
        text: err?.response?.data?.message || err?.message || 'Terjadi kesalahan sistem'
      });
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchData();
  }, []);

  const wlList = Array.isArray(workloads) ? workloads : [];
  const fList = Array.isArray(faskesList) ? faskesList : [];
  const mList = Array.isArray(mutasiHistory) ? mutasiHistory : [];

  const openMutasiForFaskes = (targetFaskesId: string) => {
    setMutasiForm({
      tenagaMedisId: '',
      faskesAsalId: '',
      faskesTujuanId: targetFaskesId,
      alasanMutasi: 'Pemerataan beban kerja nakes karena lonjakan traffic pasien faskes penerima.',
      nomorSkDinkes: `SK-DINKES/${new Date().getFullYear()}/${Math.floor(1000 + Math.random() * 9000)}`
    });
    setShowMutasiModal(true);
  };

  const handleSubmitMutasi = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!mutasiForm.faskesTujuanId) {
      Swal.fire('Validasi Gagal', 'Pilih faskes tujuan mutasi.', 'warning');
      return;
    }

    setSubmittingMutasi(true);
    try {
      await dinkesService.createMutasiNakes({
        tenagaMedisId: mutasiForm.tenagaMedisId || 'cm00nakes0001dummy',
        faskesAsalId: mutasiForm.faskesAsalId,
        faskesTujuanId: mutasiForm.faskesTujuanId,
        alasanMutasi: mutasiForm.alasanMutasi,
        nomorSkDinkes: mutasiForm.nomorSkDinkes
      });

      Swal.fire({
        icon: 'success',
        title: 'Mutasi Berhasil Diterbitkan',
        text: 'SK Mutasi Dinas Kesehatan telah tercatat dan tenaga medis telah dialokasikan.',
      });
      setShowMutasiModal(false);
      fetchData();
    } catch (err: any) {
      Swal.fire({
        icon: 'error',
        title: 'Gagal Memproses Mutasi',
        text: err?.response?.data?.message || err?.message || 'Terjadi kesalahan'
      });
    } finally {
      setSubmittingMutasi(false);
    }

            <ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4 mr-1" /> Kembali ke Dashboard Dinkes
          </Link>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-black text-slate-900 tracking-tight flex items-center gap-2">
            <Activity className="w-7 h-7 text-emerald-600" />

          >

          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => setShowMutasiModal(true)}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white text-sm font-semibold rounded-lg shadow-xs transition-colors"
          >
            <ArrowLeftRight className="w-4 h-4" />
            Terbitkan SK Mutasi Nakes

        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Tabs */}
      <div className="flex border-b border-slate-200 gap-4">

  const { user, logout } = useAuthStore();
  const router = useRouter();
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [dokterRekap, setDokterRekap] = useState<RekapDokterItem | null>(null);
  const [todayPresensi, setTodayPresensi] = useState<any>(null);
  const [masterTarif, setMasterTarif] = useState<MasterTarifFee | null>(null);
  const [selectedShift, setSelectedShift] = useState<string>('PAGI');
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'pasien' | 'kehadiran'>('pasien');
  const [selectedBulan, setSelectedBulan] = useState<number>(new Date().getMonth() + 1);
  const [selectedTahun, setSelectedTahun] = useState<number>(new Date().getFullYear());

  const printSlipRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const handlePrint = useReactToPrint({
    contentRef: printSlipRef,
    documentTitle: `Slip_Fee_Dokter_${user?.username || 'Dokter'}`,
  });

  const fetchData = async () => {
    if (!user?.id) return;
    setIsLoading(true);
    try {
      const formatYMD = (d: Date) => {
        const year = d.getFullYear();
        const month = String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
        const day = String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
        return `${year}-${month}-${day}`;
      };

      const startOfMonth = new Date(selectedTahun, selectedBulan - 1, 1);
      const endOfMonth = new Date(selectedTahun, selectedBulan, 0);
      const awal = formatYMD(startOfMonth);
      const akhir = formatYMD(endOfMonth);

      const [rekapRes, todayRes, tarifRes] = await Promise.all([
        remunerasiService.getRekapDokter({
          tanggalAwal: awal,
          tanggalAkhir: akhir,
          dokterId: String(user.id),
        }),
        remunerasiService.getTodayPresensi(),
        remunerasiService.getMasterTarif(),
      ]);

      if (rekapRes?.dokterList && rekapRes.dokterList.length > 0) {
        const myRekap = rekapRes.dokterList.find((d: any) => d.dokter.id === user.id) || rekapRes.dokterList[0];
        setDokterRekap(myRekap);
      }
      setTodayPresensi(todayRes);
      setMasterTarif(tarifRes);
    } catch (err: any) {
      if (err?.response?.status === 401) {
        console.warn('Sesi login telah kedaluwarsa atau tidak valid.');
        Swal.fire({
          icon: 'warning',
          title: 'Sesi Telah Berakhir',
          text: 'Sesi login Anda telah berakhir. Silakan login kembali untuk melanjutkan.',
          confirmButtonText: 'Login Ulang',
        }).then(() => {
          logout();
          router.push('/login');
        });
        return;
      }
      console.error('Error fetching doctor fee data:', err);
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (user?.id) {
      fetchData();
    }
  }, [user?.id, selectedBulan, selectedTahun]);

  const handleClockIn = async () => {
    try {
      await remunerasiService.checkInMandiri({ shift: selectedShift });
      Swal.fire({
        icon: 'success',
        title: 'Presensi Shift Berhasil!',
        text: `Kehadiran shift ${selectedShift} berhasil dicatat. Fee kehadiran telah ditambahkan ke akun Anda.`,
      });
      fetchData();
    } catch (err: any) {
      Swal.fire('Gagal', err?.response?.data?.message || 'Gagal melakukan presensi', 'error');
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="p-4 sm:p-6 lg:p-8 space-y-6 max-w-6xl mx-auto">
      {/* Banner Dokter */}
      <div className="bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-700 to-indigo-800 p-6 rounded-2xl text-white shadow-xl flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center space-x-2 text-blue-200 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">
            <Stethoscope className="w-4 h-4" />
            <span>Portal Remunerasi Dokter Spesialis & Umum</span>
          </div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-black">
            Doctor Fee & Jaspel Saya
          </h1>
          <p className="text-blue-100 text-xs sm:text-sm mt-1">
            dr. {user?.namaLengkap || user?.username} • Unit: {user?.poliklinik?.namaPoli || 'Poli Umum / Rawat Jalan'}
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Action Clock-in Button */}
        <div className="bg-white/10 backdrop-blur-md p-3 rounded-xl border border-white/20 flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center gap-2">
          <div className="text-xs text-blue-100 flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
            {todayPresensi?.hasCheckedIn ? (
              <span className="flex items-center text-emerald-300 font-bold">
                <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 mr-1" />
                Presensi Hari Ini:
              </span>
            ) : (
              <span>Presensi Kehadiran Shift Hari Ini:</span>
            )}
            {todayPresensi?.presensi?.map((p: any) => (
              <span key={p.shift} className="bg-emerald-500/30 text-emerald-200 border border-emerald-400/40 px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-bold">
                Shift {p.shift}
              </span>
            ))}
          </div>
          {(() => {
            const checkedShifts = (todayPresensi?.presensi || []).map((p: any) => p.shift);
            const availableShifts = ['PAGI', 'SIANG', 'MALAM'].filter((s: string) => !checkedShifts.includes(s));
            if (availableShifts.length === 0) return null;
            return (
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 w-full sm:w-auto">
                <select
                  value={selectedShift}
                  onChange={(e) => setSelectedShift(e.target.value)}
                  className="bg-blue-900/60 text-white text-xs font-bold rounded-lg px-2.5 py-2 border border-blue-400 focus:outline-none"
                >
                  {availableShifts.map((s: string) => (
                    <option key={s} value={s} className="bg-gray-800 text-white">Shift {s}</option>
                  ))}
                </select>
                <button
                  onClick={handleClockIn}
                  className="px-4 py-2 bg-emerald-500 hover:bg-emerald-600 text-white rounded-lg text-xs font-bold shadow transition-all active:scale-95 whitespace-nowrap"
                >
                  Clock-In
                </button>
              </div>
            );
          })()}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Filter Periode Bulan */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 bg-white px-5 py-3.5 rounded-2xl border border-gray-200 shadow-sm">
        <div className="flex items-center space-x-2 text-xs font-bold text-gray-700">
          <Calendar className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-600" />
          <span>Periode Laporan Akumulasi:</span>
          <span className="text-blue-700 bg-blue-50 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full border border-blue-200">
            {DAFTAR_BULAN[selectedBulan - 1]} {selectedTahun}
          </span>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
          <select
            value={selectedBulan}
            onChange={(e) => setSelectedBulan(Number(e.target.value))}
            className="text-xs font-bold bg-gray-50 border border-gray-300 rounded-xl px-3 py-1.5 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500"
          >
            {DAFTAR_BULAN.map((b, idx) => (
              <option key={idx} value={idx + 1}>{b}</option>
            ))}
          </select>
          <select
            value={selectedTahun}
            onChange={(e) => setSelectedTahun(Number(e.target.value))}
            className="text-xs font-bold bg-gray-50 border border-gray-300 rounded-xl px-3 py-1.5 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500"
          >
            {[2025, 2026, 2027].map((y) => (
              <option key={y} value={y}>{y}</option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* KPI Cards */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
        <div className="bg-white p-5 rounded-2xl border border-gray-100 shadow-sm">
          <div className="text-xs text-gray-500 uppercase font-semibold">Total Fee Bulan Ini (Akumulasi)</div>
          <div className="text-2xl font-black text-blue-900 mt-1">
            Rp {(dokterRekap?.rekap.totalFeeKumulatif || 0).toLocaleString('id-ID')}
          </div>
          <div className="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-1">
            Pending: Rp {(dokterRekap?.rekap.totalBelumDibayar || 0).toLocaleString('id-ID')}
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-white p-5 rounded-2xl border border-gray-100 shadow-sm">
          <div className="text-xs text-blue-600 uppercase font-semibold flex items-center justify-between">
            <span>Fee Kehadiran</span>
            <span className="text-[10px] bg-blue-100 text-blue-800 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded font-bold">Akumulasi Bulan Ini</span>
          </div>
          <div className="text-xs text-blue-600 uppercase font-semibold hidden">
            Fee Kehadiran ({dokterRekap?.kehadiran.totalHadir || 0} Shift)
          </div>
          <div className="text-2xl font-black text-gray-900 mt-1">
            Rp {(dokterRekap?.rekap.totalFeeKehadiran || 0).toLocaleString('id-ID')}
          </div>
          <div className="text-xs text-gray-400 mt-1">
            Rp {(masterTarif?.feeKehadiranDokter || 150000).toLocaleString('id-ID')} / shift
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-white p-5 rounded-2xl border border-gray-100 shadow-sm">
          <div className="text-xs text-purple-600 uppercase font-semibold">
            Fee Penanganan ({dokterRekap?.penangananPasien.totalPasien || 0} Pasien)
          </div>
          <div className="text-2xl font-black text-purple-900 mt-1">
            Rp {(dokterRekap?.rekap.totalFeePenanganan || 0).toLocaleString('id-ID')}
          </div>
          <div className="text-xs text-gray-400 mt-1">
            Rp {(masterTarif?.feePerPasienDokter || 15000).toLocaleString('id-ID')} / pasien selesai
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Tabel Pasien yang Ditangani */}
      <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-gray-200 shadow-sm overflow-hidden">
        <div className="px-6 py-4 border-b border-gray-100 flex items-center justify-between">
          <h2 className="text-base font-bold text-gray-900 flex items-center">
            <Activity className="w-5 h-5 text-purple-600 mr-2" />
            Riwayat Penanganan Pasien Saya
          </h2>
          <button
            onClick={() => handlePrint()}
            className="flex items-center px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-gray-700 bg-gray-50 hover:bg-gray-100 border border-gray-200 rounded-lg transition-all"
          >
            <Printer className="w-3.5 h-3.5 mr-1.5" />
            Cetak Slip Fee Saya
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="overflow-x-auto">
          <table className="w-full text-left text-sm text-gray-600">
            <thead className="bg-gray-50 text-xs uppercase font-bold text-gray-500 border-b border-gray-200">
              <tr>
                <th className="px-6 py-3">Waktu Pelayanan</th>
                <th className="px-6 py-3">Nama Pasien</th>
                <th className="px-6 py-3">No RM</th>
                <th className="px-6 py-3">Jenis Layanan</th>
                <th className="px-6 py-3 text-right">Fee Penanganan</th>
                <th className="px-6 py-3 text-center">Status Pembayaran</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody className="divide-y divide-gray-100">
              {isLoading ? (
                <tr>
                  <td colSpan={6} className="text-center py-8 text-gray-400">
                    Memuat data pemeriksaan...
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ) : !dokterRekap || dokterRekap.penangananPasien.daftarPasien.length === 0 ? (
