'use client';

import React, { useState, useRef, useEffect, Dispatch, SetStateAction } from 'react';
import { 
  Camera, 
  Upload, 
  Trash2, 
  ZoomIn, 
  RefreshCw, 
  Check, 
  X, 
  AlertCircle, 
  Loader2, 
  SwitchCamera,
  Maximize2,
  Calendar,
  Image as ImageIcon
} from 'lucide-react';
import { SOAPPayload, FotoObjektifItem } from '@/types/rawatJalan.types';
import { rawatJalanService } from '@/services/rawatJalan.service';
import { getFileUrl } from '@/lib/fileUrl';

interface FotoObjektifSectionProps {
  soapData: SOAPPayload;
  setSoapData: Dispatch<SetStateAction<SOAPPayload>>;
}

export default function FotoObjektifSection({ soapData, setSoapData }: FotoObjektifSectionProps) {
  const fotoList: FotoObjektifItem[] = Array.isArray(soapData.fotoObjektif) ? soapData.fotoObjektif : [];

  // File upload state
  const [isUploading, setIsUploading] = useState(false);
  const [uploadError, setUploadError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement | null>(null);

  // Camera modal state
  const [isCameraOpen, setIsCameraOpen] = useState(false);
  const [cameraStream, setCameraStream] = useState<MediaStream | null>(null);
  const [capturedImage, setCapturedImage] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [capturedKeterangan, setCapturedKeterangan] = useState('');
  const [cameraFacing, setCameraFacing] = useState<'user' | 'environment'>('environment');
  const [isSavingCamera, setIsSavingCamera] = useState(false);
  const [cameraError, setCameraError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const videoRef = useRef<HTMLVideoElement | null>(null);

  // Zoom lightbox state
  const [previewFoto, setPreviewFoto] = useState<FotoObjektifItem | null>(null);

  // Stop camera stream safely
  const stopCameraStream = () => {
    if (cameraStream) {
      cameraStream.getTracks().forEach((track) => track.stop());
      setCameraStream(null);
    }
  };

  // Start camera
  const startCamera = async (facing: 'user' | 'environment') => {
    stopCameraStream();
    setCameraError(null);
    try {
      if (!navigator.mediaDevices || !navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia) {
        throw new Error('Kamera tidak didukung oleh browser ini.');
      }

      const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
        video: {
          facingMode: facing,
          width: { ideal: 1280 },
          height: { ideal: 720 },
        },
        audio: false,
      });

      setCameraStream(stream);
      if (videoRef.current) {
        videoRef.current.srcObject = stream;
        videoRef.current.play().catch(() => {});
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error('Camera error:', err);
      // Fallback: coba mode kamera tanpa facingMode spesifik
      try {
        const fallbackStream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ video: true, audio: false });
        setCameraStream(fallbackStream);
        if (videoRef.current) {
          videoRef.current.srcObject = fallbackStream;
          videoRef.current.play().catch(() => {});
        }
      } catch (fallbackErr: any) {
        setCameraError(err.message || 'Gagal mengakses perangkat kamera. Pastikan izin kamera aktif.');
      }
    }
  };

  // Open camera modal
  const handleOpenCameraModal = () => {
    setCapturedImage(null);
    setCapturedKeterangan('');
    setCameraError(null);
    setIsCameraOpen(true);
    startCamera(cameraFacing);
  };

  // Close camera modal
  const handleCloseCameraModal = () => {
    stopCameraStream();
    setIsCameraOpen(false);
    setCapturedImage(null);
    setCapturedKeterangan('');
    setCameraError(null);
  };

  // Toggle switch camera
  const handleSwitchCamera = () => {
    const nextFacing = cameraFacing === 'user' ? 'environment' : 'user';
    setCameraFacing(nextFacing);
    startCamera(nextFacing);
  };

  // Capture snapshot from video feed
  const handleCaptureSnapshot = () => {
    if (!videoRef.current) return;
    const video = videoRef.current;
    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    canvas.width = video.videoWidth || 1280;
    canvas.height = video.videoHeight || 720;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    if (ctx) {
      ctx.drawImage(video, 0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
      const dataUrl = canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.88);
      setCapturedImage(dataUrl);
      stopCameraStream();
    }
  };

  // Retake photo
  const handleRetake = () => {
    setCapturedImage(null);
    startCamera(cameraFacing);
  };

  // Save captured photo to server & soapData
  const handleSaveCapturedPhoto = async () => {
    if (!capturedImage) return;
    setIsSavingCamera(true);
    setCameraError(null);
    try {
      const res = await rawatJalanService.uploadFotoKlinis({
        base64Image: capturedImage,
        namaFile: `Foto Klinis ${new Date().toLocaleTimeString('id-ID')}`,
        keterangan: capturedKeterangan.trim(),
      });

      if (res.success && res.data && res.data.length > 0) {
        const savedItems: FotoObjektifItem[] = res.data.map((item: any) => ({
          ...item,
          keterangan: capturedKeterangan.trim() || item.keterangan || '',
        }));

        setSoapData((prev) => ({
          ...prev,
          fotoObjektif: [...(prev.fotoObjektif || []), ...savedItems],
        }));

        handleCloseCameraModal();
      } else {
        throw new Error(res.message || 'Gagal menyimpan foto');
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error('Error saving captured photo:', err);
      setCameraError(err.message || 'Gagal mengunggah foto ke server');
    } finally {
      setIsSavingCamera(false);
    }
  };

  // Handle file upload input change (multiple)
  const handleFileChange = async (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const files = e.target.files;
    if (!files || files.length === 0) return;

    setIsUploading(true);
    setUploadError(null);

    try {
      const formData = new FormData();
      for (let i = 0; i < files.length; i++) {
        formData.append('fotos', files[i]);
      }

      const res = await rawatJalanService.uploadFotoKlinis(formData);
      if (res.success && res.data && res.data.length > 0) {
        setSoapData((prev) => ({
          ...prev,
          fotoObjektif: [...(prev.fotoObjektif || []), ...res.data],
        }));
      } else {
        throw new Error(res.message || 'Gagal mengunggah foto');
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error('Upload error:', err);
      setUploadError(err.message || 'Gagal mengunggah foto. Pastikan ukuran file tidak melebihi 10MB.');
    } finally {
      setIsUploading(false);
      if (fileInputRef.current) {
        fileInputRef.current.value = '';
      }
    }
  };

  // Update keterangan foto klinis
  const handleUpdateKeterangan = (index: number, newKeterangan: string) => {
    setSoapData((prev) => {
      const current = [...(prev.fotoObjektif || [])];
      if (current[index]) {
        current[index] = { ...current[index], keterangan: newKeterangan };
      }
      return { ...prev, fotoObjektif: current };
    });
  };

  // Delete foto
  const handleDeleteFoto = (index: number) => {
    if (confirm('Hapus foto klinis ini dari rekam medis pemeriksaan saat ini?')) {
      setSoapData((prev) => {
        const current = [...(prev.fotoObjektif || [])];
        current.splice(index, 1);
        return { ...prev, fotoObjektif: current };
      });
    }
  };

  // Cleanup camera stream on unmount
  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      stopCameraStream();
    };
  }, []);

  return (
    <div className="bg-emerald-50/40 p-5 border border-emerald-200 space-y-4">
      {/* HEADER SECTION */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 border-b border-emerald-200 pb-3">
        <div>
          <h4 className="text-sm font-bold text-emerald-950 flex items-center gap-2">
            <Camera className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600" />
            Dokumentasi Foto Objektif / Klinis (Luka & Lesi Pasien)
          </h4>
          <p className="text-xs text-emerald-800 mt-0.5">
            Ambil atau unggah foto kondisi fisik pasien (luka, jahitan, fraktur, lesi kulit). Foto ini akan tersimpan permanen di RME untuk rujukan dan kolaborasi antar dokter.
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* ACTION BUTTONS */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          {/* Hidden File Input */}
          <input
            type="file"
            ref={fileInputRef}
            onChange={handleFileChange}
            accept="image/*"
            multiple
            className="hidden"
          />

          {/* Upload File Button */}
          <button
            type="button"
            disabled={isUploading}
            onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 bg-white hover:bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800 border border-emerald-300 text-xs font-bold shadow-sm transition-colors disabled:opacity-50"
          >
            {isUploading ? (
              <>
                <Loader2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin text-emerald-600" />
                <span>Mengunggah...</span>
              </>
            ) : (
              <>
                <Upload className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600" />
                <span>Unggah Foto</span>
              </>
            )}
          </button>

          {/* Ambil Kamera Button */}
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleOpenCameraModal}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white text-xs font-bold shadow-sm transition-colors"
          >
            <Camera className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>Ambil Foto (Kamera)</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* ERROR MESSAGE IF ANY */}
      {uploadError && (
        <div className="p-3 bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 text-rose-800 text-xs flex items-center justify-between">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-rose-600 shrink-0" />
            <span>{uploadError}</span>
          </div>
          <button onClick={() => setUploadError(null)} className="text-rose-500 hover:text-rose-700 font-bold">
            <X className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* PHOTO GALLERY LIST */}
      {fotoList.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="border border-dashed border-emerald-300 bg-white/60 p-6 text-center">
          <div className="inline-flex items-center justify-center w-12 h-12 rounded-full bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 mb-2">
            <Camera className="w-6 h-6" />
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-700">Belum ada foto objektif/klinis yang ditambahkan</p>
          <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 max-w-md mx-auto mt-1">
            Klik tombol <span className="font-semibold text-emerald-800">Unggah Foto</span> untuk memilih foto dari perangkat atau <span className="font-semibold text-emerald-800">Ambil Foto (Kamera)</span> untuk memotret langsung dengan webcam/kamera HP.
          </p>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
          {fotoList.map((foto, index) => {
            const fullUrl = getFileUrl(foto.url);
            return (
              <div
                key={foto.id || foto.url || index}
                className="bg-white border border-slate-300 shadow-sm flex flex-col justify-between overflow-hidden group hover:border-emerald-500 transition-colors"
              >
                {/* Image Thumbnail with Overlay */}
                <div className="relative aspect-[4/3] bg-slate-900/5 overflow-hidden flex items-center justify-center">
                  <img
                    src={fullUrl}
                    alt={foto.keterangan || foto.namaFile || `Foto ${index + 1}`}
                    className="w-full h-full object-cover group-hover:scale-105 transition-transform duration-200"
                    onError={(e) => {
                      const target = e.currentTarget;
                      target.style.display = 'none';
                      if (target.nextElementSibling) {
                        (target.nextElementSibling as HTMLElement).style.display = 'flex';
                      }
                    }}
                  />
                  <div className="hidden absolute inset-0 items-center justify-center bg-slate-100 text-slate-400 text-xs flex-col gap-1">
                    <ImageIcon className="w-6 h-6" />
                    <span>Gambar rusak</span>
                  </div>

                  {/* Badges / Controls Top */}
                  <div className="absolute top-2 left-2 flex items-center gap-1">
                    <span className="bg-slate-900/70 text-white text-[10px] font-bold px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-none font-mono">
                      #{index + 1}
                    </span>
                  </div>

                  {/* Zoom Button Overlay */}
                  <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-black/40 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setPreviewFoto(foto)}
                      className="p-1.5 bg-white text-slate-800 hover:bg-emerald-600 hover:text-white transition-colors shadow-sm"
                      title="Perbesar / Lihat Penuh"
                    >
                      <ZoomIn className="w-4 h-4" />
                    </button>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => handleDeleteFoto(index)}
                      className="p-1.5 bg-white text-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-600 hover:text-white transition-colors shadow-sm"
                      title="Hapus Foto Ini"
                    >
                      <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Caption / Keterangan Edit Area */}
                <div className="p-2.5 bg-white flex-1 flex flex-col justify-between space-y-2">
                  <div>
                    <label className="block text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-600 uppercase mb-1">
                      Keterangan / Catatan Klinis:
                    </label>
                    <textarea
                      rows={2}
                      value={foto.keterangan || ''}
                      onChange={(e) => handleUpdateKeterangan(index, e.target.value)}
                      placeholder="Contoh: Luka robek paha kanan 4cm, tepi rata..."
                      className="w-full text-xs p-1.5 border border-slate-300 focus:outline-none focus:border-emerald-600 text-slate-900 font-medium leading-tight"
                    />
                  </div>

                  <div className="pt-1 border-t border-slate-100 flex items-center justify-between text-[10px] text-slate-400">
                    <span className="truncate max-w-[120px]" title={foto.namaFile}>
                      {foto.namaFile || 'Foto Klinis'}
                    </span>
                    {foto.waktuAmbil && (
                      <span className="font-mono">
                        {new Date(foto.waktuAmbil).toLocaleTimeString('id-ID', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })}
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* CAMERA MODAL VIEW */}
      {isCameraOpen && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[9999] bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-center justify-center p-3 sm:p-6 animate-in fade-in duration-150">
          <div className="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 w-full max-w-2xl overflow-hidden shadow-2xl flex flex-col">
            {/* Modal Header */}
            <div className="p-3.5 bg-slate-950 border-b border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between text-white">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <Camera className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400" />
                <h3 className="text-sm font-bold tracking-wide">
                  {capturedImage ? 'Konfirmasi Foto Klinis' : 'Ambil Foto Klinis Pasien'}
                </h3>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleCloseCameraModal}
                className="p-1 hover:bg-slate-800 text-slate-300 hover:text-white transition-colors"
                title="Tutup Modal"
              >
                <X className="w-5 h-5" />
              </button>
            </div>

            {/* Error in modal if any */}
            {cameraError && (
              <div className="p-3 bg-rose-950/80 border-b border-rose-800 text-rose-200 text-xs flex items-center gap-2">
                <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-rose-400 shrink-0" />
                <span>{cameraError}</span>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Viewfinder or Captured Preview */}
            <div className="relative bg-black aspect-[4/3] max-h-[55vh] flex items-center justify-center overflow-hidden">
              {!capturedImage ? (
                <>
                  <video
                    ref={videoRef}
                    playsInline
                    autoPlay
                    muted
                    className="w-full h-full object-cover"
                  />
                  {/* Grid overlay for medical alignment */}
                  <div className="absolute inset-0 pointer-events-none border border-white/20 grid grid-cols-3 grid-rows-3 opacity-30" />
                  
                  {/* Switch Camera Button (Mobile/Tablet/Webcam) */}
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={handleSwitchCamera}
                    className="absolute top-3 right-3 p-2 bg-slate-900/80 hover:bg-slate-800 text-white rounded-full border border-slate-700 shadow-lg text-xs flex items-center gap-1"
                    title="Ganti Kamera (Depan / Belakang)"
                  >
                    <SwitchCamera className="w-4 h-4" />
                  </button>
                </>
              ) : (
                <img
                  src={capturedImage}
                  alt="Captured"
                  className="w-full h-full object-contain"
                />
              )}
            </div>

            {/* Modal Controls / Footer */}
            <div className="p-4 bg-slate-950 border-t border-slate-800 text-white space-y-3">
              {capturedImage && (
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-emerald-400 uppercase tracking-wide mb-1">
                    Keterangan Foto Klinis (Luka / Kondisi):
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={capturedKeterangan}
                    onChange={(e) => setCapturedKeterangan(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="Contoh: Vulnus laceratum regio antebrachii 5cm, perdarahan aktif..."
                    className="w-full bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-white placeholder:text-slate-500 focus:outline-none focus:border-emerald-500 font-medium"
                    autoFocus
                  />
                </div>
              )}

              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                {!capturedImage ? (
                  <>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={handleCloseCameraModal}
                      className="px-4 py-2 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-200 text-xs font-bold transition-colors"
                    >
                      Batal
                    </button>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={handleCaptureSnapshot}
                      className="px-6 py-2.5 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white text-xs font-black tracking-wide uppercase flex items-center gap-2 shadow-lg transition-transform active:scale-95"
                    >
                      <Camera className="w-4 h-4" />
                      Jepret Foto
                    </button>
                  </>
                ) : (
                  <>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      disabled={isSavingCamera}
                      onClick={handleRetake}
                      className="px-4 py-2 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-200 text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors"
                    >
                      <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      Foto Ulang
                    </button>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      disabled={isSavingCamera}
                      onClick={handleSaveCapturedPhoto}
                      className="px-6 py-2.5 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wide flex items-center gap-2 shadow-lg disabled:opacity-50"
                    >
                      {isSavingCamera ? (
                        <>
                          <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" />
                          <span>Menyimpan...</span>
                        </>
                      ) : (
                        <>
                          <Check className="w-4 h-4" />
                          <span>Simpan Foto Ini</span>
                        </>
                      )}
                    </button>
                  </>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* SINGLE PHOTO LIGHTBOX PREVIEW */}
      {previewFoto && (
        <div
          className="fixed inset-0 z-[9999] bg-black/85 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-center justify-center p-4 sm:p-6 animate-in fade-in duration-150"
          onClick={() => setPreviewFoto(null)}
        >
          <div
            className="relative max-w-4xl w-full bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 shadow-2xl overflow-hidden flex flex-col max-h-[90vh]"
            onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
          >
            <div className="p-3 bg-slate-950 border-b border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between text-white">
              <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-200">
                Detail Foto Klinis ({previewFoto.namaFile || 'Foto Klinis'})
              </span>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setPreviewFoto(null)}
                className="p-1 hover:bg-slate-800 text-slate-300 hover:text-white"
              >
                <X className="w-5 h-5" />
              </button>
            </div>
            <div className="bg-black flex items-center justify-center p-2 min-h-[350px]">
              <img
                src={getFileUrl(previewFoto.url)}
                alt="Preview"
                className="max-h-[65vh] w-auto max-w-full object-contain"
              />
            </div>
            <div className="p-4 bg-slate-950 border-t border-slate-800 text-white">
              <p className="text-xs font-bold text-emerald-400 uppercase mb-1">Keterangan Klinis:</p>
              <p className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-200">
                {previewFoto.keterangan || <span className="text-slate-500 italic">Belum ada keterangan klinis.</span>}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { Camera, ZoomIn, X, ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, Image as ImageIcon, Calendar } from 'lucide-react';
import { FotoObjektifItem } from '@/types/rawatJalan.types';
import { getFileUrl } from '@/lib/fileUrl';

interface FotoObjektifViewerProps {
  fotoList?: FotoObjektifItem[] | null;
  title?: string;
  compact?: boolean;
}

export default function FotoObjektifViewer({
  fotoList,
  title = 'Dokumentasi Foto Objektif / Klinis (Luka/Lesi)',
  compact = false,
}: FotoObjektifViewerProps) {
  const [activePreviewIndex, setActivePreviewIndex] = useState<number | null>(null);

  if (!fotoList || fotoList.length === 0) {
    return null;
  }

  const activePhoto = activePreviewIndex !== null ? fotoList[activePreviewIndex] : null;

  const handleNext = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    if (activePreviewIndex !== null) {
      setActivePreviewIndex((activePreviewIndex + 1) % fotoList.length);
    }
  };

  const handlePrev = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    if (activePreviewIndex !== null) {
      setActivePreviewIndex((activePreviewIndex - 1 + fotoList.length) % fotoList.length);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className={`mt-3 border border-emerald-300 bg-emerald-50/40 ${compact ? 'p-2.5' : 'p-3.5'}`}>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
        <span className="text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-emerald-900 flex items-center gap-1.5">
          <Camera className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600" /> {title}
          <span className="ml-1.5 px-1.5 py-0.2 bg-emerald-200 text-emerald-800 text-[10px] font-bold">
            {fotoList.length} Foto
          </span>
        </span>
      </div>

      <div className={`grid ${compact ? 'grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3' : 'grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 md:grid-cols-4'} gap-2.5`}>
        {fotoList.map((foto, idx) => {
          const fullUrl = getFileUrl(foto.url);
          return (
            <div
              key={foto.id || foto.url || idx}
              onClick={() => setActivePreviewIndex(idx)}
              className="group relative cursor-pointer overflow-hidden border border-slate-300 bg-white shadow-sm hover:border-emerald-500 hover:shadow-md transition-all duration-150"
            >
              {/* Thumbnail Container */}
              <div className="aspect-[4/3] bg-slate-900/5 relative overflow-hidden flex items-center justify-center">
                <img
                  src={fullUrl}
                  alt={foto.keterangan || foto.namaFile || `Foto ${idx + 1}`}
                  className="w-full h-full object-cover group-hover:scale-105 transition-transform duration-200"
                  onError={(e) => {
                    // Fallback jika gagal muat gambar
                    const target = e.currentTarget;
                    target.style.display = 'none';
                    if (target.nextElementSibling) {
                      (target.nextElementSibling as HTMLElement).style.display = 'flex';
                    }
                  }}
                />
                <div className="hidden absolute inset-0 items-center justify-center bg-slate-100 text-slate-400 text-xs flex-col gap-1">
                  <ImageIcon className="w-6 h-6" />
                  <span>Gambar tidak dapat dimuat</span>
                </div>

                {/* Overlay Hover */}
                <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-slate-950/40 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity flex items-center justify-center text-white gap-1 text-xs font-bold">
                  <ZoomIn className="w-4 h-4" />
                  <span>Lihat Detail</span>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Caption & Info */}
              <div className="p-2 bg-white">
                <p className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-800 line-clamp-2 leading-snug">
                  {foto.keterangan ? foto.keterangan : (foto.namaFile || `Foto ${idx + 1}`)}
                </p>
                {foto.waktuAmbil && (
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 flex items-center gap-1 mt-1 font-mono">
                    <Calendar className="w-2.5 h-2.5" />
                    {new Date(foto.waktuAmbil).toLocaleDateString('id-ID', {
                      day: 'numeric',
                      month: 'short',
                      year: 'numeric',
                      hour: '2-digit',
                      minute: '2-digit',
                    })}
                  </span>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      {/* LIGHTBOX MODAL PREVIEW DETAIL */}
      {activePreviewIndex !== null && activePhoto && (
        <div
          className="fixed inset-0 z-[9999] bg-black/85 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-center justify-center p-4 sm:p-6"
          onClick={() => setActivePreviewIndex(null)}
        >
          <div
            className="relative max-w-4xl w-full bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 shadow-2xl overflow-hidden flex flex-col max-h-[90vh]"
            onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
          >
            {/* Header Modal */}
            <div className="p-3 bg-slate-950/90 border-b border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between text-white">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <Camera className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400" />
                <span className="text-xs font-bold tracking-wide">
                  Foto Klinis #{activePreviewIndex + 1} dari {fotoList.length}
                </span>
                {activePhoto.namaFile && (
                  <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 hidden sm:inline">
                    ({activePhoto.namaFile})
                  </span>
                )}
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setActivePreviewIndex(null)}
                className="p-1 hover:bg-slate-800 text-slate-300 hover:text-white transition-colors"
                title="Tutup (Esc)"
              >
                <X className="w-5 h-5" />
              </button>
            </div>

            {/* Gambar Utama */}
            <div className="relative flex-1 bg-black flex items-center justify-center overflow-auto min-h-[350px] p-2">
              <img
                src={getFileUrl(activePhoto.url)}
                alt={activePhoto.keterangan || 'Detail Foto Klinis'}
                className="max-h-[65vh] w-auto max-w-full object-contain select-none"
              />

              {/* Tombol Navigasi Prev/Next */}
              {fotoList.length > 1 && (
                <>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={handlePrev}
                    className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 p-2 bg-slate-900/80 hover:bg-emerald-600 text-white rounded-full shadow-lg border border-slate-700 transition-colors"
                    title="Foto Sebelumnya"
                  >
                    <ChevronLeft className="w-5 h-5" />
                  </button>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={handleNext}
                    className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 p-2 bg-slate-900/80 hover:bg-emerald-600 text-white rounded-full shadow-lg border border-slate-700 transition-colors"
                    title="Foto Berikutnya"
                  >
                    <ChevronRight className="w-5 h-5" />
                  </button>
                </>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* Footer Keterangan Klinis */}
            <div className="p-3.5 bg-slate-950 border-t border-slate-800 text-slate-200">
              <div className="text-xs">

import React, { useRef, useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { FileText, Printer, FileDown, Loader2, AlertTriangle, Calendar, ChevronRight, CheckCircle2, History } from 'lucide-react';
import { CetakHasilLab } from '@/components/laboratorium/CetakHasilLab';
import { useReactToPrint } from 'react-to-print';

interface LabResultModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  isLoading?: boolean;
  orderLabData?: any;
  orderList?: any[]; // Riwayat hasil lab pasien (mendukung hasil menyusul & antar-kunjungan)
  pasienData?: any;  // Fallback data pasien jika order belum menyertakan relasi pasien
  handlePrint?: () => void;
  handleDownloadPdf?: () => void;
  printRef?: React.RefObject<HTMLDivElement | null>;
}

export default function LabResultModal({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  isLoading = false,
  orderLabData,
  orderList = [],
  pasienData,
  handlePrint: propHandlePrint,
  handleDownloadPdf: propHandleDownloadPdf,
  printRef: propPrintRef,
}: LabResultModalProps) {
  const localPrintRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const effectivePrintRef = propPrintRef || localPrintRef;

  const [selectedOrderId, setSelectedOrderId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Initialize selected order: default to orderLabData id or first item in orderList
  useEffect(() => {
    if (orderLabData?.id) {
      setSelectedOrderId(orderLabData.id);
    } else if (orderList && orderList.length > 0) {
      setSelectedOrderId(orderList[0].id);
    } else {
      setSelectedOrderId(null);
    }
  }, [orderLabData, orderList, isOpen]);

  // Determine active data to render with safe enrichment
  const activeOrder = React.useMemo(() => {
    let order: any = null;
    if (orderList && orderList.length > 0) {
      if (selectedOrderId) {
        order = orderList.find((o) => o.id === selectedOrderId) || orderList[0];
      } else {
        order = orderList[0];
      }
    } else {
      order = orderLabData;
    }

    if (!order) return null;

    const resolvedPasien = order.pasien || pasienData || order.kunjungan?.pasien;
    const resolvedDokter = order.dokter || order.kunjungan?.dokterTujuan || { namaLengkap: 'dr. Pemeriksa' };

    return {
      ...order,
      pasien: resolvedPasien,
      dokter: resolvedDokter,
    };
  }, [orderList, selectedOrderId, orderLabData, pasienData]);

  // Self-contained Print
  const internalPrint = useReactToPrint({
    contentRef: effectivePrintRef,
    documentTitle: `Hasil_Lab_${activeOrder?.pasien?.namaLengkap ? String(activeOrder.pasien.namaLengkap).replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '_') : 'Pasien'}_${activeOrder?.id?.slice(-6) || ''}`,
  });

  const onPrint = () => {
    if (propHandlePrint) {
      propHandlePrint();
    } else {
      internalPrint();
    }
  };

  // Self-contained Download PDF
  const onDownloadPdf = async () => {
    if (propHandleDownloadPdf) {
      propHandleDownloadPdf();
      return;
    }
    if (!effectivePrintRef.current) return;
    try {
      const html2pdf = (await import('html2pdf.js')).default;
      const element = effectivePrintRef.current;
      const opt = {
        margin: 0,
        filename: `Hasil_Lab_${activeOrder?.pasien?.namaLengkap ? String(activeOrder.pasien.namaLengkap).replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '_') : 'Pasien'}_${activeOrder?.id?.slice(-6) || ''}.pdf`,
        image: { type: 'jpeg' as const, quality: 0.98 },
        html2canvas: { scale: 2 },
        jsPDF: { unit: 'mm', format: 'a4' as const, orientation: 'portrait' as const }
      };
      html2pdf().set(opt).from(element).save();
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('Failed to generate PDF', e);
    }
  };

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/60 p-2 sm:p-4 animate-in fade-in duration-150">
      <div className="bg-white rounded-none shadow-2xl w-full max-w-6xl overflow-hidden flex flex-col max-h-[96vh] border border-slate-300">
        
        {/* Modal Top Bar */}
        <div className="flex flex-wrap justify-between items-center p-4 sm:p-5 border-b border-indigo-100 bg-indigo-50/80 gap-3">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <div className="w-10 h-10 bg-indigo-600 text-white flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs">
              <FileText className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h3 className="text-lg sm:text-xl font-extrabold text-indigo-950 flex items-center gap-2">
                Lembar Hasil Laboratorium Pasien
              </h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-indigo-700">
                {activeOrder?.pasien?.namaLengkap 
                  ? `Pasien: ${activeOrder.pasien.namaLengkap} (No. RM: ${activeOrder.pasien.noRM || '-'})`
                  : 'Dokumen Rekam Medis Laboratorium Terintegrasi'}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 sm:gap-3 flex-wrap">
            <button 
              onClick={onPrint} 
              disabled={isLoading || !activeOrder}
              className="bg-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-800 disabled:opacity-50 text-white px-3.5 py-2 text-xs sm:text-sm font-bold shadow-sm transition-colors flex items-center gap-2"
              title="Cetak Fisik Hasil Laboratorium"
            >
              <Printer className="w-4 h-4" /> Cetak (Printer)
            </button>
            <button 
              onClick={onDownloadPdf} 
              disabled={isLoading || !activeOrder}
              className="bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 disabled:opacity-50 text-white px-3.5 py-2 text-xs sm:text-sm font-bold shadow-sm transition-colors flex items-center gap-2"
              title="Unduh Berkas PDF Hasil Laboratorium"
            >
              <FileDown className="w-4 h-4" /> Download PDF
            </button>
            <button 
              onClick={onClose} 
              className="text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-700 p-1.5 transition-colors"
            >
              <svg className="w-6 h-6" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth="2" d="M6 18L18 6M6 6l12 12"></path></svg>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Multi-Order Selector (Jika pasien punya lebih dari 1 riwayat hasil lab) */}
        {orderList && orderList.length > 1 && (
          <div className="bg-slate-100 border-b border-slate-200 px-4 py-2.5 flex items-center gap-2 overflow-x-auto text-xs">
            <span className="font-bold text-slate-600 flex items-center gap-1 shrink-0">
              <History className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-indigo-600" /> Pilih Tanggal Order:
            </span>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
              {orderList.map((order, idx) => {
                const isActive = (selectedOrderId === order.id) || (!selectedOrderId && idx === 0);
                let orderDate = '-';
                try {
                  const rawDate = order.tanggalOrder || order.createdAt;
                  if (rawDate) {
                    const parsed = new Date(rawDate);
                    if (!isNaN(parsed.getTime())) {
                      orderDate = parsed.toLocaleDateString('id-ID', {
                        day: '2-digit',
                        month: 'short',
                        year: 'numeric'
                      });
                    }
                  }
                } catch {
                  orderDate = '-';
                }
                const testCount = order.details?.length || 0;
                const poliName = order.kunjungan?.poliklinik?.namaPoli || 'Poli';

                return (
                  <button
                    key={order.id}
                    onClick={() => setSelectedOrderId(order.id)}
                    className={`px-3 py-1.5 font-bold transition-all flex items-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap text-xs border ${
                      isActive 
                        ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white border-indigo-700 shadow-xs' 
                        : 'bg-white text-slate-700 border-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-50'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <span>{orderDate}</span>
                    <span className={`text-[10px] px-1 py-0.2 rounded-xs ${isActive ? 'bg-indigo-800 text-indigo-100' : 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-600'}`}>
                      {poliName} • {testCount} Tes
                    </span>
                  </button>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Modal Body / Paper Sheet */}
        <div className="flex-1 p-4 sm:p-6 overflow-y-auto bg-slate-200 flex justify-center">
          {isLoading ? (
            <div className="py-20 flex flex-col items-center text-gray-500">
              <Loader2 className="w-8 h-8 animate-spin mb-4 text-indigo-600" />
              <p className="font-medium text-sm">Memuat dokumen hasil laboratorium...</p>
            </div>
          ) : activeOrder ? (
            <div className="shadow-2xl overflow-hidden bg-white max-w-full my-auto" style={{ width: '210mm', minHeight: '297mm' }}>
              <CetakHasilLab ref={effectivePrintRef} data={activeOrder} />
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="py-20 flex flex-col items-center text-gray-500 max-w-md text-center">
              <AlertTriangle className="w-12 h-12 mb-4 text-amber-500" />
              <p className="font-bold text-base text-gray-800 mb-1">Belum Ada Hasil Laboratorium</p>
              <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 leading-relaxed">
                Pasien ini belum memiliki order pemeriksaan laboratorium, atau pemeriksaan masih dalam proses di laboratorium / rujukan eksternal.
              </p>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Modal Footer */}
        <div className="p-3 sm:p-4 border-t border-gray-200 bg-white flex justify-between items-center text-xs text-gray-500">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600" />
            <span>Terintegrasi Rekam Medis Elektronik (RME) & Siap Cetak</span>

            className="px-5 py-2 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-900 text-white font-bold transition-colors shadow-xs"

import React from 'react';

export type ToothSurface = 'oklusal' | 'mesial' | 'distal' | 'bukal' | 'lingual';

export interface ToothCondition {
  number: number;
  condition?: string; // 'mis', 'non', 'une', 'abn' dll.
  surfaces?: Record<string, string>;
}

export interface ConditionOption {
  code: string;
  label: string;
  color: string;
  fill: string;
  stroke: string;
  dmf: string | null;
}

export const CONDITION_OPTIONS: ConditionOption[] = [
  { code: 'car', label: 'Karies / Berlubang (car)', color: 'bg-red-500 text-white border-red-600', fill: '#ef4444', stroke: '#b91c1c', dmf: 'D' },
  { code: 'amf', label: 'Tambalan Amalgam (amf)', color: 'bg-indigo-600 text-white border-indigo-700', fill: '#4f46e5', stroke: '#3730a3', dmf: 'F' },
  { code: 'cof', label: 'Tambalan Komposit (cof)', color: 'bg-blue-500 text-white border-blue-600', fill: '#3b82f6', stroke: '#1d4ed8', dmf: 'F' },
  { code: 'gif', label: 'Tambalan GIC (gif)', color: 'bg-cyan-600 text-white border-cyan-700', fill: '#0891b2', stroke: '#0e7490', dmf: 'F' },
  { code: 'rct', label: 'Perawatan Saluran Akar (rct)', color: 'bg-amber-500 text-white border-amber-600', fill: '#f59e0b', stroke: '#b45309', dmf: null },
  { code: 'cfr', label: 'Gigi Patah / Fraktur (cfr)', color: 'bg-orange-500 text-white border-orange-600', fill: '#f97316', stroke: '#c2410c', dmf: 'D' },
  { code: 'une', label: 'Impaksi / Erupsi Tidak Sempurna (une)', color: 'bg-purple-600 text-white border-purple-700', fill: '#9333ea', stroke: '#6b21a8', dmf: null },
  { code: 'non', label: 'Belum Erupsi / Non-Erupted (non)', color: 'bg-slate-500 text-white border-slate-600', fill: '#64748b', stroke: '#475569', dmf: null },
  { code: 'pfs', label: 'Pit & Fissure Sealant (pfs)', color: 'bg-emerald-600 text-white border-emerald-700', fill: '#059669', stroke: '#047857', dmf: null },
  { code: 'crw', label: 'Mahkota / Jaket Crown (crw)', color: 'bg-amber-700 text-white border-amber-800', fill: '#b45309', stroke: '#78350f', dmf: 'F' },
  { code: 'pon', label: 'Gigi Tiruan / Bridge Abutment (pon)', color: 'bg-teal-600 text-white border-teal-700', fill: '#0d9488', stroke: '#0f766e', dmf: null },
  { code: 'rrr', label: 'Sisa Akar / Radix (rrr)', color: 'bg-rose-700 text-white border-rose-800', fill: '#be123c', stroke: '#881337', dmf: 'D' },
];

export const getSurfaceColor = (teethMap: Record<number, ToothCondition>, num: number, surfaceName: ToothSurface) => {
  const tooth = teethMap[num];
  if (!tooth || !tooth.surfaces) return { fill: '#ffffff', stroke: '#000000' };

  const condCode = tooth.surfaces[surfaceName];
  if (!condCode) return { fill: '#ffffff', stroke: '#000000' };

  const opt = CONDITION_OPTIONS.find((c) => c.code === condCode);
  return opt ? { fill: opt.fill, stroke: opt.stroke } : { fill: '#ffffff', stroke: '#000000' };
};

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Activity } from 'lucide-react';
import { ToothCondition, ToothSurface, CONDITION_OPTIONS } from './odontogram.types';
import ToothItem from './ToothItem';
import OdontogramEditorPanel from './OdontogramEditorPanel';
import OralFindingsForm from './OralFindingsForm';

interface OdontogramChartProps {
  value?: Record<number, ToothCondition>;
  onChange?: (odontogram: Record<number, ToothCondition>, dmft: { d: number; m: number; f: number; total: number }) => void;
  oralFindings?: {
    occlusi?: string;
    torusPalatinus?: string;
    torusMandibularis?: string;
    palatum?: string;
    diastema?: string;
    gigiAnomali?: string;
    kondisiLain?: string;
  };
  onOralFindingsChange?: (findings: any) => void;
}

export default function OdontogramChart({
  value = {},
  onChange,
  oralFindings = {},
  onOralFindingsChange,
}: OdontogramChartProps) {
  const [selectedTooth, setSelectedTooth] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [selectedSurface, setSelectedSurface] = useState<ToothSurface | 'all'>('oklusal');
  const [teethMap, setTeethMap] = useState<Record<number, ToothCondition>>(value);
  const [findings, setFindings] = useState(oralFindings);

  // FDI Quadrants Definition
  const q1 = [18, 17, 16, 15, 14, 13, 12, 11];
  const q2 = [21, 22, 23, 24, 25, 26, 27, 28];
  const q5 = [55, 54, 53, 52, 51];
  const q6 = [61, 62, 63, 64, 65];

  const q8 = [85, 84, 83, 82, 81];
  const q7 = [71, 72, 73, 74, 75];
  const q4 = [48, 47, 46, 45, 44, 43, 42, 41];
  const q3 = [31, 32, 33, 34, 35, 36, 37, 38];

  const calculateDmft = (currentMap: Record<number, ToothCondition>) => {
    let d = 0, m = 0, f = 0;
    Object.values(currentMap).forEach((item) => {
      if (item.condition === 'mis') {
        m++;
      } else if (item.surfaces) {
        let hasDecayed = false;
        let hasFilled = false;
        Object.values(item.surfaces).forEach((c) => {
          if (c === 'car' || c === 'cfr') hasDecayed = true;
          if (c === 'amf' || c === 'cof') hasFilled = true;
        });
        if (hasDecayed) d++;
        else if (hasFilled) f++;
      }
    });
    return { d, m, f, total: d + m + f };
  };

  const handleApplySurfaceCondition = (conditionCode: any) => {
    if (!selectedTooth) return;

    const currentTooth = teethMap[selectedTooth] || { number: selectedTooth, surfaces: {} };
    let updatedSurfaces = { ...(currentTooth.surfaces || {}) };

    if (selectedSurface === 'all') {
      updatedSurfaces = {
        oklusal: conditionCode,
        mesial: conditionCode,
        distal: conditionCode,
        bukal: conditionCode,
        lingual: conditionCode,
      };
    } else {
      updatedSurfaces[selectedSurface] = conditionCode;
    }

    const updatedMap = {
      ...teethMap,
      [selectedTooth]: {
        ...currentTooth,
        condition: undefined,
        surfaces: updatedSurfaces,
      },
    };

    setTeethMap(updatedMap);
    const dmft = calculateDmft(updatedMap);
    if (onChange) onChange(updatedMap, dmft);
  };

  const handleMarkMissingTooth = () => {
    if (!selectedTooth) return;
    const updatedMap = {
      ...teethMap,
      [selectedTooth]: {
        number: selectedTooth,
        condition: 'mis',
        surfaces: undefined,
      },
    };
    setTeethMap(updatedMap);
    const dmft = calculateDmft(updatedMap);
    if (onChange) onChange(updatedMap, dmft);
    setSelectedTooth(null);
  };

  const handleResetTooth = (toothNum: number) => {
    const updatedMap = { ...teethMap };
    delete updatedMap[toothNum];
    setTeethMap(updatedMap);
    const dmft = calculateDmft(updatedMap);
    if (onChange) onChange(updatedMap, dmft);
  };

  const handleClearSurface = (surfaceName: ToothSurface) => {
    if (!selectedTooth || !teethMap[selectedTooth]?.surfaces) return;
    const currentSurfaces = { ...teethMap[selectedTooth].surfaces };
    delete currentSurfaces[surfaceName];

    const updatedMap = {
      ...teethMap,
      [selectedTooth]: {
        ...teethMap[selectedTooth],
        surfaces: currentSurfaces,
      },
    };
    setTeethMap(updatedMap);
    const dmft = calculateDmft(updatedMap);
    if (onChange) onChange(updatedMap, dmft);
  };

  const handleFindingChange = (field: string, val: string) => {
    const updated = { ...findings, [field]: val };
    setFindings(updated);
    if (onOralFindingsChange) onOralFindingsChange(updated);
  };

  const handleSelectTooth = (num: number) => {
    setSelectedTooth(num);
  };

  const handleSelectSurface = (num: number, surface: ToothSurface) => {
    setSelectedTooth(num);
    setSelectedSurface(surface);
  };

  const dmft = calculateDmft(teethMap);

  return (
    <div className="bg-white border border-blue-200 p-6 rounded-none space-y-6 shadow-sm">
      {/* Header & DMF-T Counter */}
      <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between border-b border-gray-200 pb-4 gap-4">
        <div>
          <h3 className="text-lg font-black text-gray-900 flex items-center gap-2">
            <Activity className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-600" />
            Standard Multi-Surface Odontogram Chart (FDI 5-Bidang Terpisah)
          </h3>
          <p className="text-xs text-gray-500">Klik langsung pada bidang (Atas, Kiri, Kanan, Bawah, Tengah) untuk mewarnai bagian yang bermasalah.</p>
        </div>

        {/* DMF-T Score Badges */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 bg-blue-50 p-2 border border-blue-200">
          <span className="text-xs font-bold text-blue-900 uppercase">Indeks DMF-T:</span>
          <span className="px-2 py-0.5 bg-red-600 text-white font-extrabold text-xs rounded-none">D: {dmft.d}</span>
          <span className="px-2 py-0.5 bg-gray-800 text-white font-extrabold text-xs rounded-none">M: {dmft.m}</span>
          <span className="px-2 py-0.5 bg-blue-600 text-white font-extrabold text-xs rounded-none">F: {dmft.f}</span>
          <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 bg-emerald-700 text-white font-black text-xs rounded-none">
            TOTAL: {dmft.total}
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* ANATOMICAL GEOMETRIC ODONTOGRAM CHART (PERSIS GAMBAR STANDAR PUSKESMAS) */}
      <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-4 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 space-y-6 overflow-x-auto">
        {/* ROW 1: PERMANEN ATAS (18 - 28) */}
        <div className="flex flex-col items-center">
          <div className="flex gap-1.5 md:gap-2">
            <div className="flex gap-1 md:gap-1.5 border-r-2 border-gray-400 pr-2 md:pr-3">
              {q1.map((num) => (
                <ToothItem key={num} num={num} numberPosition="top" isSelected={selectedTooth === num} teethMap={teethMap} onSelectTooth={handleSelectTooth} onSelectSurface={handleSelectSurface} />
              ))}
            </div>
            <div className="flex gap-1 md:gap-1.5 pl-1 md:pl-2">
              {q2.map((num) => (
                <ToothItem key={num} num={num} numberPosition="top" isSelected={selectedTooth === num} teethMap={teethMap} onSelectTooth={handleSelectTooth} onSelectSurface={handleSelectSurface} />
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* ROW 2: DESIDUI / SUSU ATAS (55 - 65) */}
        <div className="flex flex-col items-center pt-2">
          <div className="flex gap-1.5 md:gap-2">
            <div className="flex gap-1 md:gap-1.5 border-r-2 border-gray-400 pr-2 md:pr-3">
              {q5.map((num) => (
                <ToothItem key={num} num={num} numberPosition="top" isSelected={selectedTooth === num} teethMap={teethMap} onSelectTooth={handleSelectTooth} onSelectSurface={handleSelectSurface} />
              ))}
            </div>
            <div className="flex gap-1 md:gap-1.5 pl-1 md:pl-2">
              {q6.map((num) => (
                <ToothItem key={num} num={num} numberPosition="top" isSelected={selectedTooth === num} teethMap={teethMap} onSelectTooth={handleSelectTooth} onSelectSurface={handleSelectSurface} />
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* ROW 3: DESIDUI / SUSU BAWAH (85 - 75) */}
        <div className="flex flex-col items-center pt-2">
          <div className="flex gap-1.5 md:gap-2">
            <div className="flex gap-1 md:gap-1.5 border-r-2 border-gray-400 pr-2 md:pr-3">
              {q8.map((num) => (
                <ToothItem key={num} num={num} numberPosition="bottom" isSelected={selectedTooth === num} teethMap={teethMap} onSelectTooth={handleSelectTooth} onSelectSurface={handleSelectSurface} />
              ))}
            </div>
            <div className="flex gap-1 md:gap-1.5 pl-1 md:pl-2">
              {q7.map((num) => (
                <ToothItem key={num} num={num} numberPosition="bottom" isSelected={selectedTooth === num} teethMap={teethMap} onSelectTooth={handleSelectTooth} onSelectSurface={handleSelectSurface} />
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* ROW 4: PERMANEN BAWAH (48 - 38) */}
        <div className="flex flex-col items-center pt-2">
          <div className="flex gap-1.5 md:gap-2">
            <div className="flex gap-1 md:gap-1.5 border-r-2 border-gray-400 pr-2 md:pr-3">
              {q4.map((num) => (
                <ToothItem key={num} num={num} numberPosition="bottom" isSelected={selectedTooth === num} teethMap={teethMap} onSelectTooth={handleSelectTooth} onSelectSurface={handleSelectSurface} />
              ))}
            </div>
            <div className="flex gap-1 md:gap-1.5 pl-1 md:pl-2">
              {q3.map((num) => (
                <ToothItem key={num} num={num} numberPosition="bottom" isSelected={selectedTooth === num} teethMap={teethMap} onSelectTooth={handleSelectTooth} onSelectSurface={handleSelectSurface} />
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* MODAL / SELECTION POPOVER UNTUK PENGISIAN PER-BIDANG DENGAN LIVE ZOOMED PREVIEW 2X */}
      <OdontogramEditorPanel
        selectedTooth={selectedTooth}
        setSelectedTooth={setSelectedTooth}
        selectedSurface={selectedSurface}
        setSelectedSurface={setSelectedSurface}
        teethMap={teethMap}
        handleMarkMissingTooth={handleMarkMissingTooth}
        handleResetTooth={handleResetTooth}
        handleClearSurface={handleClearSurface}
        handleApplySurfaceCondition={handleApplySurfaceCondition}
      />

      {/* PEMERIKSAAN LINGKUNGAN MULUT LAINNYA (SATUSEHAT USE CASE GIGI) */}
      <OralFindingsForm findings={findings} handleFindingChange={handleFindingChange} />
    </div>
  );
}

                  >
                    <span>{surf.name}</span>

                  </button>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* 2. PILIHAN KONDISI / WARNA UNTUK BIDANG TERPILIH */}
          <div className="space-y-2 pt-2 border-t border-slate-800">
            <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-300 uppercase tracking-wider">

                <span className="text-yellow-400 font-extrabold uppercase">{selectedSurface}</span>
              </label>

              {selectedSurface !== 'all' && teethMap[selectedTooth]?.surfaces?.[selectedSurface as ToothSurface] && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => handleClearSurface(selectedSurface as ToothSurface)}
                  className="text-[11px] text-red-400 hover:underline"
                >
                  Hapus Warna Bidang Ini
                </button>
              )}
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-2">
              {CONDITION_OPTIONS.map((opt) => (
                <button
                  key={opt.code}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => handleApplySurfaceCondition(opt.code)}
                  className={`px-3 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-left border rounded-none transition-all ${opt.color} hover:brightness-110`}
                >
                  {opt.label}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>

        </div>

      </div>
    </div>
  );

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { 
  TestTubes, 
  X, 
  Search, 
  Sparkles, 
  CheckCircle2, 
  ChevronDown, 
  ChevronRight, 
  AlertCircle,
  Building2,
  Check,
  ExternalLink,
  ArrowRight,
  Loader2,
  User,
  FlaskConical,
  Info,
  Printer
} from 'lucide-react';
import Swal from 'sweetalert2';
import { 
  AVAILABLE_LAB_TESTS, 
  QUICK_LAB_PACKAGES, 
  isInternalLabTest, 
  QuickLabPackage 
} from '../rawatJalan.constants';
import { laboratoriumService } from '@/services/laboratorium.service';
import CetakLaboratoriumModal from '@/components/kasir/CetakLaboratoriumModal';

interface OrderLabModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  selectedKunjungan: any;
  existingOrder?: any;
  onSuccess?: () => void;
}

export default function OrderLabModal({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  selectedKunjungan,
  existingOrder,
  onSuccess,
}: OrderLabModalProps) {
  const [labOrders, setLabOrders] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [labNote, setLabNote] = useState('');
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [faskesTujuan, setFaskesTujuan] = useState('UPT Labkesda Kabupaten / RSUD Terdekat');
  const [metodeRujukan, setMetodeRujukan] = useState<'KIRIM_PASIEN' | 'KIRIM_SPESIMEN'>('KIRIM_PASIEN');
  const [isCetakModalOpen, setIsCetakModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [lastSavedOrder, setLastSavedOrder] = useState<any>(null);

  // Initialize or prefill from existing order
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      if (existingOrder?.details && Array.isArray(existingOrder.details)) {
        setLabOrders(existingOrder.details.map((d: any) => d.parameter));
        setLabNote(existingOrder.catatanKlinis || '');
      } else {
        setLabOrders([]);
        setLabNote('');
      }
      setSearchQuery('');
    }
  }, [isOpen, existingOrder]);

  const [openLabCategories, setOpenLabCategories] = useState<string[]>(
    AVAILABLE_LAB_TESTS.map(c => c.category)
  );

  if (!isOpen || !selectedKunjungan) return null;

  const handleToggleLabCategory = (category: string) => {
    if (openLabCategories.includes(category)) {
      setOpenLabCategories(openLabCategories.filter(c => c !== category));
    } else {
      setOpenLabCategories([...openLabCategories, category]);
    }
  };

  const handleExpandAll = () => {
    setOpenLabCategories(AVAILABLE_LAB_TESTS.map(c => c.category));
  };

  const handleCollapseAll = () => {
    setOpenLabCategories([]);
  };

  const handleToggleLab = (test: string) => {
    if (labOrders.includes(test)) {
      setLabOrders(labOrders.filter(t => t !== test));
    } else {
      setLabOrders([...labOrders, test]);
    }
  };

  const handleApplyPackage = (pkg: QuickLabPackage) => {
    const isAllIncluded = pkg.tests.every(t => labOrders.includes(t));
    if (isAllIncluded) {
      setLabOrders(labOrders.filter(t => !pkg.tests.includes(t)));
    } else {
      const merged = Array.from(new Set([...labOrders, ...pkg.tests]));
      setLabOrders(merged);
    }
  };

  const internalCount = labOrders.filter(t => isInternalLabTest(t)).length;
  const externalCount = labOrders.filter(t => !isInternalLabTest(t)).length;

  const handleSubmit = async () => {
    if (labOrders.length === 0) {
      Swal.fire('Peringatan', 'Pilih minimal 1 parameter pemeriksaan laboratorium!', 'warning');
      return;
    }

    setIsSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const payloadTests = labOrders.map((t) => {
        const isLuar = !isInternalLabTest(t);
        return {
          parameter: t,
          isRujukanLuar: isLuar,
          faskesTujuan: isLuar ? faskesTujuan : undefined,
          metodeRujukan: isLuar ? metodeRujukan : undefined,
        };
      });

      const resOrder = await laboratoriumService.createOrder({
        kunjunganId: selectedKunjungan.id,
        pasienId: selectedKunjungan.pasien?.id,
        dokterId: selectedKunjungan.dokterTujuan?.id || selectedKunjungan.dokterId || 'dummy-dokter-id',
        catatanKlinis: labNote,
        faskesTujuan: externalCount > 0 ? faskesTujuan : undefined,
        metodeRujukan: externalCount > 0 ? metodeRujukan : undefined,
        tests: payloadTests,
      });

      setLastSavedOrder(resOrder);

      if (externalCount > 0) {
        const confirmPrint = await Swal.fire({
          icon: 'success',
          title: 'Permintaan Lab Berhasil Disimpan!',
          html: `
            <div class="text-left text-xs space-y-2 mt-2">
              <p><strong>${internalCount} Uji Internal:</strong> Diteruskan ke analis lab Puskesmas & masuk kasir.</p>
              <p><strong>${externalCount} Uji Rujukan Luar:</strong> Otomatis <strong>Rp 0 di Kasir Puskesmas</strong> (pasien bayar di ${faskesTujuan}).</p>
              <p class="font-bold text-slate-800 mt-2">Cetak 1 Lembar Surat Pengantar Rujukan Lab sekarang?</p>
            </div>
          `,
          showCancelButton: true,
          confirmButtonText: 'Cetak Surat Pengantar Lab',
          cancelButtonText: 'Selesai Tanpa Cetak',
          confirmButtonColor: '#2563eb',
        });

        if (confirmPrint.isConfirmed) {
          setIsCetakModalOpen(true);
          if (onSuccess) onSuccess();
          return;
        }
      } else {
        await Swal.fire({
          icon: 'success',
          title: 'Permintaan Lab Internal Terkirim!',
          text: `Total ${internalCount} parameter uji telah diteruskan ke analis laboratorium & tersinkron ke kasir faskes.`,
          timer: 2000,
          showConfirmButton: false,
        });
      }

      if (onSuccess) {
        onSuccess();
      }
      onClose();
    } catch (error: any) {
      Swal.fire('Gagal', error?.response?.data?.message || 'Gagal mengirim order laboratorium.', 'error');
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  // Filter categories and tests based on search query
  const filteredCategories = AVAILABLE_LAB_TESTS.map(cat => {
    const matchingTests = cat.tests.filter(t => 
      t.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) || 
      cat.category.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase())
    );
    return {
      ...cat,
      matchingTests,
    };
  }).filter(cat => cat.matchingTests.length > 0);

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-slate-900/70 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-center justify-center p-3 sm:p-5">
      <div className="bg-white max-w-5xl w-full max-h-[92vh] flex flex-col border border-slate-300 shadow-2xl overflow-hidden animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95 duration-150">
        
        {/* MODAL HEADER */}
        <div className="bg-gradient-to-r from-amber-700 via-amber-800 to-amber-900 text-white px-6 py-4 flex items-center justify-between shrink-0 shadow-md">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="w-10 h-10 bg-white/10 rounded-none flex items-center justify-center border border-white/20">
              <TestTubes className="w-6 h-6 text-amber-300" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <h3 className="text-base font-extrabold uppercase tracking-wide">
                  Formulir Permintaan Pemeriksaan Laboratorium
                </h3>
                {existingOrder && (
                  <span className="px-2 py-0.5 bg-amber-400 text-amber-950 text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider">
                    Perbarui Order ({existingOrder.status || 'Terkirim'})
                  </span>
                )}
              </div>
              <p className="text-xs text-amber-200 mt-0.5 font-medium">
                Pasien: <strong className="text-white">{selectedKunjungan.pasien?.namaLengkap}</strong> • No. RM: <strong className="text-white">{selectedKunjungan.pasien?.noRM}</strong> • Poli: {selectedKunjungan.poliklinik?.namaPoli || 'Rawat Jalan'}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            {/* Legend */}
            <div className="hidden sm:flex items-center gap-2 text-[11px] bg-black/20 px-3 py-1 border border-white/10">

            {filteredCategories.map((cat, idx) => {

              const selectedInCat = cat.tests.filter((t: string) => labOrders.includes(t)).length;

              return (
                <div key={idx} className="bg-white border border-slate-300 shadow-xs break-inside-avoid">
                  {/* Category Header */}
                  <div

                    className="font-extrabold text-xs text-slate-900 bg-amber-100/70 hover:bg-amber-200/80 px-3 py-2.5 uppercase tracking-wide border-b border-slate-300 cursor-pointer flex justify-between items-center transition-colors select-none"
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <span>{cat.category}</span>
                      {selectedInCat > 0 && (
                        <span className="px-1.5 py-0.2 bg-amber-700 text-white text-[10px] font-mono font-bold">
                          {selectedInCat}
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </div>
                    {isOpen ? <ChevronDown className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-700" /> : <ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-700" />}
                  </div>

                          >
                            <div className="flex items-start gap-2.5 flex-1">
                              <input 
                                type="checkbox" 
                                className="w-4 h-4 mt-0.5 text-amber-700 border-slate-400 focus:ring-amber-600 cursor-pointer" 
                                checked={isChecked}
                                onChange={() => handleToggleLab(test)}
                              />
                              <span className="text-xs text-slate-800 leading-snug">
                                {test}
                              </span>
                            </div>
                            
                            <span className={`shrink-0 text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.2 font-extrabold border ${
                              isInternal 
                                ? 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border-emerald-300' 
                                : 'bg-amber-50 text-amber-800 border-amber-300'
                            }`}>
                              {isInternal ? 'Tersedia Internal' : 'Rujuk Lab Luar'}
                            </span>
                          </label>
                        );
                      })}
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>

          {filteredCategories.length === 0 && (
            <div className="text-center py-10 bg-white border border-slate-200 p-6">
              <AlertCircle className="w-8 h-8 text-slate-400 mx-auto mb-2" />
              <p className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-700">Tidak ada pemeriksaan laboratorium yang cocok dengan kata kunci &quot;{searchQuery}&quot;</p>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setSearchQuery('')}
                className="mt-2 text-xs font-bold text-amber-700 underline"
              >
                Reset Pencarian
              </button>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* CATATAN KLINIS */}
          <div className="bg-white p-4 border border-slate-300 space-y-1.5">
            <label className="block text-xs font-black text-slate-800 uppercase tracking-wide">
              Catatan Klinis / Indikasi Pemeriksaan untuk Petugas Lab:
            </label>
            <textarea 
              rows={2} 
              value={labNote} 
              onChange={e => setLabNote(e.target.value)} 
              className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-white border border-slate-300 text-xs text-slate-900 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-amber-500 focus:outline-none" 
              placeholder="Contoh: Skrining ANC Trimester 1, Cek Glukosa karena riwayat keluarga, CITO/Segera..." 
            />
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* MODAL FOOTER */}
        <div className="p-4 bg-white border-t border-slate-300 flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 shrink-0 shadow-lg">
          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <span className="text-xs text-slate-600 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider">Total Terpilih:</span>
              <span className="text-base font-black text-amber-900 font-mono">{labOrders.length} Parameter</span>
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3 text-xs text-slate-600 mt-0.5">
              <span className="font-semibold text-slate-800 inline-flex items-center gap-1">
                <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600" /> {internalCount} Uji Internal Faskes
              </span>
              <span>•</span>
              <span className="font-semibold text-slate-700 inline-flex items-center gap-1">
                <ExternalLink className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-500" /> {externalCount} Rujukan Luar (Labkesda/RS)
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onClose}
              disabled={isSubmitting}
              className="px-4 py-2.5 bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-700 text-xs font-bold transition-colors"
            >
              Batal
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleSubmit}
              disabled={labOrders.length === 0 || isSubmitting}
              className="px-6 py-2.5 bg-amber-700 hover:bg-amber-800 disabled:opacity-50 text-white font-extrabold text-xs shadow-md transition-all flex items-center gap-2"
            >
              {isSubmitting ? (
                <>
                  <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" />
                  <span>Mengirim Permintaan Lab...</span>
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <TestTubes className="w-4 h-4" />
                  <span>Kirim Permintaan Lab ke Analis</span>
                  <ArrowRight className="w-4 h-4" />
                </>
              )}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

      </div>

      {/* MODAL CETAK SURAT PENGANTAR RUJUKAN LAB EKSTERNAL */}
      {isCetakModalOpen && (
        <CetakLaboratoriumModal
          isOpen={isCetakModalOpen}
          onClose={() => {
            setIsCetakModalOpen(false);
            onClose();
          }}
          pasienData={selectedKunjungan?.pasien}
          orderLabData={{
            ...(lastSavedOrder || existingOrder || {}),
            details: labOrders.map((t) => ({
              parameter: t,
              isRujukanLuar: !isInternalLabTest(t),
              faskesTujuan: !isInternalLabTest(t) ? faskesTujuan : undefined,
              metodeRujukan: !isInternalLabTest(t) ? metodeRujukan : undefined,
            })),
            catatanKlinis: labNote,
            faskesTujuan,
            metodeRujukan,
          }}

        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { 
  Radio, 
  X, 
  Search, 
  Plus, 
  Trash2, 
  CheckCircle2, 
  Clock, 
  FileText, 
  AlertCircle, 
  Loader2,
  Building2,
  Printer,
  ArrowRight
} from 'lucide-react';
import Swal from 'sweetalert2';
import { radiologiService } from '@/services/radiologi.service';
import CetakRadiologiModal from '@/components/kasir/CetakRadiologiModal';

interface OrderRadiologiModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  selectedKunjungan: any;
  onSuccess?: () => void;
}

const MASTER_RADIOLOGI_LOINC = [
  { kodeLoinc: '39051-8', namaPemeriksaan: 'Rontgen Thorax AP/PA (XR Thorax AP/PA)', modalitas: 'XR', bodySiteCode: '51185008', bodySiteDisplay: 'Thoracic structure' },
  { kodeLoinc: '26122-2', namaPemeriksaan: 'Rontgen Femur (XR Femur - Right/Left)', modalitas: 'XR', bodySiteCode: '29836001', bodySiteDisplay: 'Hip structure' },
