  };

  // Toggle tipe pelaksanaan
  const handleToggleTipePelaksanaan = (procIndex: number, tipe: 'INTERNAL' | 'EKSTERNAL') => {
    if (!canEdit) return;
    setSelectedProsedur(prev => {
      const updated = [...prev];
      updated[procIndex] = {
        ...updated[procIndex],
        tipePelaksanaan: tipe,
        pelaksana: tipe === 'EKSTERNAL' ? 'Rujukan Luar' : 'Dokter',
        faskesRujukan: tipe === 'EKSTERNAL' ? (updated[procIndex].faskesRujukan || 'RSUD Rujukan Lanjutan') : '',
        alkesDetails: tipe === 'EKSTERNAL' ? [] : updated[procIndex].alkesDetails,
        bmhpDetails: tipe === 'EKSTERNAL' ? [] : updated[procIndex].bmhpDetails
      };
      return updated;
    });
  };

  // Toggle Alkes pada tindakan
  const handleToggleAlkes = (procIndex: number, alkes: any) => {
    if (!canEdit) return;
    setSelectedProsedur(prev => {
      const updated = [...prev];
      const proc = { ...updated[procIndex] };
      const currentAlkes = [...(proc.alkesDetails || [])];
      const existingIdx = currentAlkes.findIndex(a => a.asetId === alkes.id || a.namaAset === alkes.namaAset);

      if (existingIdx >= 0) {
        currentAlkes.splice(existingIdx, 1);
      } else {
        currentAlkes.push({
          asetId: alkes.id,
          namaAset: alkes.namaAset,
          kodeAset: alkes.kodeAset,
          tarifPemakaian: Number(alkes.tarifPemakaian) || 25000
        });
      }
      proc.alkesDetails = currentAlkes;
      updated[procIndex] = proc;
      return updated;
    });
  };

  // Tambah BMHP dari dropdown
  const handleAddBmhpItem = (procIndex: number, obat: any) => {
    if (!canEdit) return;
    setSelectedProsedur(prev => {
      const updated = [...prev];
      const proc = { ...updated[procIndex] };
      const currentBmhp = [...(proc.bmhpDetails || [])];

      const existing = currentBmhp.find(b => b.obatId === obat.id || b.namaItem === obat.namaObat);
      if (existing) {
        existing.jumlah += 1;
        existing.subTotal = existing.jumlah * existing.hargaSatuan;
      } else {
        const harga = Number(obat.hargaJual || obat.harga || obat.hargaBeli) || 3000;
        currentBmhp.push({
          obatId: obat.id,
          namaItem: obat.namaObat,
          sediaan: obat.sediaan || 'Pcs',
          jumlah: 1,
          hargaSatuan: harga,
          subTotal: harga
        });
      }
      proc.bmhpDetails = currentBmhp;
      updated[procIndex] = proc;
      return updated;
    });

    setOpenBmhpDropdown(prev => ({ ...prev, [procIndex]: false }));
    setActiveBmhpSearch(prev => ({ ...prev, [procIndex]: '' }));
  };

  // Update BMHP Qty
  const handleUpdateBmhpQty = (procIndex: number, bmhpIndex: number, delta: number) => {
    if (!canEdit) return;
    setSelectedProsedur(prev => {
      const updated = [...prev];
      const proc = { ...updated[procIndex] };
      const currentBmhp = [...(proc.bmhpDetails || [])];

      if (currentBmhp[bmhpIndex]) {
        const newQty = Math.max(1, currentBmhp[bmhpIndex].jumlah + delta);
        currentBmhp[bmhpIndex] = {
          ...currentBmhp[bmhpIndex],
          jumlah: newQty,
          subTotal: newQty * currentBmhp[bmhpIndex].hargaSatuan
        };
      }
      proc.bmhpDetails = currentBmhp;
      updated[procIndex] = proc;
      return updated;
    });
  };

  // Hapus item BMHP
  const handleRemoveBmhpItem = (procIndex: number, bmhpIndex: number) => {
    if (!canEdit) return;
    setSelectedProsedur(prev => {
      const updated = [...prev];
      const proc = { ...updated[procIndex] };
      const currentBmhp = [...(proc.bmhpDetails || [])];
      currentBmhp.splice(bmhpIndex, 1);
      proc.bmhpDetails = currentBmhp;
      updated[procIndex] = proc;
      return updated;
    });
  };

  // Hapus Prosedur
  const handleRemoveProsedur = (kode: string) => {
    if (!canEdit) return;
    setSelectedProsedur(prev => prev.filter(p => p.kode_icd9 !== kode));
  };

  // Total Estimasi Biaya
  const totalSummary = useMemo(() => {
    let totalAlkes = 0;
    let totalBmhp = 0;
    let totalTindakan = 0;

    selectedProsedur.forEach(p => {
      if (p.tipePelaksanaan === 'EKSTERNAL') return;
      totalTindakan += 25000; // Standar jasa tindakan UGD (estimasi)
      (p.alkesDetails || []).forEach(a => {
        totalAlkes += Number(a.tarifPemakaian) || 0;
      });
      (p.bmhpDetails || []).forEach(b => {
        totalBmhp += Number(b.subTotal) || 0;
      });
    });

    return {
      totalTindakan,
      totalAlkes,
      totalBmhp,
      grandTotal: totalTindakan + totalAlkes + totalBmhp
    };
  }, [selectedProsedur]);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {/* Header Bagian Tindakan */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-rose-200 pb-2">
        <div>
          <h4 className="text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-rose-800 flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <Syringe className="w-4 h-4 text-rose-600" />
            Tindakan Medis, Alkes & Pemakaian BMHP UGD (ICD-9-CM)
          </h4>
          <p className="text-[11px] text-gray-500">
            Pemakaian BMHP otomatis memotong stok logistik farmasi, sewa Alkes & tindakan tercatat di Kasir.
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="text-[11px] font-mono bg-rose-50 text-rose-800 border border-rose-200 px-2 py-1 font-bold">
          {selectedProsedur.length} Tindakan Terpilih
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Quick Action Presets Gawat Darurat UGD */}
      <div>
        <label className="block text-[11px] font-bold text-gray-600 mb-1.5 flex items-center gap-1">
          <Sparkles className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-500" />
          Preset Cepat Tindakan Gawat Darurat (1-Klik Tambah + Alkes & BMHP):
        </label>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
          <button
            type="button"
            disabled={!canEdit}
            onClick={() => applyQuickPresetUGD('INFUS')}
            className="text-[11px] px-2.5 py-1.5 bg-blue-50 hover:bg-blue-100 text-blue-800 border border-blue-200 font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors disabled:opacity-60 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
          >
            <Syringe className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-blue-600" />
            <span>Pasang Infus / IV Line</span>
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            disabled={!canEdit}
            onClick={() => applyQuickPresetUGD('OKSIGEN')}
            className="text-[11px] px-2.5 py-1.5 bg-cyan-50 hover:bg-cyan-100 text-cyan-800 border border-cyan-200 font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors disabled:opacity-60 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
          >
            <Wind className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-cyan-600" />
            <span>Oksigenasi Kanul/Masker</span>
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            disabled={!canEdit}
            onClick={() => applyQuickPresetUGD('NEBULIZER')}
            className="text-[11px] px-2.5 py-1.5 bg-indigo-50 hover:bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-800 border border-indigo-200 font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors disabled:opacity-60 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
          >
            <Stethoscope className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-indigo-600" />
            <span>Nebulisasi Darurat</span>
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            disabled={!canEdit}
            onClick={() => applyQuickPresetUGD('EKG')}
            className="text-[11px] px-2.5 py-1.5 bg-emerald-50 hover:bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 border border-emerald-200 font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors disabled:opacity-60 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
          >
            <Activity className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600" />
            <span>Rekam EKG 12-Lead</span>
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            disabled={!canEdit}
            onClick={() => applyQuickPresetUGD('HECTING')}
            className="text-[11px] px-2.5 py-1.5 bg-rose-50 hover:bg-rose-100 text-rose-800 border border-rose-200 font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors disabled:opacity-60 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
          >
            <Scissors className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-rose-600" />
            <span>Hecting & Jahit Luka</span>
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            disabled={!canEdit}
            onClick={() => applyQuickPresetUGD('KATETER')}
            className="text-[11px] px-2.5 py-1.5 bg-amber-50 hover:bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 border border-amber-200 font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors disabled:opacity-60 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
          >
            <Droplets className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-600" />
            <span>Pasang Kateter Urine</span>
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            disabled={!canEdit}
            onClick={() => applyQuickPresetUGD('INJEKSI')}
            className="text-[11px] px-2.5 py-1.5 bg-purple-50 hover:bg-purple-100 text-purple-800 border border-purple-200 font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors disabled:opacity-60 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
          >
            <Syringe className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-purple-600" />
            <span>Injeksi Obat Darurat</span>
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            disabled={!canEdit}
            onClick={() => applyQuickPresetUGD('DEBRIDEMENT')}
            className="text-[11px] px-2.5 py-1.5 bg-teal-50 hover:bg-teal-100 text-teal-800 border border-teal-200 font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors disabled:opacity-60 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
          >
            <Bandage className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-teal-600" />
            <span>Rawat Luka / Debridement</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Input Pencarian ICD-9 */}
      <div className="relative" ref={dropdownRef}>
        <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-gray-700 mb-1">
          Cari & Tambah Tindakan Medis ICD-9-CM:
        </label>
        <div className="relative flex items-center">
          <input
            type="text"
            disabled={!canEdit}
            value={searchTerm}
            onChange={e => {
              setSearchTerm(e.target.value);
              setIsIcd9DropdownOpen(true);
            }}
            onClick={() => {
              if (canEdit) {
                setIsIcd9DropdownOpen(true);
                if (icd9Results.length === 0) fetchICD9('');
              }
            }}
            placeholder="Ketik kode atau nama tindakan ICD-9 (cth: 99.18, 93.96, jahit, infus, nebulizer, ekg)..."
            className="w-full pl-9 pr-8 py-2 text-xs border border-gray-300 rounded-none bg-white focus:border-rose-500 focus:outline-none disabled:bg-gray-100 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
          />
          <div className="absolute left-2.5 text-gray-400 pointer-events-none">
            {isLoadingIcd9 ? <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin text-rose-600" /> : <Search className="w-4 h-4" />}
          </div>
          {searchTerm && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                setSearchTerm('');
                fetchICD9('');
              }}
              className="absolute right-2.5 text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600 text-xs"
            >
              <X className="w-4 h-4" />
            </button>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Dropdown Hasil Pencarian ICD-9 */}
        {isIcd9DropdownOpen && canEdit && (
          <div className="absolute z-30 w-full mt-1 bg-white border border-gray-300 shadow-xl max-h-60 overflow-y-auto divide-y divide-gray-100 text-xs">
            <div className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-rose-50 border-b border-rose-100 flex justify-between items-center text-[11px] text-rose-900 font-bold sticky top-0 z-10">
              <span>{searchTerm ? `Hasil untuk "${searchTerm}"` : 'Master ICD-9 Tindakan Medis'}</span>
              <span className="text-gray-500 text-[10px]">{icd9Results.length} tersedia</span>
            </div>

            {isLoadingIcd9 && icd9Results.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="p-4 text-center text-gray-400 flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
                <Loader2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin text-rose-600" />
                <span>Memuat master ICD-9...</span>
              </div>
            ) : icd9Results.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="p-4 text-center text-gray-400">
                Tidak ada tindakan ICD-9 yang cocok.
              </div>
            ) : (
              icd9Results.map((item, idx) => {
                const isSelected = selectedProsedur.some(
                  p => p.kode_icd9 === item.kode_icd9 || p.id_icd9 === (item.id_icd9 || item.id)
                );
                return (
                  <div
                    key={item.id_icd9 || idx}
                    onClick={() => !isSelected && handleSelectICD9(item)}
                    className={`p-2.5 hover:bg-rose-50 flex items-center justify-between cursor-pointer transition-colors ${
                      isSelected ? 'bg-rose-50/50 cursor-default' : ''
                    }`}
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <span className="font-mono font-bold bg-rose-100 text-rose-800 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] border border-rose-200">
                        {item.kode_icd9}
                      </span>
                      <span className="font-semibold text-gray-800">{item.nama_prosedur}</span>
                      {item.kategori && (
                        <span className="text-[10px] text-gray-400">({item.kategori})</span>
                      )}
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      {isSelected ? (
                        <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-emerald-700 bg-emerald-50 px-2 py-0.5 border border-emerald-200 flex items-center gap-1">
                          <Check className="w-3 h-3" /> Dipilih
                        </span>
                      ) : (
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={e => {
                            e.stopPropagation();
                            handleSelectICD9(item);
                          }}
                          className="text-[10px] font-bold text-rose-700 hover:text-white bg-rose-50 hover:bg-rose-600 px-2 py-0.5 border border-rose-200 hover:border-rose-600 flex items-center gap-0.5"
                        >
                          <Plus className="w-3 h-3" /> Tambah
                        </button>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                );
              })
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Daftar Kartu Tindakan & Rincian BMHP/Alkes Terpilih */}
      {selectedProsedur.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="bg-slate-50 border border-dashed border-gray-300 p-6 text-center text-gray-400">
          <Syringe className="w-8 h-8 mx-auto mb-2 text-gray-300" />
          <p className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-600">Belum ada tindakan medis / pemakaian BMHP yang dipilih</p>
          <p className="text-[11px] text-gray-400 mt-0.5">
            Gunakan tombol preset darurat di atas atau ketik pencarian ICD-9 untuk mencatat tindakan, pemakaian BMHP, dan sewa Alkes UGD.
          </p>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="space-y-3">
          {selectedProsedur.map((proc, procIdx) => {
            const isEksternal = proc.tipePelaksanaan === 'EKSTERNAL';
            const subtotalAlkes = (proc.alkesDetails || []).reduce((acc, a) => acc + (Number(a.tarifPemakaian) || 0), 0);
            const subtotalBmhp = (proc.bmhpDetails || []).reduce((acc, b) => acc + (Number(b.subTotal) || 0), 0);

            // Filter BMHP untuk dropdown "+ Tambah BMHP" pada kartu ini
            const bmhpSearch = (activeBmhpSearch[procIdx] || '').toLowerCase();
            const filteredBmhpOptions = availableBmhp.filter((b: any) =>
              (b.namaObat || '').toLowerCase().includes(bmhpSearch) ||
              (b.kodeObat || '').toLowerCase().includes(bmhpSearch)
            ).slice(0, 15);

            return (
              <div
                key={proc.kode_icd9 || procIdx}
                className={`border shadow-sm p-3.5 transition-all ${
                  isEksternal
                    ? 'border-emerald-300 bg-emerald-50/40'
                    : 'border-gray-200 bg-white hover:border-rose-300'
                }`}
              >
                {/* Header Kartu Tindakan */}
                <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b pb-2 mb-2.5">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <span className="font-mono font-bold bg-rose-100 text-rose-800 px-2 py-0.5 text-xs border border-rose-300">
                      {proc.kode_icd9}
                    </span>
                    <span className="font-bold text-sm text-gray-900">{proc.nama_prosedur}</span>
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    {/* Pelaksana Dropdown */}
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px]">
                      <span className="text-gray-500">Pelaksana:</span>
                      <select
                        disabled={!canEdit || isEksternal}
                        value={proc.pelaksana}
                        onChange={e => {
                          const val = e.target.value;
                          setSelectedProsedur(prev => {
                            const u = [...prev];
                            u[procIdx] = { ...u[procIdx], pelaksana: val };
                            return u;
                          });
                        }}
                        className="text-xs border border-gray-300 bg-white px-2 py-1 focus:outline-none"
                      >
                        <option value="Dokter">Dokter DPJP</option>
                        <option value="Perawat">Perawat UGD</option>
                        <option value="Bersama">Dokter & Perawat</option>
                        {isEksternal && <option value="Rujukan Luar">Rujukan Luar</option>}
                      </select>
                    </div>

                    {/* Toggle Internal vs Eksternal */}
                    <div className="flex border border-gray-300 text-[10px] font-bold overflow-hidden">
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        disabled={!canEdit}
                        onClick={() => handleToggleTipePelaksanaan(procIdx, 'INTERNAL')}
                        className={`px-2 py-1 transition-colors ${
                          !isEksternal
                            ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white'
                            : 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-200'
                        }`}
                      >
                        Internal Faskes
                      </button>
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        disabled={!canEdit}
                        onClick={() => handleToggleTipePelaksanaan(procIdx, 'EKSTERNAL')}
                        className={`px-2 py-1 transition-colors ${
                          isEksternal
                            ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white'
                            : 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-200'
                        }`}
                      >
                        Rujukan Luar (Rp 0)
                      </button>
                    </div>

                    {/* Hapus Prosedur Button */}
                    {canEdit && (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => handleRemoveProsedur(proc.kode_icd9)}
                        title="Hapus Tindakan Ini"
                        className="p-1 text-gray-400 hover:text-rose-600 transition-colors"
                      >
                        <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                      </button>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Kondisional Tipe Eksternal vs Internal */}
                {isEksternal ? (
                  <div className="bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200 p-2.5 text-xs text-emerald-950 space-y-2">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 font-bold text-emerald-800">
                      <ExternalLink className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      Tindakan / Pemeriksaan Dialihkan ke Faskes Luar (Tarif Rp 0 di Faskes Ini)
                    </div>
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-2 text-xs">
                      <div>
                        <label className="block text-[10px] font-bold text-gray-600 mb-0.5">
                          Rumah Sakit / Lab Rujukan:
                        </label>
                        <input
                          type="text"
                          disabled={!canEdit}
                          value={proc.faskesRujukan || ''}
                          onChange={e => {
                            const val = e.target.value;
                            setSelectedProsedur(prev => {
                              const u = [...prev];
                              u[procIdx] = { ...u[procIdx], faskesRujukan: val };
                              return u;
                            });
                          }}
                          placeholder="RSUD Cibinong / RS PMI..."
                          className="w-full text-xs p-1.5 border border-emerald-300 bg-white"
                        />
                      </div>
                      <div>
                        <label className="block text-[10px] font-bold text-gray-600 mb-0.5">
                          Indikasi / Alasan Rujukan:
                        </label>
                        <input
                          type="text"
                          disabled={!canEdit}
                          value={proc.alasanRujukan || ''}
                          onChange={e => {
                            const val = e.target.value;
                            setSelectedProsedur(prev => {
                              const u = [...prev];
                              u[procIdx] = { ...u[procIdx], alasanRujukan: val };
                              return u;
                            });
                          }}
                          placeholder="Fasilitas internal belum memadai..."
                          className="w-full text-xs p-1.5 border border-emerald-300 bg-white"
                        />
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-3 text-xs">
                    {/* Panel Kiri: Pemakaian / Sewa Alat Kesehatan (Alkes) */}
                    <div className="bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 p-2.5 space-y-2">
                      <div className="flex justify-between items-center border-b border-slate-200 pb-1">
                        <span className="font-bold text-slate-800 flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px]">
                          <Wrench className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-blue-600" />
                          Sewa / Pemakaian Alat Medis (Alkes):
                        </span>
                        <span className="font-mono text-[10px] text-blue-700 font-bold">
                          Subtotal: Rp {subtotalAlkes.toLocaleString('id-ID')}
                        </span>
                      </div>

                      {availableAlkes.length === 0 ? (
                        <p className="text-[11px] text-gray-400 italic">Tidak ada master alkes tindakan terdaftar di faskes ini.</p>
                      ) : (
                        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5 max-h-32 overflow-y-auto pr-1">
                          {availableAlkes.map(alkes => {
                            const isChecked = (proc.alkesDetails || []).some(
                              a => a.asetId === alkes.id || a.namaAset === alkes.namaAset
                            );
                            return (
                              <button
                                key={alkes.id}
                                type="button"
                                disabled={!canEdit}
                                onClick={() => handleToggleAlkes(procIdx, alkes)}
                                className={`text-[10px] px-2 py-1 border transition-colors flex items-center gap-1 ${
                                  isChecked
                                    ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white border-blue-700 font-bold shadow-xs'
                                    : 'bg-white text-gray-700 border-gray-300 hover:bg-gray-100'
                                }`}
                              >
                                {isChecked && <Check className="w-3 h-3" />}
                                <span>{alkes.namaAset}</span>
                                <span className={`text-[9px] ${isChecked ? 'text-blue-100' : 'text-gray-400'}`}>
                                  (Rp {(Number(alkes.tarifPemakaian) || 0).toLocaleString('id-ID')})
                                </span>
                              </button>
                            );
                          })}
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>

                    {/* Panel Kanan: Pemakaian BMHP & Logistik Farmasi */}
                    <div className="bg-amber-50/50 border border-amber-200 p-2.5 space-y-2">
                      <div className="flex justify-between items-center border-b border-amber-200 pb-1">
                        <span className="font-bold text-amber-900 flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px]">
                          <Package className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-600" />
                          Pemakaian BMHP / Bahan Medis Habis Pakai:
                        </span>
                        <span className="font-mono text-[10px] text-amber-800 font-bold">
                          Subtotal: Rp {subtotalBmhp.toLocaleString('id-ID')}
                        </span>
                      </div>

                      {/* Tabel BMHP Terpakai */}
                      {(proc.bmhpDetails || []).length === 0 ? (
                        <p className="text-[11px] text-gray-400 italic">Belum ada BMHP yang ditambahkan.</p>
                      ) : (
                        <div className="space-y-1 max-h-36 overflow-y-auto pr-1">
                          {(proc.bmhpDetails || []).map((bmhp, bIdx) => (
                            <div
                              key={bIdx}
                              className="bg-white border border-amber-200 p-1.5 flex items-center justify-between text-[11px]"
                            >
                              <div className="flex-1 pr-2 truncate">
                                <span className="font-bold text-gray-800">{bmhp.namaItem}</span>
                                <span className="text-gray-400 text-[10px] ml-1">
                                  (@ Rp {bmhp.hargaSatuan.toLocaleString('id-ID')})
                                </span>
                              </div>

                              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                                {/* Stepper Qty */}
                                <div className="flex items-center border border-gray-300">
                                  <button
                                    type="button"
                                    disabled={!canEdit}
                                    onClick={() => handleUpdateBmhpQty(procIdx, bIdx, -1)}
                                    className="px-1.5 py-0.5 bg-gray-100 hover:bg-gray-200 text-gray-700 font-bold disabled:opacity-50"
                                  >
                                    -
                                  </button>
                                  <span className="px-2 font-mono font-bold text-gray-800">{bmhp.jumlah}</span>
                                  <button
                                    type="button"
                                    disabled={!canEdit}
                                    onClick={() => handleUpdateBmhpQty(procIdx, bIdx, 1)}
                                    className="px-1.5 py-0.5 bg-gray-100 hover:bg-gray-200 text-gray-700 font-bold disabled:opacity-50"
                                  >
                                    +
                                  </button>
                                </div>
                                <span className="text-[10px] text-gray-500 w-8">{bmhp.sediaan || 'Pcs'}</span>
                                <span className="font-mono font-bold text-gray-800 w-16 text-right">
                                  Rp {bmhp.subTotal.toLocaleString('id-ID')}
                                </span>
                                {canEdit && (
                                  <button
                                    type="button"
                                    onClick={() => handleRemoveBmhpItem(procIdx, bIdx)}
                                    className="text-gray-400 hover:text-rose-600 p-0.5"
                                  >
                                    <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                                  </button>
                                )}
                              </div>
                            </div>
                          ))}
                        </div>
                      )}

                      {/* Dropdown Tambah BMHP Terpakai */}
                      {canEdit && (
                        <div className="relative pt-1">
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() =>
                              setOpenBmhpDropdown(prev => ({ ...prev, [procIdx]: !prev[procIdx] }))
                            }
                            className="w-full text-left px-2 py-1.5 bg-white border border-amber-300 text-amber-900 text-[11px] font-bold flex items-center justify-between hover:bg-amber-50/60"
                          >
                            <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
                              <Plus className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Tambah BMHP dari Stok Farmasi
                            </span>
                            <ChevronDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-600" />
                          </button>

                          {openBmhpDropdown[procIdx] && (
                            <div className="absolute z-20 w-full mt-1 bg-white border border-gray-300 shadow-xl p-2 text-xs space-y-1.5">
                              <input
                                type="text"
                                placeholder="Cari BMHP (kassa, spuit, infus, jarum, plester...)"
                                value={activeBmhpSearch[procIdx] || ''}
                                onChange={e => {
                                  const val = e.target.value;
                                  setActiveBmhpSearch(prev => ({ ...prev, [procIdx]: val }));
                                }}
                                className="w-full text-xs p-1.5 border border-gray-300 focus:outline-none focus:border-amber-500"
                              />

                              <div className="max-h-40 overflow-y-auto divide-y divide-gray-100">
                                {filteredBmhpOptions.length === 0 ? (
                                  <div className="p-2 text-center text-gray-400 text-[11px]">
                                    Tidak ada item BMHP yang cocok.
                                  </div>
                                ) : (
                                  filteredBmhpOptions.map((o: any) => (
                                    <div
                                      key={o.id}
                                      onClick={() => handleAddBmhpItem(procIdx, o)}
                                      className="p-1.5 hover:bg-amber-50 cursor-pointer flex justify-between items-center text-[11px]"
                                    >
                                      <div>
                                        <p className="font-bold text-gray-800">{o.namaObat}</p>
                                        <p className="text-[10px] text-gray-400">
                                          Sediaan: {o.sediaan || '-'} | Stok: {o.stok ?? o.stokTotal ?? '-'}
                                        </p>
                                      </div>
                                      <span className="font-mono font-bold text-amber-800 text-[11px]">
                                        Rp {(Number(o.hargaJual || o.harga || o.hargaBeli) || 3000).toLocaleString('id-ID')}
                                      </span>
                                    </div>
                                  ))
                                )}
                              </div>
                            </div>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Ringkasan Estimasi Biaya Seluruh Tindakan & BMHP UGD */}
      {selectedProsedur.length > 0 && (
        <div className="bg-slate-900 text-white p-3 flex flex-col sm:flex-row justify-between items-center gap-3">
          <div className="text-xs">
            <span className="font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-rose-400">
              Estimasi Masuk Billing Kasir:
            </span>
            <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-300 mt-0.5 flex flex-wrap gap-x-4">
              <span>Jasa Tindakan: <strong>Rp {totalSummary.totalTindakan.toLocaleString('id-ID')}</strong></span>
              <span>Sewa Alkes: <strong>Rp {totalSummary.totalAlkes.toLocaleString('id-ID')}</strong></span>
              <span>BMHP Logistik: <strong>Rp {totalSummary.totalBmhp.toLocaleString('id-ID')}</strong></span>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="text-right">
            <span className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400 block">Total Biaya UGD</span>
            <span className="text-lg font-mono font-black text-emerald-400">
              Rp {totalSummary.grandTotal.toLocaleString('id-ID')}
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

// Helper aman untuk membaca data screening (baik bertipe object maupun array)
const getScreeningData = (patient?: KunjunganUGD | null) => {
  if (!patient || !patient.screening) return null;
  if (Array.isArray(patient.screening)) {
    return patient.screening.length > 0 ? patient.screening[0] : null;
  }
  return patient.screening;
};

// Helper aman untuk membaca data rekam medis
const getRekamMedisData = (patient?: KunjunganUGD | null) => {
  if (!patient || !patient.rekamMedis) return null;
  if (Array.isArray(patient.rekamMedis)) {
    return patient.rekamMedis.length > 0 ? patient.rekamMedis[0] : null;
  }
  return patient.rekamMedis;
};

            <p><strong>Nama:</strong> ${res.pasien?.namaLengkap}</p>
            <p><strong>Nomor Antrean:</strong> <span class="text-rose-600 font-mono font-black text-lg">${res.kunjungan?.noAntrian}</span></p>
            <p><strong>Tempat Tidur:</strong> <span class="bg-blue-100 text-blue-800 px-2 py-0.5 font-bold">${res.bed?.nomorBed}</span></p>
            <p><strong>Kategori Triase:</strong> <span class="font-bold text-red-600">${res.kunjungan?.triase}</span></p>
            <p><strong>Dokter DPJP:</strong> <span class="font-bold text-slate-800">${assignedDoc?.namaLengkap || 'Dokter Jaga UGD'}</span></p>
            <div class="bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 p-2.5 text-xs text-slate-800 mt-2 space-y-1">
              <div>• Triase perawat awal selesai.</div>
              <div>• Pasien dialihkan ke antrean <strong>Pemeriksaan Medis Dokter (SOAP & Rencana Tindak Lanjut)</strong>.</div>
              <div>• Petugas pendaftaran dapat melengkapi administrasi resmi.</div>
            </div>
          </div>
        `
      });
      setIsAdmitModalOpen(false);

      // Ambil antrean terbaru dan otomatis buka pasien yang baru di-admit
      const updatedQueue = await ugdService.getAntrean();
      setQueue(updatedQueue || []);
      const newPatient = (updatedQueue || []).find(p => p.id === res?.kunjungan?.id);
      if (newPatient) {
        selectPatientWithDraft(newPatient);
      } else if (updatedQueue && updatedQueue.length > 0) {
        selectPatientWithDraft(updatedQueue[0]);
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      Swal.fire({
        icon: 'error',
        title: 'Gagal Admit Pasien UGD',
        text: err.response?.data?.message || err.message || 'Terjadi kesalahan sistem'
      });
    } finally {
      setIsSubmittingAdmit(false);
    }
  };

  // Submit Update Observasi Triase oleh Perawat UGD
  const handleSimpanObservasiTriase = async () => {
    if (!selectedPatient) return;

    setIsSavingTriase(true);
    try {
      await ugdService.updateTriase(selectedPatient.id, triageEditForm);
      await Swal.fire({
        icon: 'success',
        title: 'Observasi Triase Diperbarui',
        text: 'Data tanda vital observasi berhasil disimpan. Pasien tetap berada dalam antrean pemeriksaan dokter DPJP.',
        timer: 2000,
        showConfirmButton: false
      });
      await fetchData(false);
    } catch (err: any) {
      Swal.fire({
        icon: 'error',
        title: 'Gagal Memperbarui Triase',
        text: err.response?.data?.message || err.message || 'Terjadi kesalahan sistem'
      });
    } finally {
      setIsSavingTriase(false);
    }
  };

  // Submit Simpan Observasi Medis & Pemakaian BMHP/Alkes (Tanpa Discharge / Bed Tetap Terisi)
  const handleSimpanObservasiMedis = async () => {
    if (!selectedPatient) return;

    if (!canEditMedis) {
      Swal.fire({
        icon: 'warning',
        title: 'Wewenang Dokter DPJP',
        text: 'Hanya Dokter DPJP yang ditugaskan atau Admin yang berwenang menyimpan observasi medis.'
      });
      return;
    }

    setIsSavingObservasi(true);
    try {
      await ugdService.simpanPemeriksaan(selectedPatient.id, {
        keluhanUtama: pemeriksaanForm.keluhanUtama,
        riwayatPenyakit: pemeriksaanForm.riwayatPenyakit,
        pemeriksaanFisik: pemeriksaanForm.pemeriksaanFisik,
        rencanaTerapi: pemeriksaanForm.rencanaTerapi,
        instruksiMedis: pemeriksaanForm.instruksiMedis,
        hanyaObservasi: true,
        isDraft: true,
        keputusan: 'OBSERVASI',
        diagnosaList: pemeriksaanForm.diagnosaAwal ? [{
          kode_icd10: 'R69',
          nama_diagnosis: pemeriksaanForm.diagnosaAwal,
          jenis: 'PRIMER'
        }] : [],
        tindakanList: selectedProsedur.map(p => ({
          id_icd9: p.id_icd9 || p.icd9Id,
          icd9Id: p.icd9Id || p.id_icd9,
          kode_icd9: p.kode_icd9,
          nama_prosedur: p.nama_prosedur,
          pelaksana: p.pelaksana || 'Dokter',
          tipePelaksanaan: p.tipePelaksanaan || 'INTERNAL',
          faskesRujukan: p.faskesRujukan || '',
          alasanRujukan: p.alasanRujukan || '',
          catatan: p.catatan || '',
          bmhpDetails: p.bmhpDetails || [],
          alkesDetails: p.alkesDetails || []
        }))
      });

      await Swal.fire({
        icon: 'success',
        title: 'Observasi & Tindakan UGD Disimpan!',
        html: `
          <div class="text-left text-xs space-y-2 mt-2">
            <p>Catatan SOAP dan <strong>${selectedProsedur.length} Tindakan/BMHP</strong> berhasil disimpan ke Rekam Medis.</p>
            <p><strong>Status Pasien:</strong> Pasien tetap berada dalam status <strong>OBSERVASI</strong> di antrean UGD.</p>
            <p><strong>Status Tempat Tidur:</strong> Bed tetap <strong>TERISI</strong> untuk pemantauan klinis.</p>
            <div class="bg-blue-50 border border-blue-200 p-2 text-blue-900 mt-2">
              Dokter dapat menambahkan observasi berkala, tindakan baru, atau menyelesaikan discharge di Tab Keputusan ketika kondisi pasien stabil.
            </div>
          </div>
        `,
        confirmButtonColor: '#2563eb'
      });

      await fetchData(false);
    } catch (err: any) {
      Swal.fire({
        icon: 'error',
        title: 'Gagal Menyimpan Observasi',
        text: err.response?.data?.message || err.message || 'Terjadi kesalahan sistem'
      });
    } finally {
      setIsSavingObservasi(false);
    }
  };

  // Submit Pemeriksaan & Discharge Pasien UGD (Hanya oleh Dokter DPJP)
  const handleSimpanPemeriksaan = async () => {
    if (!selectedPatient) return;

    if (isPerawat) {
      Swal.fire({
        icon: 'warning',
        title: 'Wewenang Dokter DPJP',
        text: 'Perawat hanya melakukan triase dan observasi tanda vital. Keputusan tindak lanjut/discharge dan penyelesaian penanganan pasien merupakan wewenang Dokter DPJP.'
      });
      return;
    }

    if (keputusan === 'RAWAT_INAP' && !selectedInapBedId && inapBeds.length > 0) {
      Swal.fire({ icon: 'warning', title: 'Pilih Bed Inap', text: 'Silakan pilih kamar dan tempat tidur rawat inap tujuan.' });
      return;
    }
    if (keputusan === 'DIRUJUK' && !faskesRujukan) {
      Swal.fire({ icon: 'warning', title: 'Faskes Rujukan Wajib', text: 'Silakan isi nama Rumah Sakit / Faskes tujuan rujukan.' });
      return;
    }

    const confirmRes = await Swal.fire({
      title: 'Konfirmasi Selesai Penanganan UGD?',
      text: `Pasien ${selectedPatient.namaAnonim || selectedPatient.pasien?.namaLengkap} akan diselesaikan dengan keputusan: ${keputusan}. Tempat tidur UGD akan otomatis dibebaskan kembali.`,
      icon: 'question',
      showCancelButton: true,
      confirmButtonText: 'Ya, Selesaikan & Discharge',
      cancelButtonText: 'Batal',
      confirmButtonColor: '#dc2626'
    });

    if (!confirmRes.isConfirmed) return;

    setIsSavingPemeriksaan(true);
    try {
      await ugdService.simpanPemeriksaan(selectedPatient.id, {
        keluhanUtama: pemeriksaanForm.keluhanUtama,
        riwayatPenyakit: pemeriksaanForm.riwayatPenyakit,
        pemeriksaanFisik: pemeriksaanForm.pemeriksaanFisik,
        rencanaTerapi: pemeriksaanForm.rencanaTerapi,
        instruksiMedis: pemeriksaanForm.instruksiMedis,
        hanyaObservasi: false,
        keputusan,
        alasanKeputusan: catatanBangsal || alasanRujukan || '',
        tempatTidurInapId: keputusan === 'RAWAT_INAP' ? selectedInapBedId : undefined,
        catatanBangsal: keputusan === 'RAWAT_INAP' ? catatanBangsal : undefined,
        rujukanData: keputusan === 'DIRUJUK' ? {
          faskesTujuan: faskesRujukan,
          alasanRujukan: alasanRujukan || 'Kebutuhan fasilitas rujukan lanjutan'
        } : undefined,
        diagnosaList: pemeriksaanForm.diagnosaAwal ? [{
          kode_icd10: 'R69',
          nama_diagnosis: pemeriksaanForm.diagnosaAwal,
          jenis: 'PRIMER'
        }] : [],
        tindakanList: selectedProsedur.map(p => ({
          id_icd9: p.id_icd9 || p.icd9Id,
          icd9Id: p.icd9Id || p.id_icd9,
          kode_icd9: p.kode_icd9,
          nama_prosedur: p.nama_prosedur,
          pelaksana: p.pelaksana || 'Dokter',
          tipePelaksanaan: p.tipePelaksanaan || 'INTERNAL',
          faskesRujukan: p.faskesRujukan || '',
          alasanRujukan: p.alasanRujukan || '',
          catatan: p.catatan || '',
          bmhpDetails: p.bmhpDetails || [],
          alkesDetails: p.alkesDetails || []
        }))
      });

      await Swal.fire({
        icon: 'success',
        title: 'Penanganan UGD Selesai!',
        text: `Pasien berhasil di-discharge (${keputusan}) oleh Dokter DPJP. Tempat tidur UGD kini berstatus TERSEDIA kembali.`
      });

      // Bersihkan draft pasien yang selesai
      if (selectedPatient.id) {
        delete draftsByPatientRef.current[selectedPatient.id];
        setDraftsByPatient({ ...draftsByPatientRef.current });
      }
      setSelectedPatient(null);
      selectedPatientRef.current = null;
      setActivePatientId(null);
      activePatientIdRef.current = null;

      await fetchData(false);
    } catch (err: any) {
      Swal.fire({
        icon: 'error',
        title: 'Gagal Menyimpan Rekam Medis',
        text: err.response?.data?.message || err.message || 'Terjadi kesalahan sistem'
      });
    } finally {
      setIsSavingPemeriksaan(false);
    }
  };

  // Otorisasi Kepemilikan DPJP Pasien UGD:
  const isMyPatient = Boolean(
    user?.id && selectedPatient && (
      selectedPatient.dokterTujuanId === String(user.id) ||
      selectedPatient.dokterTujuan?.id === String(user.id)
    )
  );

  const isAdmin = user?.role === 'ADMIN' || (user?.role as string) === 'SUPERADMIN';
  const canEditMedis = isDokter && (isMyPatient || isAdmin);
  const isReadOnlyForOtherDoctor = isDokter && !isMyPatient && !isAdmin;

  // Handler operan jaga / alihkan DPJP ke dokter yang sedang aktif
  const handleTakeOverPatient = async () => {
    if (!selectedPatient) return;
    const result = await Swal.fire({
      title: 'Alihkan Pasien ke Anda?',
      text: `Pasien ${selectedPatient.namaAnonim || selectedPatient.pasien?.namaLengkap} akan dialihkan ke Anda sebagai Dokter DPJP. Akses pengisian SOAP medis akan dibuka untuk Anda.`,
      icon: 'question',
      showCancelButton: true,
      confirmButtonColor: '#e11d48',
      cancelButtonColor: '#6b7280',
      confirmButtonText: 'Ya, Ambil Alih Pasien',
      cancelButtonText: 'Batal'
    });

    if (result.isConfirmed) {
      try {
        await ugdService.updateTriase(selectedPatient.id, {
          dokterId: String(user?.id)
        });
        await Swal.fire({
          icon: 'success',
          title: 'Berhasil Dialihkan',
          text: 'Anda sekarang resmi menjadi Dokter DPJP untuk pasien ini. Silakan lanjutkan pemeriksaan SOAP.',
          timer: 1800,
          showConfirmButton: false
        });
        await fetchData(false);
      } catch (err: any) {
        Swal.fire({
          icon: 'error',
          title: 'Gagal Mengalihkan Pasien',
          text: err.response?.data?.message || err.message || 'Terjadi kesalahan sistem'
        });
      }
    }
  };

  const availableUGDBeds = beds.filter(b => b.statusBed === 'TERSEDIA');

  return (
    <div className="flex h-full bg-gray-50 overflow-hidden">

      {/* ============================================================ */}
      {/* LEFT PANEL: UGD QUEUE & BED STATUS */}
      {/* ============================================================ */}
      <div className="w-96 bg-white border-r border-gray-200 flex flex-col h-full shadow-sm z-10">

        {/* Header Panel */}
        <div className="p-4 border-b border-gray-200 bg-rose-50/70">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
            <h2 className="text-base font-black text-rose-800 flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <AlertOctagon className="w-5 h-5 text-rose-600" />
              UGD / Gawat Darurat
            </h2>
            <button
              onClick={() => fetchData(false)}
              title="Segarkan Antrean"
              className="p-1 text-gray-500 hover:text-rose-700 transition-colors"
            >
              <RefreshCw className={`w-4 h-4 ${isLoading ? 'animate-spin text-rose-600' : ''}`} />
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Quick Admit Button */}
          <button
            onClick={handleOpenAdmitModal}
            className="w-full mt-1 px-4 py-2.5 bg-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-700 text-white font-bold text-xs uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center justify-center gap-2 shadow-sm rounded-none transition-all"
          >
            <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
            Quick Triage Pasien Darurat
          </button>

          {/* Status Bed Ringkas */}
          <div className="mt-3 grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 text-[11px]">
            <div className="bg-white p-2 border border-gray-200 text-gray-700 flex justify-between items-center">
              <span>Bed Tersedia:</span>
              <strong className="text-emerald-600 text-xs">{availableUGDBeds.length}</strong>
            </div>
            <div className="bg-white p-2 border border-gray-200 text-gray-700 flex justify-between items-center">
              <span>Bed Terisi:</span>
              <strong className="text-rose-600 text-xs">{beds.length - availableUGDBeds.length}</strong>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Tab Filter Antrean: Pasien Saya vs Semua Pasien UGD */}
        <div className="flex border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 text-xs font-bold">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setQueueFilter('my')}
            className={`flex-1 py-2.5 px-3 text-center border-b-2 transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 ${queueFilter === 'my'
                ? 'border-rose-600 text-rose-700 bg-white shadow-sm'
                : 'border-transparent text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-800 hover:bg-gray-100'
              }`}
          >
            <span>Pasien Saya</span>
            <span className={`text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded-full font-mono ${queueFilter === 'my' ? 'bg-rose-100 text-rose-700 font-bold' : 'bg-gray-200 text-gray-600'
              }`}>
              {myQueue.length}
            </span>
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setQueueFilter('all')}
            className={`flex-1 py-2.5 px-3 text-center border-b-2 transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 ${queueFilter === 'all'
                ? 'border-rose-600 text-rose-700 bg-white shadow-sm'
                : 'border-transparent text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-800 hover:bg-gray-100'
              }`}
          >
            <span>Semua UGD</span>
            <span className={`text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded-full font-mono ${queueFilter === 'all' ? 'bg-rose-100 text-rose-700 font-bold' : 'bg-gray-200 text-gray-600'
              }`}>
              {queue.length}
            </span>
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-2 space-y-2">
          {displayedQueue.map((patient) => {
            const isSelected = selectedPatient?.id === patient.id;
            const currentBed = patient.tempatTidurs?.[0];
            const scr = getScreeningData(patient);
            const triageColor = patient.triase || scr?.kategoriTriage || 'MERAH';
            const isAssignedToMe = Boolean(user?.id && (patient.dokterTujuanId === String(user.id) || patient.dokterTujuan?.id === String(user.id)));

            return (
              <div
                key={patient.id}
                onClick={() => selectPatientWithDraft(patient)}
                className={`p-3.5 border-l-4 cursor-pointer transition-all ${isSelected
                    ? 'border-l-rose-600 bg-rose-50/60 shadow-md border-y border-r border-rose-200'
                    : 'border-l-transparent border-y border-r border-gray-200 hover:bg-gray-50'
                  }`}
              >
                <div className="flex justify-between items-start mb-1.5">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <span className="text-xs font-mono font-bold text-gray-700 bg-gray-100 px-1.5 py-0.5">
                      {patient.noAntrian}
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-[11px] text-gray-400 font-mono">{patient.jamRegistrasi}</span>
                  </div>
                  <span className={`text-[10px] px-2 py-0.5 font-black uppercase rounded shadow-sm ${getTriageColor(triageColor)}`}>
                    {triageColor}
                  </span>
                </div>

                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <h3 className="font-bold text-gray-900 text-sm truncate">
                    {patient.namaAnonim || patient.pasien?.namaLengkap}
                  </h3>
                  {patient.isAnonim && (
                    <span className="text-[9px] font-bold px-1 py-0.2 bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 border border-amber-300 rounded">
                      Anonim
                    </span>
                  )}
                </div>

                <div className="mt-1 flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
                  <span className="text-blue-700 font-semibold flex items-center gap-1">
                    <BedDouble className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-blue-500" />
                    {currentBed ? currentBed.nomorBed : 'Bed UGD'}
                  </span>
                  <span className={`text-[10px] font-bold px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded ${patient.statusAdministrasi === 'LENGKAP'
                      ? 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800'
                      : 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-800'
                    }`}>
                    {patient.statusAdministrasi === 'LENGKAP' ? 'Admin Lengkap' : 'Pending Loket'}
                  </span>
                </div>

                <div className="mt-1.5 pt-1.5 border-t border-gray-100 flex items-center justify-between text-[11px]">
                  <span className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 truncate max-w-[170px] ${isAssignedToMe ? 'text-emerald-700 font-bold' : 'text-slate-700 font-medium'}`} title={patient.dokterTujuan?.namaLengkap || 'Belum di-assign'}>
                    <Stethoscope className={`w-3 h-3 flex-shrink-0 ${isAssignedToMe ? 'text-emerald-600' : 'text-slate-500'}`} />
                    {isAssignedToMe ? (
                      <span className="flex items-center gap-1 font-bold text-emerald-800">
                        <Star className="w-3 h-3 fill-emerald-600 text-emerald-600" /> Pasien Anda
                      </span>
                    ) : (
                      `DPJP: ${patient.dokterTujuan?.namaLengkap || 'Belum di-assign'}`
                    )}
                  </span>
                  <span className={`text-[9px] font-bold px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded ${isAssignedToMe
                      ? 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 border border-emerald-300'
                      : patient.statusKunjungan === 'MENUNGGU_DOKTER'
                        ? 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 border border-amber-200'
                        : 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-700'
                    }`}>
                    {isAssignedToMe ? 'Perlu Diperiksa' : (patient.statusKunjungan === 'MENUNGGU_DOKTER' ? 'Menunggu DPJP' : patient.statusKunjungan)}
                  </span>
                </div>

                <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-1 line-clamp-1 italic">
                  {scr?.keluhanUtama || patient.keluhanUtama || patient.kondisiTiba || 'Kondisi kegawatdaruratan'}
                </p>

                {isDokter && (
                <div className="mt-2 pt-1.5 border-t border-gray-100 flex items-center justify-between">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={(e) => {
                      e.stopPropagation();
                      router.push(`/dokter/rawat-jalan?kunjunganId=${patient.id}`);
                    }}
                    className="w-full py-1.5 px-2 bg-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-800 text-white text-[11px] font-bold rounded-none flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 transition-colors shadow-2xs"
                  >
                    <Stethoscope className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-400" />
                    <span>Buka SOAP di RME Dokter</span>
                    <ArrowRight className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-400" />
                  </button>
                </div>
              )}
              </div>
            );
          })}

          {displayedQueue.length === 0 && !isLoading && (
            <div className="py-16 text-center text-gray-400 px-4">
              <CheckCircle2 className="w-10 h-10 mx-auto mb-2 text-gray-300" />
              <p className="font-bold text-gray-700 text-sm">
                {queueFilter === 'my' ? 'Tidak Ada Pasien yang Di-assign ke Anda' : 'Tidak Ada Pasien Aktif di UGD'}
              </p>
              <p className="text-xs text-gray-400 mt-1">
                {queueFilter === 'my'
                  ? 'Pasien baru akan muncul setelah perawat melakukan triase awal dan memilih Anda sebagai DPJP.'
                  : 'Gunakan tombol Quick Triage jika pasien gawat darurat baru tiba.'}
              </p>
              {queueFilter === 'my' && queue.length > 0 && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setQueueFilter('all')}
                  className="mt-3 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-rose-700 bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 hover:bg-rose-100 transition-colors"
                >
                  Lihat Semua Pasien UGD ({queue.length})
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* ============================================================ */}
      {/* RIGHT PANEL: MAIN FORM & EXAMINATION */}
      {/* ============================================================ */}
      <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col h-full bg-gray-50 overflow-hidden">
        {selectedPatient ? (
          <>
            {/* Header Pasien UGD Terpilih */}
            {(() => {
              const activeScr = getScreeningData(selectedPatient);
              const activeTriage = selectedPatient.triase || activeScr?.kategoriTriage || 'MERAH';
              return (
                <div className={`p-4 border-b border-gray-200 shadow-sm flex justify-between items-center text-white ${activeTriage === 'MERAH' ? 'bg-red-700' :
                    activeTriage === 'KUNING' ? 'bg-yellow-500 text-black' :
                      activeTriage === 'HIJAU' ? 'bg-green-700' : 'bg-gray-900'
                  }`}>
                  <div className="flex items-center">
                    <div className="w-12 h-12 flex items-center justify-center font-black text-xl mr-4 border-2 border-white/40 bg-black/15">
                      {(selectedPatient.namaAnonim || selectedPatient.pasien?.namaLengkap || 'X').charAt(0)}
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <h1 className="text-xl font-black">
                          {selectedPatient.namaAnonim || selectedPatient.pasien?.namaLengkap}
                        </h1>
                        {selectedPatient.isAnonim && (
                          <span className="text-[10px] bg-black/30 text-white font-bold uppercase px-2 py-0.5 rounded">
                            Pasien Anonim (Mr./Mrs. X)
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-xs opacity-90 flex items-center mt-1 font-medium gap-3 flex-wrap">
                        <span className="font-mono bg-black/20 px-1.5 py-0.5">
                          Antrean: {selectedPatient.noAntrian}
                        </span>
                        <span>
                          Bed: {selectedPatient.tempatTidurs?.[0]?.nomorBed || 'UGD'}
                        </span>
                        <span>
                          Gender: {selectedPatient.pasien?.jenisKelamin || '-'}
                        </span>
                        <span className="font-bold uppercase tracking-wider">
                          TRIASE: {activeTriage}
                        </span>
                        <span className="bg-black/25 px-2 py-0.5 rounded font-bold text-yellow-200 flex items-center gap-1">
                          <Stethoscope className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                          DPJP: dr. {selectedPatient.dokterTujuan?.namaLengkap || 'Belum di-assign'}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="text-right flex flex-col items-end gap-1.5">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <span className="text-[11px] opacity-80 font-mono">
                        Tiba: {selectedPatient.jamRegistrasi || '-'}
                      </span>
                      <span className={`px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-bold uppercase rounded shadow-xs flex items-center gap-1 ${selectedPatient.statusAdministrasi === 'LENGKAP'
                          ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white'
                          : 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-900 border border-amber-300'
                        }`}>
                        {selectedPatient.statusAdministrasi === 'LENGKAP' ? (
                          <><Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> BERKAS LENGKAP</>
                        ) : (
                          <><AlertTriangle className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-700" /> PENDING DI LOKET</>
                        )}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 mt-1">
                      {/* Tombol Akses Cepat ke RME Dokter SOAP (Hanya Dokter) */}
                      {isDokter && (
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => router.push(`/dokter/rawat-jalan?kunjunganId=${selectedPatient.id}`)}
                          className="px-3.5 py-1.5 bg-white text-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-100 font-bold text-xs uppercase tracking-wider rounded shadow-md flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors"
                        >
                          <Stethoscope className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600" />
                          <span>Buka Pemeriksaan SOAP di RME Dokter</span>
                          <ArrowRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-500" />
                        </button>
                      )}

                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => {
                          setSelectedPatient(null);
                          selectedPatientRef.current = null;
                          setActivePatientId(null);
                          activePatientIdRef.current = null;
                        }}
                        className="p-1.5 bg-black/25 hover:bg-black/40 text-white rounded shadow transition-colors"
                        title="Tutup Pasien Ini (Kembali ke Antrean Kosong)"
                      >
                        <X className="w-4 h-4" />
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              );
            })()}

            {/* Alert Banner jika dibuka oleh Dokter Lain yang BUKAN DPJP */}
            {isReadOnlyForOtherDoctor && (
              <div className="bg-amber-600 text-white px-4 py-3 flex items-center justify-between text-xs shadow-md">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">

                  <div>
                    <span className="font-bold uppercase tracking-wider block">Bukan Pasien DPJP Anda (Mode Hanya Lihat)</span>
                    <span className="opacity-95">
                      Pasien ini di-assign ke <strong>{selectedPatient.dokterTujuan?.namaLengkap || 'Dokter Lain'}</strong>. Anda tidak dapat mengisi pemeriksaan SOAP atau memutuskan discharge kecuali dilakukan operan jaga.
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handleTakeOverPatient}
                  className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-white text-amber-900 font-bold text-xs uppercase tracking-wider shadow hover:bg-amber-50 transition-colors whitespace-nowrap flex items-center gap-1.5 ml-4"

                  <UserCheck className="w-4 h-4" />

            {/* Notification / Context Banner Pemisahan Wewenang */}
            <div className={`px-4 py-2.5 text-xs flex items-center justify-between border-b ${isPerawat
                ? 'bg-amber-50 text-amber-900 border-amber-200'
                : isReadOnlyForOtherDoctor
                  ? 'bg-amber-50/80 text-amber-950 border-amber-300'
                  : 'bg-blue-50 text-blue-900 border-blue-200'

              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <span className={`px-2 py-0.5 font-bold uppercase rounded text-[10px] ${isPerawat ? 'bg-amber-600 text-white' : isReadOnlyForOtherDoctor ? 'bg-amber-700 text-white' : 'bg-blue-600 text-white'

                <span className="font-medium">
                  {isPerawat
                    ? 'Wewenang Perawat: Melakukan Quick Triage, observasi tanda vital, dan assign Dokter DPJP. Pasien selanjutnya diperiksa oleh dokter untuk SOAP dan keputusan tindak lanjut.'
                    : isReadOnlyForOtherDoctor
                      ? `Status Akses: Anda sedang melihat pasien milik dr. ${selectedPatient.dokterTujuan?.namaLengkap || 'DPJP lain'}. Form SOAP terkunci untuk mencegah tumpang tindih rekam medis.`
                      : 'Wewenang Anda (DPJP): Meninjau Triase Perawat, mengisi SOAP Medis, Diagnosa ICD-10, Terapi, serta memutuskan Rencana Tindak Lanjut / Discharge.'}
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-gray-600">
                Alur Pasien: <strong className={selectedPatient.statusKunjungan === 'MENUNGGU_DOKTER' ? 'text-amber-700' : 'text-blue-700'}>
                  {selectedPatient.statusKunjungan === 'MENUNGGU_DOKTER' ? 'Menunggu Pemeriksaan Dokter DPJP' : selectedPatient.statusKunjungan}
                </strong>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Form Tabs */}
            <div className="flex border-b border-gray-200 bg-white shadow-sm z-10">
              <button

              >
                1. Triage & Tanda Vital Awal

              <button

                  }`}
              >
                2. Pemeriksaan Medis (SOAP)
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={() => setActiveTab('keputusan')}

                    ? 'border-emerald-600 text-emerald-700 bg-emerald-50/40'
                    : 'border-transparent text-gray-500 hover:bg-gray-50'
                  }`}
              >
                3. Keputusan & Discharge
              </button>
            </div>

            {/* Form Content Area */}
            <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-6 bg-gray-100">

              {/* TAB 1: TRIAGE & VITAL SIGNS */}
              {activeTab === 'triage' && (
                <div className="space-y-6 max-w-5xl mx-auto">
                  <div className="bg-white p-6 shadow-sm border border-gray-200">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b pb-3 mb-4">
                      <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-gray-900 flex items-center">
                        <Activity className="w-5 h-5 mr-2 text-red-600" />
                        Hasil Triase Cepat Saat Pasien Tiba di UGD
                      </h3>
                      {isDokter && (
                        <button
                          onClick={() => router.push(`/dokter/rawat-jalan?kunjunganId=${selectedPatient.id}`)}
                          className="px-3.5 py-1.5 bg-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-800 text-white text-xs font-bold rounded flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors shadow-xs"
                        >
                          <Stethoscope className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400" />
                          <span>Buka SOAP di RME Dokter</span>
                          <ArrowRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400" />

                      )}
                    </div>

                    {(() => {
                      const s = getScreeningData(selectedPatient);
                      if (!s) {
                        return (
                          <div className="p-8 bg-gray-50 border border-gray-200 text-center">
                            <AlertTriangle className="w-8 h-8 text-amber-500 mx-auto mb-2" />
                            <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-700">Data triase awal belum tercatat lengkap.</p>
                            <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-1">Belum ada data pemeriksaan triase & vital signs untuk kunjungan ini.</p>
                          </div>
                        );
                      }

                      const kesadaran = (s.dataTambahan as any)?.kesadaran || (s as any).kesadaran || 'Compos Mentis';
                      const triageCat = s.kategoriTriage || selectedPatient.triase || 'MERAH';

                      return (
                        <>
                          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
                            <div className="bg-gray-50 p-4 border border-gray-200 space-y-3">
                              <h4 className="font-bold text-gray-700 text-xs uppercase tracking-wider">
                                Tanda-Tanda Vital Saat Pasien Tiba
                              </h4>
                              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 text-xs">
                                <div>
                                  <span className="text-gray-500 block">Tekanan Darah:</span>
                                  <strong className="text-sm text-gray-900 font-mono">
                                    {s.tekananDarahSistolik || '-'}/{s.tekananDarahDiastolik || '-'} mmHg
                                  </strong>
                                </div>
                                <div>
                                  <span className="text-gray-500 block">Denyut Nadi:</span>
                                  <strong className="text-sm text-gray-900 font-mono">
                                    {s.nadi ? `${s.nadi} x/mnt` : '-'}
                                  </strong>
                                </div>
                                <div>
                                  <span className="text-gray-500 block">Frekuensi Pernapasan:</span>
                                  <strong className="text-sm text-gray-900 font-mono">
                                    {s.frekuensiNapas ? `${s.frekuensiNapas} x/mnt` : '-'}
                                  </strong>
                                </div>
                                <div>
                                  <span className="text-gray-500 block">Suhu Tubuh:</span>
                                  <strong className="text-sm text-gray-900 font-mono">
                                    {s.suhuTubuh ? `${s.suhuTubuh} °C` : '-'}
                                  </strong>
                                </div>
                                <div>
                                  <span className="text-gray-500 block">SpO2 (Saturasi O2):</span>

                                    {s.saturasiOksigen ? `${s.saturasiOksigen}%` : '-'}
                                  </strong>
                                </div>
                                <div>
                                  <span className="text-gray-500 block">Tingkat Kesadaran:</span>
                                  <strong className="text-sm text-gray-900 font-mono">
                                    {kesadaran}
                                  </strong>
                                </div>
                                <div>
                                  <span className="text-gray-500 block">Tingkat Nyeri:</span>
                                  <strong className="text-sm text-gray-900 font-mono">
                                    Skala {s.skalaNyeri ?? '0'} / 10
                                  </strong>
                                </div>
                                <div>
                                  <span className="text-gray-500 block">Kategori Triase:</span>

                                    {triageCat}
                                  </span>
                                </div>
                              </div>
                            </div>

                            <div className="bg-gray-50 p-4 border border-gray-200 space-y-3">
                              <h4 className="font-bold text-gray-700 text-xs uppercase tracking-wider">
                                Kedatangan & Penugasan Medis
                              </h4>
                              <div className="space-y-2 text-xs">
                                <div>
                                  <span className="text-gray-500 block">Petugas Perawat Triase:</span>
                                  <span className="font-semibold text-gray-800">{s.petugas || selectedPatient.userPendaftar?.namaLengkap || 'Perawat UGD'}</span>
                                </div>
                                <div>
                                  <span className="text-gray-500 block">Dokter DPJP yang Di-assign:</span>
                                  <span className="font-bold text-indigo-700 flex items-center gap-1 mt-0.5">
                                    <Stethoscope className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-indigo-500" />
                                    dr. {selectedPatient.dokterTujuan?.namaLengkap || 'Belum di-assign'}
                                  </span>
                                </div>
                                <div>
                                  <span className="text-gray-500 block">Cara Kedatangan:</span>
                                  <span className="font-semibold text-gray-800">{s.jenisKedatangan || selectedPatient.caraDatang || 'Ambulans'}</span>
                                </div>
                                <div>
                                  <span className="text-gray-500 block">Waktu Triase:</span>
                                  <span className="font-semibold text-gray-800 font-mono">
                                    {s.tanggalScreening ? new Date(s.tanggalScreening).toLocaleTimeString('id-ID', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }) : selectedPatient.jamRegistrasi || '-'} WIB
                                  </span>
                                </div>
                                <div>
                                  <span className="text-gray-500 block">Keluhan Utama Saat Masuk:</span>
                                  <p className="font-medium text-rose-700 bg-white p-2 border border-gray-200 mt-1">
                                    {s.keluhanUtama || selectedPatient.keluhanUtama || selectedPatient.kondisiTiba || '-'}
                                  </p>
                                </div>
                              </div>
                            </div>
                          </div>

                          {/* Form Observasi Tanda Vital Lanjutan Khusus Perawat UGD */}
                          {isPerawat && (
                            <div className="mt-6 pt-5 border-t border-gray-200 bg-amber-50/50 p-4 border border-amber-200">
                              <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
                                <div>
                                  <h4 className="font-bold text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-amber-900 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                                    <HeartPulse className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-600" />
                                    Update Observasi Tanda Vital Berkala & Triase (Perawat UGD)
                                  </h4>
                                  <p className="text-[11px] text-amber-700 mt-0.5">
                                    Perbarui tanda vital berkala jika ada perubahan kondisi selama observasi di Bed UGD

                                  type="button"

                                >
                                  <HeartPulse className="w-4 h-4" />

                              </div>
