'use client';

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { 
  Users, 
  TestTubes, 
  CheckCircle2, 
  Activity,
  ArrowRight,
  Clock,
  Calendar,
  ClipboardList,
  AlertCircle,
  Loader2,
  RefreshCw,
  Info
} from 'lucide-react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { useAuthStore } from '@/store/auth.store';
import { laboratoriumService } from '@/services/laboratorium.service';

export default function LaboratoriumDashboard() {
  const { user } = useAuthStore();
  const [currentTime, setCurrentTime] = useState('');
  const [isClient, setIsClient] = useState(false);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);

  // Data riil dari backend
  const [dashboardData, setDashboardData] = useState<{
    stats: {
      totalHariIni: number;
      menunggu: number;
      sedangDilayani: number;
      selesai: number;
    };
    chartData: { day: string; date: string; count: number }[];
    selesaiTerakhir: any[];
  }>({
    stats: {
      totalHariIni: 0,
      menunggu: 0,
      sedangDilayani: 0,
      selesai: 0,
    },
    chartData: [],
    selesaiTerakhir: [],
  });

  const fetchStats = async () => {
    try {
      setIsLoading(true);
      const res = await laboratoriumService.getDashboardStats();
      if (res && res.success && res.data) {
        setDashboardData(res.data);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Gagal mengambil data dashboard laboratorium:', err);
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    setIsClient(true);
    const tick = () => setCurrentTime(new Date().toLocaleTimeString('id-ID', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', second: '2-digit' }));
    tick();
    const interval = setInterval(tick, 1000);
    fetchStats();
    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, []);

  const stats = dashboardData.stats;
  const chartData = dashboardData.chartData;
  const rawMax = Math.max(...chartData.map(d => d.count), 0);
  const maxCount = rawMax > 0 ? rawMax : 5; // Default skala 5 jika masih 0 agar grafik rapi

  if (!isClient) return null;

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-50 animate-in fade-in duration-500">
      {/* ── HERO HEADER ── */}
      <div className="relative bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-700 via-indigo-600 to-indigo-500 overflow-hidden">
        <div className="absolute inset-0 opacity-10">
          <div className="absolute top-0 right-0 w-96 h-96 bg-white rounded-full -translate-y-1/2 translate-x-1/3" />
          <div className="absolute bottom-0 left-1/3 w-64 h-64 bg-white rounded-full translate-y-1/2" />
        </div>

        <div className="relative max-w-screen-2xl mx-auto px-6 py-6 flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-6">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-5">
            <div>
              <h1 className="text-2xl md:text-3xl font-extrabold text-white tracking-tight">Dashboard Laboratorium</h1>
              <p className="text-indigo-100 text-sm mt-1 flex items-center gap-2">
                <Activity className="w-4 h-4" />
                {user?.namaLengkap || user?.username || 'Analis Laboratorium'}
                <span className="mx-1 text-indigo-300">•</span>
                <Calendar className="w-4 h-4" />
                {new Date().toLocaleDateString('id-ID', { weekday: 'long', day: 'numeric', month: 'long', year: 'numeric' })}
                <span className="mx-1 text-indigo-300">•</span>
                <Clock className="w-4 h-4" />{currentTime}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <button
            onClick={fetchStats}
            disabled={isLoading}
            className="self-start md:self-auto flex items-center gap-2 px-3.5 py-2 bg-indigo-600/70 hover:bg-indigo-600 text-white text-xs font-semibold rounded-none border border-indigo-400/40 transition-colors shadow-sm"
            title="Refresh Data"
          >
            <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${isLoading ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
            <span>Segarkan Data</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="max-w-screen-2xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 py-6 space-y-6">
        {/* STATS */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
          {/* Card 1 */}
          <div className="bg-white border border-gray-200 shadow-sm p-6 relative overflow-hidden flex flex-col justify-between rounded-none">
            <div className="absolute top-6 right-6 w-10 h-10 bg-indigo-100 flex items-center justify-center rounded-none">
              <Users className="w-5 h-5 text-indigo-600" />
            </div>
            
            <div className="relative z-10">
              <p className="text-[11px] font-bold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">Total Order Uji Lab</p>
              <h3 className="text-4xl font-extrabold text-gray-900">
                {isLoading ? <Loader2 className="w-8 h-8 animate-spin text-indigo-600" /> : stats.totalHariIni}
              </h3>
              <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 mt-1">Hari ini dari rawat jalan / IGD</p>
            </div>
            
            <div className="relative z-10 mt-6 flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500">
              <span>{stats.totalHariIni > 0 ? `${stats.totalHariIni} pasien terdaftar hari ini` : 'Belum ada order masuk hari ini'}</span>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Card 2 */}
          <div className="bg-white border border-gray-200 shadow-sm p-6 relative overflow-hidden flex flex-col justify-between rounded-none">
            <div className="absolute top-6 right-6 w-10 h-10 bg-amber-100 flex items-center justify-center rounded-none">
              <Clock className="w-5 h-5 text-amber-600" />
            </div>
            
            <div className="relative z-10">
              <p className="text-[11px] font-bold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">Antrean Aktif</p>
              <h3 className="text-4xl font-extrabold text-gray-900">
                {isLoading ? <Loader2 className="w-8 h-8 animate-spin text-amber-600" /> : stats.menunggu}
              </h3>
              <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 mt-1">Menunggu diambil sampel</p>
            </div>
            
            <div className="relative z-10 mt-6 flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-amber-600">
              <div className="w-2 h-2 rounded-none bg-amber-400"></div>
              <span>{stats.sedangDilayani} spesimen sedang diproses analis</span>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Card 3 */}
          <div className="bg-white border border-gray-200 shadow-sm p-6 relative overflow-hidden flex flex-col justify-between rounded-none">
            <div className="absolute top-6 right-6 w-10 h-10 bg-emerald-100 flex items-center justify-center rounded-none">
              <CheckCircle2 className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-600" />
            </div>
            
            <div className="relative z-10">
              <p className="text-[11px] font-bold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">Selesai Diuji</p>
              <h3 className="text-4xl font-extrabold text-gray-900">
                {isLoading ? <Loader2 className="w-8 h-8 animate-spin text-emerald-600" /> : stats.selesai}
              </h3>
              <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 mt-1">Hasil telah dikirim ke dokter</p>
            </div>
            
            <div className="relative z-10 mt-6 flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-emerald-600">
              <span>
                {stats.totalHariIni > 0 
                  ? `${Math.round((stats.selesai / stats.totalHariIni) * 100)}% dari total order hari ini` 
                  : 'Siap melayani pemeriksaan baru'}
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
          
          {/* MAIN COLUMN - CHARTS & TABLE */}
          <div className="lg:col-span-2 space-y-6">
            
            {/* Chart 7 Hari Terakhir */}
            <div className="bg-white border border-gray-200 shadow-sm rounded-none overflow-hidden p-6">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-6">
                <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-gray-900 flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Activity className="w-5 h-5 text-indigo-600" />
                  Statistik Pemeriksaan (7 Hari Terakhir)
                </h3>
                <span className="text-[11px] text-gray-400 font-medium">Data Nyata Database</span>
              </div>

              {isLoading ? (
                <div className="h-64 flex items-center justify-center">
                  <Loader2 className="w-8 h-8 animate-spin text-indigo-600" />
                </div>
              ) : chartData.length > 0 ? (
                <div className="h-64 flex items-end justify-between gap-2">
                  {chartData.map((d, i) => {
                    const heightPercentage = rawMax > 0 ? (d.count / maxCount) * 100 : 0;
                    return (
                      <div key={i} className="flex flex-col items-center flex-1 group h-full">
                        <div className="w-full relative flex justify-center h-full items-end pb-2">
                          {/* Value Label */}
                          <div className={`absolute -top-6 text-xs font-bold ${d.count > 0 ? 'text-indigo-700' : 'text-gray-400'}`}>
                            {d.count}
                          </div>
                          {/* Bar */}
                          <div 
                            className={`w-full max-w-[40px] rounded-none transition-all duration-300 ${
                              d.count > 0 
                                ? 'bg-indigo-500 group-hover:bg-indigo-600' 
                                : 'bg-gray-100 h-1.5'
                            }`}
                            style={{ height: d.count > 0 ? `${Math.max(heightPercentage, 8)}%` : '6px' }}
                          ></div>
                        </div>
                        <span className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-500 uppercase mt-2">{d.day}</span>
                      </div>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div className="h-64 flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-gray-400 text-xs">
                  <Activity className="w-8 h-8 mb-2 opacity-50" />
                  <span>Belum ada data riwayat pemeriksaan 7 hari terakhir.</span>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* Tabel Ringkasan Terakhir */}
            <div className="bg-white border border-gray-200 shadow-sm rounded-none overflow-hidden">
              <div className="px-6 py-4 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 flex items-center justify-between">
                <div>
                  <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-gray-900 flex items-center gap-2">
                    <CheckCircle2 className="w-5 h-5 text-indigo-600" />
                    Pemeriksaan Selesai Terakhir
                  </h2>
                  <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-1">Daftar spesimen yang telah selesai diuji dan dikirim ke dokter.</p>
                </div>
                <Link href="/laboratorium/antrian" className="text-sm font-medium text-indigo-600 hover:text-indigo-800 flex items-center gap-1">
                  Lihat Antrean <ArrowRight className="w-4 h-4" />
                </Link>
              </div>

              <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                <table className="w-full text-sm text-left text-gray-600">
                  <thead className="text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 bg-white border-b border-gray-200 uppercase tracking-wider">
                    <tr>
                      <th className="px-6 py-3">Waktu Selesai</th>
                      <th className="px-6 py-3">Nama Pasien</th>
                      <th className="px-6 py-3">Dokter Pengirim</th>
                      <th className="px-6 py-3">Pemeriksaan</th>
                      <th className="px-6 py-3 text-right">Status</th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody className="divide-y divide-gray-100">
                    {dashboardData.selesaiTerakhir.length > 0 ? (
                      dashboardData.selesaiTerakhir.map((order) => {
                        const finishTime = order.updatedAt 
                          ? new Date(order.updatedAt).toLocaleTimeString('id-ID', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }) + ' WIB'
                          : '-';
                        return (
                          <tr key={order.id} className="hover:bg-indigo-50/50 transition-colors">
                            <td className="px-6 py-4 font-mono text-gray-500 whitespace-nowrap">{finishTime}</td>
                            <td className="px-6 py-4">
                              <div className="font-bold text-gray-900">{order.pasien?.namaLengkap || '-'}</div>
                              <div className="text-[11px] font-mono text-gray-400">RM: {order.pasien?.noRM || '-'}</div>
                            </td>
                            <td className="px-6 py-4 text-gray-700">{order.dokter?.namaLengkap || 'Dokter Pemeriksa'}</td>
                            <td className="px-6 py-4">
                              <span className="font-medium text-indigo-700">
                                {order.details?.length || 0} Parameter Uji
                              </span>
                            </td>
                            <td className="px-6 py-4 text-right">
                              <span className="bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 border border-emerald-200 px-2 py-1 rounded-none text-xs font-bold">
                                SELESAI
                              </span>
                            </td>
                          </tr>
                        );
                      })
                    ) : (
                      <tr>
                        <td colSpan={5} className="px-6 py-10 text-center text-gray-400 text-xs">
                          <ClipboardList className="w-8 h-8 mx-auto mb-2 opacity-40 text-gray-400" />
                          <span>Belum ada pemeriksaan laboratorium yang selesai.</span>
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    )}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>
            </div>

          </div>

          {/* SIDE COLUMN - QUICK LINKS & STATUS */}
          <div className="space-y-6">
            
            {/* Quick Links */}
            <div className="bg-white border border-gray-200 shadow-sm rounded-none">
              <div className="px-5 py-4 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50">
                <h2 className="text-sm font-bold text-gray-900">Akses Cepat Laboratorium</h2>
              </div>
              <div className="p-3 grid grid-cols-1 gap-2">
                <Link href="/laboratorium/antrian" className="p-4 border border-gray-200 hover:border-indigo-400 hover:bg-indigo-50/60 group flex items-center gap-3.5 transition-all rounded-none">
                  <div className="p-2.5 bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-600 group-hover:scale-105 transition-transform">
                    <ClipboardList className="w-5 h-5" />
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <h4 className="text-sm font-bold text-gray-800 group-hover:text-indigo-700">Antrean Uji Lab</h4>
                    <p className="text-xs text-gray-500">Buka antrean sampel & input hasil lab</p>
                  </div>
                </Link>

                <div className="p-4 border border-gray-100 bg-gray-50/50 flex items-center gap-3.5 rounded-none">
                  <div className="p-2.5 bg-slate-200 text-slate-600">
                    <TestTubes className="w-5 h-5" />
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <h4 className="text-sm font-bold text-gray-800">Alur Pemeriksaan</h4>
                    <p className="text-xs text-gray-500">Dokter buat order lab → Analis input hasil</p>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Status Operasional */}
            <div className="bg-white border border-gray-200 shadow-sm rounded-none">
              <div className="px-5 py-4 border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 flex items-center justify-between">
                <h2 className="text-sm font-bold text-gray-900">Status Operasional Lab</h2>
                <span className="bg-emerald-100 border border-emerald-200 text-emerald-700 text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-none">Aktif</span>
              </div>
              <div className="p-5 text-xs text-gray-600 space-y-3 leading-relaxed">
                <p>
                  Unit Laboratorium siap menerima spesimen medis. Semua rujukan uji laboratorium yang diorder oleh Dokter Poli Rawat Jalan atau UGD akan otomatis muncul di menu <b>Antrean Uji Lab</b>.
                </p>
                <div className="p-3 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 text-slate-800 text-xs">
                  <strong className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-slate-900 font-bold">
                    <Info className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-600" /> Catatan Alur:
                  </strong>
                  <ul className="list-disc pl-4 mt-1.5 space-y-1 text-[11px] text-slate-600">
                    <li>Dokter memilih parameter uji di tab <em>Laboratorium</em> saat periksa pasien.</li>
                    <li>Order masuk ke Lab → Petugas input hasil & klik <em>Kirim Hasil</em>.</li>
                    <li>Hasil lab langsung muncul di rekam medis dokter secara real-time.</li>
                  </ul>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

          </div>

        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import {
  FileText,
  Calendar,
  Users,
  Activity,
  Package,
  Wrench,
  Search,
  Filter,
  Download,
  Printer,
  RefreshCw,
  TrendingUp,
  AlertTriangle,
  CheckCircle2,
  ChevronRight,
  Layers,
  Building2,
  Stethoscope,
  BarChart3,
  PieChart,
  FileSpreadsheet,
  FileCheck,
  ShieldAlert,
  TrendingDown,
  ArrowDownRight,
  ArrowUpRight,
  History,
  UserCheck
} from 'lucide-react';
import Swal from 'sweetalert2';
import { laporanService } from '@/services/laporan.service';
import { klinikService } from '@/services/klinik.service';
import { Poliklinik } from '@/types/klinik.types';
import { exportTableToCsv } from '@/lib/exportCsv';
import CetakDokumenLaporanModal from '@/components/laporan/CetakDokumenLaporanModal';

type ActiveTab = 'kunjungan' | 'morbiditas' | 'bmhp' | 'alkes' | 'kinerja_nakes';
type PeriodType = 'hari_ini' | 'bulan_ini' | 'bulan_lalu' | 'tahun_ini' | 'custom';

export default function PusatLaporanFaskesPage() {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<ActiveTab>('kunjungan');
  const [periodType, setPeriodType] = useState<PeriodType>('bulan_ini');
  
  // Date range states
  const [startDate, setStartDate] = useState('');
  const [endDate, setEndDate] = useState('');
  
  // Additional filter states
  const [selectedPoli, setSelectedPoli] = useState('');
  const [bmhpSearch, setBmhpSearch] = useState('');
  const [bmhpStatus, setBmhpStatus] = useState('SEMUA');
  const [bmhpFilterMode, setBmhpFilterMode] = useState<'bermutasi' | 'semua' | 'kritis'>('bermutasi');
  const [alkesKondisi, setAlkesKondisi] = useState('');
  const [alkesFilterMode, setAlkesFilterMode] = useState<'digunakan' | 'semua'>('digunakan');
  const [nakesProfesi, setNakesProfesi] = useState('');
  const [nakesSearch, setNakesSearch] = useState('');
  const [nakesFilterMode, setNakesFilterMode] = useState<'aktif' | 'semua'>('aktif');
  
  // Master data
  const [poliList, setPoliList] = useState<Poliklinik[]>([]);
  
  // Data reports
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [reportData, setReportData] = useState<any>(null);
  
  // Modal Cetak Dokumen Resmi
  const [isCetakModalOpen, setIsCetakModalOpen] = useState(false);
  
  // Sub-view untuk Tab Kunjungan: 'rekap' | 'detail'
  const [kunjunganSubTab, setKunjunganSubTab] = useState<'rekap' | 'detail'>('rekap');

  // Helper Init Tanggal berdasarkan Preset (Local Timezone Safe)
  const applyPeriodPreset = useCallback((preset: PeriodType) => {
    const now = new Date();
    let s = '';
    let e = '';

    const formatDate = (d: Date) => {
      const year = d.getFullYear();
      const month = String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
      const day = String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
      return `${year}-${month}-${day}`;
    };

    if (preset === 'hari_ini') {
      s = formatDate(now);
      e = formatDate(now);
    } else if (preset === 'bulan_ini') {
      const firstDay = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), 1);
      const lastDay = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth() + 1, 0);
      s = formatDate(firstDay);
      e = formatDate(lastDay);
    } else if (preset === 'bulan_lalu') {
      const firstDay = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth() - 1, 1);
      const lastDay = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), 0);
      s = formatDate(firstDay);
      e = formatDate(lastDay);
    } else if (preset === 'tahun_ini') {
      s = `${now.getFullYear()}-01-01`;
      e = `${now.getFullYear()}-12-31`;
    }

    if (s && e) {
      setStartDate(s);
      setEndDate(e);
    }
  }, []);

  // Set default date range on mount
  useEffect(() => {
    applyPeriodPreset('bulan_ini');
    // Load poliklinik
    klinikService.getPoliklinik().then(res => {
      if (Array.isArray(res)) setPoliList(res);
    }).catch(() => {});
  }, [applyPeriodPreset]);

  // Load Data Report saat Tab atau Filter berubah
  const fetchReport = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!startDate || !endDate) return;
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      if (activeTab === 'kunjungan') {
        const res = await laporanService.getLaporanKunjungan({
          startDate,
          endDate,
          poliklinikId: selectedPoli || undefined,
          periode: periodType === 'hari_ini' ? 'harian' : (periodType === 'tahun_ini' ? 'tahunan' : 'bulanan')
        });
        if (res.success) setReportData(res.data);
      } else if (activeTab === 'morbiditas') {
        const res = await laporanService.getLaporanMorbiditas({
          startDate,
          endDate,
          poliklinikId: selectedPoli || undefined,
          limit: 20
        });
        if (res.success) setReportData(res.data);
      } else if (activeTab === 'bmhp') {
        const res = await laporanService.getLaporanBMHP({
          startDate,
          endDate,
          search: bmhpSearch || undefined,
          statusStok: bmhpStatus !== 'SEMUA' ? bmhpStatus : undefined,
          filterMode: bmhpFilterMode
        });
        if (res.success) setReportData(res.data);
      } else if (activeTab === 'alkes') {
        const res = await laporanService.getLaporanAlkes({
          startDate,
          endDate,
          kondisiAset: alkesKondisi || undefined,
          filterMode: alkesFilterMode
        });
        if (res.success) setReportData(res.data);
      } else if (activeTab === 'kinerja_nakes') {
        const res = await laporanService.getLaporanKinerjaNakes({
          startDate,
          endDate,
          poliklinikId: selectedPoli || undefined,
          profesi: nakesProfesi || undefined,
          filterMode: nakesFilterMode
        });
        if (res.success) setReportData(res.data);
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error('Gagal memuat data laporan:', err);
      Swal.fire({
        icon: 'error',
        title: 'Gagal Memuat Laporan',
        text: err?.response?.data?.message || 'Terjadi kesalahan saat menarik data pelaporan.'
      });
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [activeTab, startDate, endDate, selectedPoli, periodType, bmhpSearch, bmhpStatus, bmhpFilterMode, alkesKondisi, alkesFilterMode, nakesProfesi, nakesFilterMode]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (startDate && endDate) {
      fetchReport();
    }
  }, [fetchReport]);

  const handlePeriodChange = (val: PeriodType) => {
    setPeriodType(val);
    if (val !== 'custom') {
      applyPeriodPreset(val);
    }
  };

  // Helper Ekspor Excel/CSV Terstruktur
  const handleExportExcel = () => {
    if (!reportData) {
      Swal.fire({ icon: 'warning', title: 'Data Kosong', text: 'Tidak ada data untuk diekspor.' });
      return;
    }

    if (activeTab === 'kunjungan') {
      const headers = ['Tanggal', 'Pasien Baru', 'Pasien Lama', 'Laki-Laki', 'Perempuan', 'BPJS', 'Umum', 'Total Pasien'];
      const rows = (reportData.rekapTabelHarian || []).map((r: any) => [
        r.tanggal,
        r.baru,
        r.lama,
        r.lakiLaki,
        r.perempuan,
        r.bpjs,
        r.umum,
        r.total
      ]);
      exportTableToCsv(`Laporan_Kunjungan_Pasien_${startDate}_sd_${endDate}`, headers, rows);
    } else if (activeTab === 'morbiditas') {
      const headers = ['Peringkat', 'Kode ICD-10', 'Nama Diagnosis Penyakit', 'Kasus Primer', 'Kasus Sekunder', 'Total Kasus', 'Proporsi (%)'];
      const rows = (reportData.topPenyakit || []).map((r: any) => [
        r.peringkat,
        r.kodeIcd10,
        r.namaDiagnosis,
        r.kasusPrimer,
        r.kasusSekunder,
        r.totalKasus,
        `${r.persentase}%`
      ]);
      exportTableToCsv(`Laporan_Morbiditas_LB1_Penyakit_${startDate}_sd_${endDate}`, headers, rows);
    } else if (activeTab === 'bmhp') {
      const headers = ['Kode Item', 'Nama Barang BMHP', 'Kategori', 'Satuan', 'Stok Awal', 'Jumlah Masuk', 'Jumlah Keluar', 'Sisa Stok Akhir', 'Ada Transaksi', 'Status'];
      const rows = (reportData.daftarBMHP || []).map((r: any) => [
        r.kodeItem,
        r.namaItem,
        r.kategori,
        r.sediaan,
        r.stokAwal,
        r.jumlahMasuk,
        r.jumlahKeluar,
        r.sisaStokAkhir,
        r.adaTransaksi ? 'Ya (Aktif)' : 'Tidak Ada Mutasi',
        r.status
      ]);
      exportTableToCsv(`Laporan_Penggunaan_Stok_BMHP_${startDate}_sd_${endDate}`, headers, rows);
    } else if (activeTab === 'alkes') {
      const headers = ['Kode Aset', 'Nama Alat Medis', 'Ruangan / Unit', 'Kategori', 'Kondisi', 'Frekuensi Pemakaian', 'Tarif Satuan (Rp)', 'Total Nilai Utilisasi (Rp)'];
      const rows = (reportData.daftarAlkes || []).map((r: any) => [
        r.kodeAset,
        r.namaAset,
        r.ruangan,
        r.kategori,
        r.kondisi,
        `${r.frekuensiPakai || 0} Kali`,
        r.tarifPemakaian || 0,
        r.totalNilaiUtilisasi || 0
      ]);
      exportTableToCsv(`Laporan_Penggunaan_Alat_Medis_${startDate}_sd_${endDate}`, headers, rows);
    } else if (activeTab === 'kinerja_nakes') {
      const headers = [
        'No',
        'Nama Tenaga Medis',
        'Profesi / Jabatan',
        'SIP / STR',
        'Unit / Poliklinik',
        'Konsultasi RME',
        'Tindakan Klinis',
        'Resep Obat',
        'Skrining & Triase',
        'Total Aktivitas Klinis'
      ];
      const rows = (reportData.daftarKinerjaNakes || [])
        .filter((r: any) => nakesFilterMode === 'semua' || r.adaTransaksi || r.totalAktivitas > 0)
        .map((r: any, idx: number) => [
          idx + 1,
          r.nama,
          r.profesi,
          r.nomorSip !== '-' ? r.nomorSip : (r.nomorStr !== '-' ? r.nomorStr : '-'),
          r.poli,
          r.jumlahRme,
          r.jumlahTindakan,
          r.jumlahResep,
          r.jumlahScreening,
          r.totalAktivitas
        ]);
      exportTableToCsv(`Laporan_Kinerja_Tenaga_Medis_${startDate}_sd_${endDate}`, headers, rows);
    }
  };

  const getPoliName = () => {
    if (!selectedPoli) return 'Semua Poliklinik';
    const p = poliList.find(x => x.id === selectedPoli);
    return p?.namaPoli || 'Poliklinik';
  };

  return (
    <div className="p-4 sm:p-6 lg:p-8 max-w-7xl mx-auto space-y-6">
      
      {/* ── HEADER HALAMAN UTAMA ── */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row justify-between items-start sm:items-center gap-4 bg-white p-6 border border-slate-200 shadow-xs">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
            <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-black uppercase bg-blue-100 text-blue-800 tracking-wider">
              Modul SP2TP &amp; Akreditasi Faskes
            </span>
            <span className="text-xs text-gray-400">•</span>
            <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500">Multi-Kategori Laporan Resmi</span>
          </div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-black text-slate-900 tracking-tight flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <BarChart3 className="w-7 h-7 text-blue-600" />
            Pusat Laporan &amp; Rekapitulasi Faskes
          </h1>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-1 max-w-2xl">
            Sistem agregasi data terpadu untuk pencatatan kunjungan, morbiditas 10 besar penyakit (LB1), mutasi logistik BMHP, dan utilisasi inventaris alkes.
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Global Action Buttons */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 w-full sm:w-auto">
          <button
            onClick={fetchReport}
            disabled={loading}
            className="px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-700 font-bold text-xs flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors border border-slate-300 shadow-xs cursor-pointer"
            title="Muat ulang data terbaru"
          >
            <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${loading ? 'animate-spin text-blue-600' : ''}`} />
            Refresh
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={handleExportExcel}
            disabled={loading || !reportData}
            className="px-4 py-2.5 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white font-bold text-xs flex items-center gap-2 transition-colors shadow-xs cursor-pointer"
            title="Unduh tabel data dalam format Microsoft Excel / CSV"
          >
            <FileSpreadsheet className="w-4 h-4" />
            Ekspor Excel
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => setIsCetakModalOpen(true)}
            disabled={loading || !reportData}
            className="px-4 py-2.5 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white font-bold text-xs flex items-center gap-2 transition-colors shadow-xs cursor-pointer"
            title="Buka dokumen laporan resmi siap cetak / simpan ke PDF"
          >
            <Printer className="w-4 h-4" />
            Cetak Dokumen Resmi (A4)
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* ── 5 TAB UTAMA LAPORAN ── */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-5 gap-3">
        <button
          onClick={() => setActiveTab('kunjungan')}
          className={`p-4 border text-left transition-all cursor-pointer ${
            activeTab === 'kunjungan'
              ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white border-blue-600 shadow-md ring-2 ring-blue-300'
              : 'bg-white hover:bg-slate-50 text-slate-700 border-slate-200 shadow-xs'
          }`}
        >
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
            <Users className={`w-6 h-6 ${activeTab === 'kunjungan' ? 'text-white' : 'text-blue-600'}`} />
            <span className={`text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full ${
              activeTab === 'kunjungan' ? 'bg-blue-700 text-white' : 'bg-blue-50 text-blue-700'
            }`}>
              Tab 1
            </span>
          </div>
          <h2 className="text-sm font-extrabold leading-tight">Kunjungan Pasien</h2>
          <p className={`text-[11px] mt-1 ${activeTab === 'kunjungan' ? 'text-blue-100' : 'text-slate-500'}`}>
            Trafik harian, bulanan, tahunan, gender &amp; penjamin.
          </p>
        </button>

        <button
          onClick={() => setActiveTab('morbiditas')}
          className={`p-4 border text-left transition-all cursor-pointer ${
            activeTab === 'morbiditas'
              ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white border-indigo-600 shadow-md ring-2 ring-indigo-300'
              : 'bg-white hover:bg-slate-50 text-slate-700 border-slate-200 shadow-xs'
          }`}
        >
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
            <Activity className={`w-6 h-6 ${activeTab === 'morbiditas' ? 'text-white' : 'text-indigo-600'}`} />
            <span className={`text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full ${
              activeTab === 'morbiditas' ? 'bg-indigo-700 text-white' : 'bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700'

        <button

              : 'bg-white hover:bg-slate-50 text-slate-700 border-slate-200 shadow-xs'
          }`}
        >
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">

          onClick={() => setActiveTab('alkes')}

            activeTab === 'alkes'
